Technical Implementation Plan\n\n### 5.1 Recommended Stack\n\n**Frontend**\n\n- Tauri, Electron, or native Windows UI.\n- React for task panel and command center.\n\n**Backend**\n\n- TypeScript/Node.js for orchestration and connectors.\n- Python for OCR/CV/ML-heavy perception modules if needed.\n- Rust or native modules for low-level OS integration if performance requires it.\n\n**Database**\n\n- SQLite for local MVP.\n- Postgres for team/enterprise edition.\n- Vector index for semantic skill and memory search.\n\n**Automation**\n\n- Windows UI Automation API.\n- Playwright or Chrome DevTools Protocol.\n- OS input APIs.\n- Filesystem APIs.\n\n**AI**\n\n- LLM for intent parsing, planning, summarization, code tasks.\n- OCR engine for visual text.\n- Vision model for screenshot understanding.\n- Embeddings for semantic retrieval.\n\n### 5.2 Repository Structure\n\n```text\ndesktop-agent/\n  apps/\n    desktop-client/\n    agent-service/\n  packages/\n    core/\n    planner/\n    task-graph/\n    skill-registry/\n    perception/\n    action-engine/\n    verification/\n    policy/\n    memory/\n    connectors/\n    ui-automation/\n    browser-automation/\n    filesystem/\n    devtools/\n  skills/\n    vision/\n    mouse/\n    keyboard/\n    windows/\n    files/\n    browser/\n    developer/\n    communication/\n    enterprise/\n  docs/\n    architecture.md\n    skill-format.md\n    security.md\n```\n\n### 5.3 Execution Flow\n\n1. User submits task.\n2. Intent parser returns structured intent.\n3. Planner creates task graph.\n4. Policy engine evaluates risk.\n5. User approves risky actions.\n6. Executor runs graph nodes.\n7. Perception engine observes current state.\n8. Skill runs action.\n9. Verification engine confirms outcome.\n10. On failure, planner retries or asks user.\n11. Final report is generated.\n12. Useful workflow patterns are saved to memory.\n\n### 5.4 Task Graph Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"task_id\": \"task_001\",\n  \"goal\": \"Organize Downloads folder\",\n  \"nodes\": [\n    { \"id\": \"n1\", \"type\": \"observe\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.list_folder\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n2\", \"type\": \"decide\", \"skill\": \"files.classify_by_content\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n3\", \"type\": \"act\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.create_folders\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n4\", \"type\": \"act\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.move_files\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n5\", \"type\": \"verify\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.verify_manifest\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n6\", \"type\": \"summarize\", \"skill\": \"report.task_summary\" }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### 5.5 Skill Runtime Contract\n\n```ts\ntype SkillInput = {\n  taskId: string;\n  parameters: Record<string, unknown>;\n  context: AgentContext;\n  permissions: PermissionGrant[];\n};\n\ntype SkillResult = {\n  status: \"success\" | \"failed\" | \"needs_user\" | \"blocked\";\n  output?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  evidence?: Evidence[];\n  error?: {\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    recoverable: boolean;\n  };\n};\n```\n\n### 5.6 Verification Strategy\n\nUse layered verification:\n\n- **File operations**: path exists, checksum, manifest.\n- **Browser actions**: DOM state, URL, network state, screenshot.\n- **UI actions**: accessibility state, screenshot diff, OCR text.\n- **Developer tasks**: tests pass, lint passes, git diff matches goal.\n- **Communication**: draft exists, recipient matches, approval captured before send.\n\n### 5.7 Safety Strategy\n\n- Dry-run mode for file and enterprise workflows.\n- Trash instead of permanent delete.\n- Approval gates for external sends and destructive actions.\n- Screenshot evidence for high-risk actions.\n- Rollback manifests for local changes.\n- Redaction before external model calls.\n- Emergency stop hotkey.\n\n### 5.8 Model Strategy\n\n- Small fast model for intent classification and routing.\n- Strong reasoning model for planning and code changes.\n- Vision model for screenshots.\n- Embedding model for memory and skill retrieval.\n- Optional local models for privacy-sensitive OCR/classification.\n\n### 5.9 Testing Strategy\n\n- Unit tests for skill inputs/outputs.\n- Golden tests for intent parsing.\n- Simulated UI tests for mouse/keyboard/window skills.\n- Browser e2e tests with Playwright.\n- File operation tests in sandbox folders.\n- Regression test corpus for screenshots.\n- Security tests for policy enforcement.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Database Schema For Skill Registry\n\n### 6.1 Core Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE skills (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  domain TEXT NOT NULL,\n  category TEXT NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT NOT NULL,\n  version TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n  risk_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  platforms TEXT NOT NULL,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_inputs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  description TEXT,\n  default_value TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_outputs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_dependencies (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  dependency_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  dependency_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  version_constraint TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_verification_methods (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  method_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  method_config TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_permissions (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  permission_scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  permission_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  approval_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_runs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  finished_at TEXT,\n  input_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n  output_json TEXT,\n  error_json TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_metrics (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  success_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  average_duration_ms INTEGER,\n  last_success_at TEXT,\n  last_failure_at TEXT\n);\n```\n\n### 6.2 Task Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE tasks (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  user_goal TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  risk_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  completed_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE task_nodes (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  skill_id TEXT REFERENCES skills(id),\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  depends_on TEXT,\n  input_json TEXT,\n  output_json TEXT,\n  error_json TEXT,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE approvals (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_id TEXT REFERENCES task_nodes(id),\n  permission_scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,\n  decision TEXT,\n  decided_at TEXT,\n  evidence_json TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE evidence (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_id TEXT REFERENCES task_nodes(id),\n  evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  uri TEXT,\n  content_hash TEXT,\n  metadata_json TEXT,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n```\n\n### 6.3 Memory Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE memories (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  memory_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  content TEXT NOT NULL,\n  embedding_id TEXT,\n  confidence REAL NULL\n);\n```\n\n### 6.4 Example Skill Record\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": \"browser.form.fill_text\",\n  \"name\": \"Fill Browser Text Field\",\n  \"domain\": \"browser_automation\",\n  \"category\": Modular System Architecture\n\n### 3.1 High-Level Pipeline\n\n```text\nNatural Language Input\n  -> Intent Parser\n  -> Planner\n  -> Task Graph\n  -> Policy & Permission Gate\n  -> Skill Registry\n  -> Execution Engine\n  -> OS APIs / UI Automation / Browser / App Connectors\n  -> Vision Verification\n  -> Self-Correction Loop\n  -> Audit Log / Memory / User Feedback\n```\n\n### 3.2 Core Modules\n\n#### 3.2.1 Interaction Layer\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Accept chat, voice, hotkey, command palette, and scheduled triggers.\n- Display task plan, progress, approvals, and results.\n- Support pause/resume/cancel.\n\n**Interfaces**\n\n- `POST /tasks`\n- `GET /tasks/:id`\n- `POST /tasks/:id/approve`\n- `POST /tasks/:id/cancel`\n\n#### 3.2.2 Intent Parser\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Convert natural language into structured intent.\n- Extract target apps, files, people, dates, constraints, risk level.\n- Detect ambiguity.\n\n**Output**\n\n```json\n{\n  \"intent\": \"organize_files\",\n  \"entities\": {\n    \"source_folder\": \"Downloads\",\n    \"file_types\": [\"pdf\", \"docx\"],\n    \"strategy\": \"semantic\"\n  },\n  \"constraints\": {\n    \"ask_before_delete\": true\n  },\n  \"risk_level\": 1\n}\n```\n\n#### 3.2.3 Planner\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Convert intent into task graph.\n- Choose skill candidates.\n- Add verification nodes.\n- Add rollback/checkpoint nodes for risky steps.\n\n#### 3.2.4 Task Graph Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Execute DAG nodes.\n- Track state.\n- Retry failed nodes.\n- Resume from checkpoint.\n- Support parallel execution when safe.\n\n**Node types**\n\n- `observe`\n- `decide`\n- `act`\n- `verify`\n- `rollback`\n- `ask_user`\n- `summarize`\n\n#### 3.2.5 Skill Registry\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Store skill metadata.\n- Version skills.\n- Match capabilities to tasks.\n- Track reliability and risk.\n- Support install/update/remove.\n\n#### 3.2.6 Perception Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Capture screen.\n- Parse OCR.\n- Read accessibility tree.\n- Detect UI elements.\n- Merge visual and accessibility signals.\n- Produce actionable UI state.\n\n#### 3.2.7 Action Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Mouse operations.\n- Keyboard operations.\n- OS APIs.\n- Browser protocol operations.\n- App connector operations.\n- File system operations.\n\n#### 3.2.8 Verification Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Confirm each action had intended effect.\n- Compare before/after state.\n- Detect errors and unexpected UI.\n- Trigger retry or planner correction.\n\n#### 3.2.9 Policy Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Evaluate permissions.\n- Detect sensitive actions.\n- Require approval.\n- Enforce app/file/domain boundaries.\n- Log all decisions.\n\n#### 3.2.10 Memory Engine\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Store user preferences.\n- Remember repeat workflows.\n- Maintain app-specific learned procedures.\n- Track failed attempts and successful patterns.\n\n#### 3.2.11 Connector Layer\n\n**Connector types**\n\n- OS connector.\n- Browser connector.\n- Files connector.\n- App connector.\n- Cloud SaaS connector.\n- Enterprise connector.\n- Developer tool connector.\n\n#### 3.2.12 Observability Layer\n\n**Responsibilities**\n\n- Structured logs.\n- Screenshots at key states.\n- Action replay trace.\n- Metrics.\n- Error reports.\n- User-visible task report.\n\n---\n\n## 4. MVP Roadmap\n\n### Phase 0: Foundation (2–3 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Build local agent shell.\n- Define task model.\n- Implement permission model.\n- Implement basic logging.\n- Build skill registry schema.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Desktop tray or command palette.\n- Natural-language task intake.\n- Task graph executor.\n- Local SQLite/Postgres database.\n- Basic audit log.\n\n### Phase 1: Local Desktop Automation (4–6 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Control mouse and keyboard.\n- Read screenshots and accessibility tree.\n- Manage windows.\n- Perform file operations safely.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Screenshot capture.\n- OCR integration.\n- Accessibility parser.\n- Mouse/keyboard automation.\n- File organizer workflows.\n- Visual verification loop.\n\n**MVP demos**\n\n- Organize Downloads.\n- Rename files from content.\n- Extract table from screenshot/PDF.\n- Open app and perform simple UI flow.\n\n### Phase 2: Browser Automation (4–6 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Automate browser workflows reliably.\n- Use DOM plus vision fallback.\n- Support downloads, uploads, and forms.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Playwright/CDP integration.\n- Browser profile management.\n- Form filling.\n- DOM extraction.\n- Download verification.\n- Login-state detection.\n\n**MVP demos**\n\n- Download report from website.\n- Fill web form.\n- Extract dashboard table.\n- Save webpage as PDF.\n\n### Phase 3: Developer Assistant (4–8 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Support coding workflows.\n- Integrate with Git, VS Code, terminal, tests.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Repo inspection.\n- Code edit pipeline.\n- Test runner.\n- Git operations.\n- Commit creation.\n- PR summary generation.\n\n**MVP demos**\n\n- Fix failing test.\n- Add feature in existing repo.\n- Review diff.\n- Generate docs.\n\n### Phase 4: Communication & Scheduling (4–6 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Support email, chat, and calendar with approval gates.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Email read/summarize/draft.\n- Calendar lookup and scheduling.\n- Meeting notes workflow.\n- Chat summarization.\n\n**MVP demos**\n\n- Summarize unread important emails.\n- Draft reply for approval.\n- Create calendar event.\n- Summarize meeting transcript.\n\n### Phase 5: Enterprise & Skill Marketplace (8–12 weeks)\n\n**Goals**\n\n- Add enterprise integrations and reusable skill packs.\n\n**Deliverables**\n\n- Skill package format.\n- Connector marketplace.\n- Admin policy controls.\n- Enterprise audit exports.\n- Role-based permissions.\n\n**MVP demos**\n\n- Jira ticket triage.\n- Salesforce update draft.\n- ServiceNow ticket summary.\n- Compliance evidence collection.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Technical Implementation Plan\n\n### 5.1 Recommended Stack\n\n**Frontend**\n\n- Tauri, Electron, or native Windows UI.\n- React for task panel and command center.\n\n**Backend**\n\n- TypeScript/Node.js for orchestration and connectors.\n- Python for OCR/CV/ML-heavy perception modules if needed.\n- Rust or native modules for low-level OS integration if performance requires it.\n\n**Database**\n\n- SQLite for local MVP.\n- Postgres for team/enterprise edition.\n- Vector index for semantic skill and memory search.\n\n**Automation**\n\n- Windows UI Automation API.\n- Playwright or Chrome DevTools Protocol.\n- OS input APIs.\n- Filesystem APIs.\n\n**AI**\n\n- LLM for intent parsing, planning, summarization, code tasks.\n- OCR engine for visual text.\n- Vision model for screenshot understanding.\n- Embeddings for semantic retrieval.\n\n### 5.2 Repository Structure\n\n```text\ndesktop-agent/\n  apps/\n    desktop-client/\n    agent-service/\n  packages/\n    core/\n    planner/\n    task-graph/\n    skill-registry/\n    perception/\n    action-engine/\n    verification/\n    policy/\n    memory/\n    connectors/\n    ui-automation/\n    browser-automation/\n    filesystem/\n    devtools/\n  skills/\n    vision/\n    mouse/\n    keyboard/\n    windows/\n    files/\n    browser/\n    developer/\n    communication/\n    enterprise/\n  docs/\n    architecture.md\n    skill-format.md\n    security.md\n```\n\n### 5.3 Execution Flow\n\n1. User submits task.\n2. Intent parser returns structured intent.\n3. Planner creates task graph.\n4. Policy engine evaluates risk.\n5. User approves risky actions.\n6. Executor runs graph nodes.\n7. Perception engine observes current state.\n8. Skill runs action.\n9. Verification engine confirms outcome.\n10. On failure, planner retries or asks user.\n11. Final report is generated.\n12. Useful workflow patterns are saved to memory.\n\n### 5.4 Task Graph Example\n\n```json\n{\n  \"task_id\": \"task_001\",\n  \"goal\": \"Organize Downloads folder\",\n  \"nodes\": [\n    { \"id\": \"n1\", \"type\": \"observe\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.list_folder\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n2\", \"type\": \"decide\", \"skill\": \"files.classify_by_content\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n3\", \"type\": \"act\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.create_folders\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n4\", \"type\": \"act\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.move_files\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n5\", \"type\": \"verify\", \"skill\": \"filesystem.verify_manifest\" },\n    { \"id\": \"n6\", \"type\": \"summarize\", \"skill\": \"report.task_summary\" }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n### 5.5 Skill Runtime Contract\n\n```ts\ntype SkillInput = {\n  taskId: string;\n  parameters: Record<string, unknown>;\n  context: AgentContext;\n  permissions: PermissionGrant[];\n};\n\ntype SkillResult = {\n  status: \"success\" | \"failed\" | \"needs_user\" | \"blocked\";\n  output?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  evidence?: Evidence[];\n  error?: {\n    code: string;\n    message: string;\n    recoverable: boolean;\n  };\n};\n```\n\n### 5.6 Verification Strategy\n\nUse layered verification:\n\n- **File operations**: path exists, checksum, manifest.\n- **Browser actions**: DOM state, URL, network state, screenshot.\n- **UI actions**: accessibility state, screenshot diff, OCR text.\n- **Developer tasks**: tests pass, lint passes, git diff matches goal.\n- **Communication**: draft exists, recipient matches, approval captured before send.\n\n### 5.7 Safety Strategy\n\n- Dry-run mode for file and enterprise workflows.\n- Trash instead of permanent delete.\n- Approval gates for external sends and destructive actions.\n- Screenshot evidence for high-risk actions.\n- Rollback manifests for local changes.\n- Redaction before external model calls.\n- Emergency stop hotkey.\n\n### 5.8 Model Strategy\n\n- Small fast model for intent classification and routing.\n- Strong reasoning model for planning and code changes.\n- Vision model for screenshots.\n- Embedding model for memory and skill retrieval.\n- Optional local models for privacy-sensitive OCR/classification.\n\n### 5.9 Testing Strategy\n\n- Unit tests for skill inputs/outputs.\n- Golden tests for intent parsing.\n- Simulated UI tests for mouse/keyboard/window skills.\n- Browser e2e tests with Playwright.\n- File operation tests in sandbox folders.\n- Regression test corpus for screenshots.\n- Security tests for policy enforcement.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Database Schema For Skill Registry\n\n### 6.1 Core Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE skills (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  domain TEXT NOT NULL,\n  category TEXT NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT NOT NULL,\n  version TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n  risk_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  platforms TEXT NOT NULL,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_inputs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  description TEXT,\n  default_value TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_outputs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_dependencies (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  dependency_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  dependency_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  version_constraint TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_verification_methods (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  method_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  method_config TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_permissions (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  permission_scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  permission_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  approval_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_runs (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  finished_at TEXT,\n  input_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n  output_json TEXT,\n  error_json TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE skill_metrics (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  skill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES skills(id),\n  success_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  average_duration_ms INTEGER,\n  last_success_at TEXT,\n  last_failure_at TEXT\n);\n```\n\n### 6.2 Task Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE tasks (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  user_goal TEXT NOT NULL,\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  risk_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  completed_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE task_nodes (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  skill_id TEXT REFERENCES skills(id),\n  status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  depends_on TEXT,\n  input_json TEXT,\n  output_json TEXT,\n  error_json TEXT,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE approvals (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_id TEXT REFERENCES task_nodes(id),\n  permission_scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  prompt TEXT NOT NULL,\n  decision TEXT,\n  decided_at TEXT,\n  evidence_json TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE evidence (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),\n  node_id TEXT REFERENCES task_nodes(id),\n  evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  uri TEXT,\n  content_hash TEXT,\n  metadata_json TEXT,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n```\n\n### 6.3 Memory Tables\n\n```sql\nCREATE TABLE memories (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  memory_type TEXT NOT NULL,\n  scope TEXT NOT NULL,\n  content TEXT NOT NULL,\n  embedding_id TEXT,\n  confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  expires_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE workflow_templates (\n  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  description TEXT NOT NULL,\n  trigger_pattern TEXT,\n  task_graph_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n  usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n```\n\n### 6.4 Example Skill Record\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": \"browser.form.fill_text\",\n  \"name\": \"Fill Browser Text Field\",\n  \"domain\": \"browser_automation\",\n  \"category\": \"forms\",\n  \"description\": \"Find and fill a text input in a browser page using DOM selectors with visual fallback.\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"risk_level\": 1,\n  \"platforms\": [\"windows\", \"macos\", \"linux\"],\n  \"inputs\": [\n    { \"name\": \"field_hint\", \"type\": \"string\", \"required\": true },\n    { \"name\": \"value\", \"type\": \"string\", \"required\": true Investor-Style Vision Document\n\n### 7.1 One-Liner\n\nA local-first AI operator that can understand, control, and verify work across the entire desktop.\n\n### 7.2 Problem\n\nModern work is fragmented across browser tabs, desktop apps, files, messages, meetings, dashboards, and developer tools. People waste hours on repetitive coordination: moving data, renaming files, filling forms, checking dashboards, updating tickets, and switching contexts.\n\nCurrent AI assistants can answer questions, but most cannot reliably operate the actual computer. Traditional RPA can automate repetitive workflows, but it is brittle, expensive, and hard to adapt.\n\n### 7.3 Solution\n\nDesktop AI Agent Platform combines natural-language planning, screen perception, OS automation, browser control, app connectors, and verification into one agent runtime.\n\nUsers give goals. The agent decomposes them into task graphs, selects skills from a growing registry, acts through the safest available interface, verifies results, and asks for approval when needed.\n\n### 7.4 Why Now\n\n- Vision-language models can understand UI screenshots.\n- Browser automation and accessibility APIs are mature.\n- Developers and enterprises are actively adopting AI agents.\n- Knowledge work is increasingly app-fragmented.\n- Local-first privacy is becoming a competitive advantage.\n\n### 7.5 Market\n\n**Initial wedge**\n\n- Developers and AI builders.\n- Technical operators.\n- Founder-led teams.\n- Power users.\n\n**Expansion**\n\n- SMB automation.\n- Enterprise RPA replacement.\n- IT operations.\n- Finance/admin operations.\n- Customer support operations.\n\n### 7.6 Differentiation\n\n- Works across the actual desktop, not only inside one SaaS app.\n- Combines APIs, DOM, accessibility, vision, and OS input.\n- Verification-first architecture.\n- Skill registry scales from atomic actions to complex workflows.\n- Local-first security posture.\n- Human approval built into sensitive operations.\n\n### 7.7 Moat\n\n- Growing skill registry.\n- Real-world workflow traces.\n- App-specific recovery patterns.\n- Permission and safety framework.\n- Enterprise connector ecosystem.\n- User-specific workflow memory.\n\n### 7.8 Business Model\n\nPossible pricing:\n\n- Free local developer edition.\n- Pro subscription for power users.\n- Team plan with shared skill packs.\n- Enterprise plan with admin controls, audit logs, and private deployment.\n- Marketplace revenue share for premium skills/connectors.\n\n### 7.9 12-Month Milestones\n\n**Months 1–3**\n\n- MVP desktop agent.\n- File, browser, and developer workflows.\n- 100 high-quality skills.\n\n**Months 4–6**\n\n- Communication workflows.\n- Skill marketplace alpha.\n- Team workspace support.\n- 300+ skills.\n\n**Months 7–9**\n\n- Enterprise connectors.\n- Admin policy engine.\n- Workflow analytics.\n- 700+ skills.\n\n**Months 10–12**\n\n- Enterprise pilot customers.\n- 1,000+ skills.\n- App-specific workflow packs.\n- Private deployment option.\n\n### 7.10 Strategic Narrative\n\nThe next interface for computers is not another dashboard. It is an operator layer: an AI system that can see the state of work, choose the right tool, perform the action, verify the result, and learn the workflow.\n\nDesktop AI Agent Platform turns the computer itself into the execution environment for AI.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Recommended Immediate Build Order\n\n1. Define skill schema and task graph schema.\n2. Build local task executor.\n3. Add file system skills with dry-run and rollback.\n4. {"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\skills\\contracts.py","content":"\"\"\"Skill contracts - typed inputs, outputs, and results.\n\nThese are the canonical Pydantic types used by every skill handler.\nSkills declare their inputs/outputs in the registry; the runtime\nvalidates them before/after execution.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\n\nclass SkillStatus(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Outcome status for a skill run.\"\"\"\n\n    SUCCESS = \"success\"\n    FAILED = \"failed\"\n    BLOCKED = \"blocked\"\n    TIMEOUT = \"timeout\"\n    ROLLED_BACK = \"rolled_back\"\n    NEEDS_APPROVAL = \"needs_approval\"\n\n\nclass SkillInputSpec(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Declared input parameter for a skill.\"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    type: str = \"string\"  # string | int | float | bool | path | url | json\n    required: bool = True\n    description: str = \"\"\n    default: Optional[Any] = None\n\n\nclass SkillOutputSpec(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Declared output field for a skill.\"\"\"\n\n    name: str\n    type: str = \"string\"\n    description: str = \"\"\n\n\nclass SkillVerificationSpec(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Verification method attached to a skill.\"\"\"\n\n    method: str  # file_exists | dom_state | screenshot_diff | ocr_text | process_healthy | http_status | json_path\n    config: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)\n    required: bool = True\n\n\nclass SkillPermission(str, Enum):\n    \"\"\"Permission scopes a skill may request.\"\"\"\n\n    FS_READ = \"fs.read\"\n    FS_WRITE = \"fs.write\"\n    FS_DELETE = \"fs.delete\"\n    NET_HTTP = \"net.http\"\n    PROCESS_SPAWN = \"process.spawn\"\n    VAULT_READ = \"vault.read\"\n    VAULT_WRITE = \"vault.write\"\n    SCREEN_READ = \"screen.read\"\n    SCREEN_CLICK = \"screen.click\"\n    BROWSER_AUTOMATE = \"browser.automate\"\n\n\nclass SkillDefinition(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Full skill metadata as stored in the registry.\"\"\"\n\n    id: str\n    domain: str\n    name: str\n    description: str\n    version: str = \"1.0.0\"\n    risk_level: int = 0\n    requires_approval: bool = False\n    reversible: bool = True\n    idempotent: bool = True\n    timeout_sec: int = 30\n    retry_limit: int = 2\n    enabled: bool = True\n    handler: str  # dotted path, e.g. \"app.skills.handlers.file.list_dir\"\n    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)\n    inputs: List[SkillInputSpec] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    outputs: List[SkillOutputSpec] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    dependencies: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    verification: List[SkillVerificationSpec] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    permissions: List[SkillPermission] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n\nclass SkillRunRequest(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Request to execute a skill.\"\"\"\n\n    skill_id: str\n    inputs: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)\n    task_id: Optional[str] = None\n    node_id: Optional[str] = None\n    command_id: Optional[int] = None\n    device_id: Optional[str] = None\n\n\nclass SkillRunResult(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Result of a skill execution.\"\"\"\n\n    skill_id: str\n    status: SkillStatus\n    outputs: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n    duration_ms: int = 0\n    attempts: int = 1\n    evidence_ids: List[int] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    verification_passed: Optional[bool] = None\n    verification_details: List[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\skills\\registry.py","content":"\"\"\"Skill registry - SQLite-backed CRUD + metrics for skills.\n\nThe registry is the single source of truth for what skills exist,\nwhat they need, what they return, and how they are verified.\nHandlers are looked up by dotted path at execution time.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom app.db.database import SkillVerificationSpec,\n)\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass SkillRegistry:\n    \"\"\"SQLite-backed skill registry.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._cache: Dict[str, SkillDefinition] = {}\n        self._cache_loaded = False\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # CRUD\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def register(self, skill: SkillDefinition) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Insert or update a skill definition.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO skills (\n                    id, domain, name, description, version, risk_level,\n                    requires_approval, reversible, idempotent, timeout_sec,\n                    retry_limit, enabled, handler, tags, metadata_json,\n                    updated_at\n                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n                ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET\n                    domain=excluded.domain,\n                    name=excluded.name,\n                    description=excluded.description,\n                    version=excluded.version,\n                    risk_level=excluded.risk_level,\n                    requires_approval=excluded.requires_approval,\n                    reversible=excluded.reversible,\n                    idempotent=excluded.idempotent,\n                    timeout_sec=excluded.timeout_sec,\n                    retry_limit=excluded.retry_limit,\n                    enabled=excluded.enabled,\n                    handler=excluded.handler,\n                    tags=excluded.tags,\n                    metadata_json=excluded.metadata_json,\n                    updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    skill.id,\n                    skill.domain,\n                    skill.name,\n                    skill.description,\n                    skill.version,\n                    skill.risk_level,\n                    1 if skill.requires_approval else 0,\n                    1 if skill.reversible else 0,\n                    1 if skill.idempotent else 0,\n                    skill.timeout_sec,\n                    skill.retry_limit,\n                    1 if skill.enabled else 0,\n                    skill.handler,\n                    json.dumps(skill.tags),\n                    json.dumps(skill.metadata),\n                ),\n            )\n\n            # Replace inputs\n            await db.execute(\"DELETE FROM skill_inputs WHERE skill_id = ?\", (skill.id,))\n            for inp in skill.inputs:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO skill_inputs (skill_id, name, type, required, description, default_value)\n                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (\n                        skill.id,\n                        inp.name,\n                        inp.type,\n                        1 if inp.required else 0,\n                        inp.description,\n                        json.dumps(inp.default) if inp.default is not None else None,\n                    ),\n                )\n\n            # Replace outputs\n            await db.execute(\"DELETE FROM skill_outputs WHERE skill_id = ?\", (skill.id,))\n            for out in skill.outputs:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO skill_outputs (skill_id, name, type, description)\n                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (skill.id, out.name, out.type, out.description),\n                )\n\n            # Replace dependencies\n            await db.execute(\"DELETE FROM skill_dependencies WHERE skill_id = ?\", (skill.id,))\n            for dep in skill.dependencies:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO skill_dependencies (skill_id, depends_on, kind)\n                    VALUES (?, ?, 'requires')\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (skill.id, dep),\n                )\n\n            # Replace verification methods\n            await db.execute(\n                \"DELETE FROM skill_verification_methods WHERE skill_id = ?\", (skill.id,)\n            )\n            for v in skill.verification:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO skill_verification_methods (skill_id, method, config_json, required)\n                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (skill.id, v.method, json.dumps(v.config), 1 if v.required else 0),\n                )\n\n            # Replace permissions\n            await db.execute(\"DELETE FROM skill_permissions WHERE skill_id = ?\", (skill.id,))\n            for perm in skill.permissions:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO skill_permissions (skill_id, scope) VALUES (?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (skill.id, perm.value if isinstance(perm, SkillPermission) else perm),\n                )\n\n            await db.commit()\n\n        self._cache[skill.id] = skill\n        self._cache_loaded = True\n        logger.info(\"Registered skill %s (domain=%s)\", skill.id, skill.domain)\n\n    async def get(self, skill_id: str) -> Optional[SkillDefinition]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch a skill by id (cached).\"\"\"\n        if skill_id in self._cache:\n            return self._cache[skill_id]\n\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\"SELECT * FROM skills WHERE id = ?\", (skill_id,))\n            row = await cur.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return None\n            skill = await self._row_to_skill(db, row)\n        self._cache[skill_id] = skill\n        return skill\n\n    async def list(\n        self,\n        domain: Optional[str] = None,\n        enabled_only: bool = True,\n    ) -> List[SkillDefinition]:\n        \"\"\"List skills, optionally filtered by domain.\"\"\"\n        await self._ensure_cache()\n        results: List[SkillDefinition] = []\n        for skill in self._cache.values():\n            if enabled_only and not skill.enabled:\n                continue\n            if domain and skill.domain != domain:\n                continue\n            results.append(skill)\n        results.sort(key=lambda s: (s.domain, s.id))\n        return results\n\n    async def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 20) -> List[SkillDefinition]:\n        \"\"\"Search skills by id, name, description, or tags.\"\"\"\n        await self._ensure_cache()\n        q = query.lower()\n        scored: List[tuple[int, SkillDefinition]] = []\n        for skill in self._cache.values():\n            score = 0\n            if q in skill.id.lower():\n                score += 5\n            if q in skill.name.lower():\n                score += 3\n            if q in skill.description.lower():\n                score += 2\n            for tag in skill.tags:\n                if q in tag.lower():\n                    score += 2\n            if score > 0:\n                scored.append((score, skill))\n        scored.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])\n        return [s for _, s in scored[:limit]]\n\n    async def enable(self, skill_id: str, enabled: bool = True) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Enable or disable a skill.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"UPDATE skills SET enabled = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?\",\n                (1 if enabled else 0, skill_id),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n        if skill_id in self._cache:\n            self._cache[skill_id].enabled = enabled\n\n    async def delete(self, skill_id: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Remove a skill and its related rows.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\"DELETE FROM skills WHERE id = ?\", (skill_id,))\n            await db.commit()\n        self._cache.pop(skill_id, None)\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Run tracking + metrics\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def record_run(\n        self,\n        skill_id: str,\n        status: SkillStatus,\n        inputs: Dict[str, Any],\n        outputs: Dict[str, Any],\n        duration_ms: int,\n        task_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        node_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        command_id: Optional[int] = None,\n        error:  \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO skill_runs (\n                    skill_id, task_id, command_id, input_json, output_json,\n                    status, error, duration_ms, finished_at\n CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?)\n                ON CONFLICT(skill_id) DO UPDATE SET\n                    total_runs = total_runs + 1,\n                    success_count = success_count + ?,\n                    failure_count = failure_count + ?,\n                    avg_duration_ms = ((avg_duration_ms * (total_runs - 1)) + ?) / total_runs,\n                    last_run_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                    last_status = excluded.last_status\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    skill_id,\n                    1 if status == SkillStatus.SUCCESS else 0,\n                    1 if status != SkillStatus.SUCCESS else 0,\n                    1 if status != SkillStatus.SUCCESS else 0,\n                    duration_ms,\n                    status.value,\n                    duration_ms,\n                ),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n            return run_id or 0\n\n    async def metrics(self, skill_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Return ]\n        cur = await db.execute(\n            \"SELECT depends_on FROM skill_dependencies WHERE skill_id = ?\",\n            (row_dict[\"id\"],),\n        )\n        deps = [r[0] for r in await )\n        verification = [\n            SkillVerificationSpec(\n                method=r[0],\n                config=json.loads(r[1]) if r[1] else {},\n                required=bool(r[2]),\n            )\n            for r in await cur.fetchall()\n        ]\n        cur = await db.execute(\n            \"SELECT scope FROM skill_permissions WHERE skill_id = ?\",\n            (row_dict[\"id\"],),\n After a skill\nruns, the engine runs the verifiers and returns pass/fail with details.\nIf a required verifier fails, the skill result is marked failed and\nthe task graph can trigger rollback.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom app.db.database import db_session\nfrom app.skills.contracts import SkillVerificationSpec\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass VerificationEngine:\n    \"\"\"Runs verification methods against skill outputs.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._handlers: Dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"file_exists\": self._verify_file_exists,\n            \"file_contains\": self._verify_file_contains,\n            \"http_status\": self._verify_http_status,\n            \"json_path\": self._verify_json_path,\n            \"process_healthy\": self._verify_process_healthy,\n            \"ocr_text\": self._verify_ocr_text,\n            \"dom_state\": self._verify_dom_state,\n            \"screenshot_diff\": self._verify_screenshot_diff,\n        }\n\n    async def verify(\n        self,\n        methods: List[SkillVerificationSpec],\n        outputs: Dict[str, Any],\n    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Run all verification methods and return aggregate result.\"\"\"\n        if not methods:\n            return {\"passed\": True, \"checks\": [], \"required_passed\": True}\n\n        checks: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n        required_passed = True\n        for spec in methods:\n            handler = self._handlers.get(spec.method)\n            if handler is None:\n                checks.append(\n                    {\n                        \"method\": spec.method,\n                        \"passed\": False,\n                        \"error\": f\"unknown verification method: {spec.method}\",\n                        \"required\": spec.required,\n                    }\n                )\n                if spec.required:\n                    required_passed = False\n                continue\n            try:\n                passed, detail = await handler(spec.config, outputs)\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                passed, detail = False, f\"verifier raised: {exc}\"\n            checks.append(\n                {\n                    \"method\": spec.method,\n                    \"passed\": bool(passed),\n                    \"detail\": detail,\n                    \"required\": spec.required,\n                }\n            )\n            if spec.required and not passed:\n                required_passed = False\n\n        return {\n            \"passed\": required_passed,\n            \"checks\": checks,\n            \"required_passed\": required_passed,\n        }\n\n    async def record_evidence(\n        self,\n        task_id: Optional[str],\n        node_id: Optional[str],\n        skill_id: Optional[str],\n        kind: str,\n        path: Optional[str] = None,\n        summary: Optional[str] = None,\n        data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,\n    ) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Persist an evidence row for replay/audit.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO evidence (task_id, node_id, skill_id, kind, path, summary, data_json)\n                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    task_id,\n                    node_id,\n                    skill_id,\n                    kind,\n                    path,\n                    summary,\n                    json.dumps(data, default=str) if data else None,\n                ),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n            return cur.lastrowid or 0\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Built-in verifiers\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _verify_file_exists(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        path = config.get(\"path\") or outputs.get(\"path\")\n        if not path:\n            return False, \"no path provided\"\n        exists = Path(path).exists()\n        return exists, f\"path={path} exists={exists}\"\n\n    async def _verify_file_contains(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        path = config.get(\"path\") or outputs.get(\"path\")\n        needle = config.get(\"text\") or outputs.get(\"text\")\n        if not path or needle is None:\n            return False, \"missing path or text\"\n        try:\n            content = Path(path).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"ignore\")\n        except OSError as exc:\n            return False, f\"read failed: {exc}\"\n        ok = str(needle) in content\n        return ok, f\"path={path} contains={ok}\"\n\n    async def _verify_http_status(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        url = config.get(\"url\") or outputs.get(\"url\")\n        expected = int(config.get(\"expected\", 200))\n        if not url:\n            return False, \"no url provided\"\n        try:\n            import urllib.request\n\n            req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=\"HEAD\")\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:  # noqa: S310\n                code = resp.status\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            return False, f\"http error: {exc}\"\n        return code == expected, f\"url={url} status={code} expected={expected}\"\n\n    async def _verify_json_path(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        path = config.get(\"path\", \"\")\n        expected = config.get(\"equals\")\n        data = outputs.get(\"data\") or outputs\n        cur: Any = data\n        for part in path.split(\".\") if path else []:\n            if isinstance(cur, dict):\n                cur = cur.get(part)\n            elif isinstance(cur, list) and part.isdigit():\n                cur = cur[int(part)] if int(part) < len(cur) else None\n            else:\n                return False, f\"cannot descend into {part}\"\n        if expected is None:\n            return cur is not None, f\"path={path} value={cur}\"\n        return cur == expected, f\"path={path} value={cur} expected={expected}\"\n\n    async def _verify_process_healthy(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        name = config.get(\"name\") or outputs.get(\"process\")\n        if not name:\n            return False, \"no process name provided\"\n        try:\n            import psutil  # type: ignore\n\n            for proc in psutil.process_iter([\"name\"]):\n                if name.lower() in (proc.info[\"name\"] or \"\").lower():\n                    return True, f\"process {name} running\"\n            return False, f\"process {name} not found\"\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            return False, f\"psutil error: {exc}\"\n\n    async def _verify_ocr_text(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        # OCR verification is best-effort; if OCR is not loaded we report unknown.\n        text = outputs.get(\"ocr_text\") or \"\"\n        needle = config.get(\"contains\", \"\")\n        if not needle:\n            return True, \"no needle configured\"\n        return needle.lower() in text.lower(), f\"contains={needle in text.lower()}\"\n\n    async def _verify_dom_state(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        selector = config.get(\"selector\")\n        expected = config.get(\"text\")\n        dom = outputs.get(\"dom\") or {}\n        if not selector:\n            return True, \"no selector configured\"\n        node = dom.get(selector)\n        if node is None:\n            return False, f\"selector {selector} not found\"\n        if expected is None:\n            return True, f\"selector {selector} present\"\n        return expected in (node.get(\"text\") or \"\"), f\"text match={expected in (node.get('text') or '')}\"\n\n    async def _verify_screenshot_diff(\n        self, config: Dict[str, Any], outputs: Dict[str, Any]\n    ) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n        # Without a stored baseline we treat the screenshot as evidence only.\n        path = outputs.get(\"screenshot\") or config.get(\"path\")\n        if not path:\n            return False, \"no screenshot path\"\n        return Path(path).exists(), f\"screenshot={path} exists={Path(path).exists()}\"\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\task_graph.py","content":"\"\"\"Task graph - DAG executor with checkpoints.\n\nA task is a directed acyclic graph of nodes. The executor walks the DAG\nin topological order, runs each node, persists checkpoints, and\nsupports resume after interruption.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport time\nimport uuid\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Set\n\nfrom app.db.database import db_session\nfrom app.skills.contracts import SkillRunResult, SkillStatus\nfrom app.skills.registry import SkillRegistry\nfrom app.skills.verification import VerificationEngine\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass NodeType(str, Enum):\n    OBSERVE = \"observe\"\n    DECIDE = \"decide\"\n    ACT = \"act\"\n    VERIFY = \"verify\"\n    ROLLBACK = \"rollback\"\n    ASK_USER = \"ask_user\"\n    SUMMARIZE = \"summarize\"\n\n\nclass TaskStatus(str, Enum):\n    PENDING = \"pending\"\n    RUNNING = \"running\"\n    PAUSED = \"paused\"\n    COMPLETED = \"completed\"\n    FAILED = \"failed\"\n    CANCELLED = \"cancelled\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TaskNode:\n    id: str\n    node_type: NodeType\n    skill_id: Optional[str] = None\n    depends_on: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    inputs: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    outputs: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    status: str = \"pending\"\n    attempts: int = 0\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n    started_at: Optional[float] = None\n    finished_at: Optional[float] = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Task:\n    id: str\n    name: str\n    nodes: List[TaskNode]\n    status: TaskStatus = TaskStatus.PENDING\n    current_node: Optional[str] = None\n    checkpoint: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n    command_id: Optional[int] = None\n    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)\n    started_at: Optional[float] = None\n    finished_at: Optional[float] = None\n\n\nNodeHandler = Callable[[TaskNode, \"TaskContext\"], Awaitable[Dict[str, Any]]]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TaskContext:\n    \"\"\"Runtime context passed to node handlers.\"\"\"\n\n    task: Task\n    skill_registry: SkillRegistry\n    verification_engine: VerificationEngine\n    extra: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n\nclass TaskGraphExecutor:\n    \"\"\"Walks a DAG of nodes and persists state for resume.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        skill_registry: SkillRegistry,\n        verification_engine: VerificationEngine,\n        node_handlers: Optional[Dict[NodeType, NodeHandler]] = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.skill_registry = skill_registry\n        self.verification_engine = verification_engine\n        self.node_handlers = node_handlers or {}\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Public API\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def create_task(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]],\n        command_id: Optional[int] = None,\n    ) -> Task:\n        \"\"\"Create and persist a new task from a node spec list.\"\"\"\n        task_id = f\"task-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}\"\n        task_nodes: List[TaskNode] = []\n        for spec in nodes:\n            node_id = spec.get(\"id\") or f\"node-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}\"\n            task_nodes.append(\n                TaskNode(\n                    id=node_id,\n                    node_type=NodeType(spec.get(\"node_type\", \"act\")),\n                    skill_id=spec.get(\"skill_id\"),\n                    depends_on=list(spec.get(\"depends_on\", [])),\n                    inputs=dict(spec.get(\"inputs\", {})),\n                )\n            )\n        task = Task(\n            id=task_id,\n            name=name,\n            nodes=task_nodes,\n            command_id=command_id,\n        )\n        await self._persist_task(task)\n        return task\n\n    async def run(self, task: Task, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Task:\n        \"\"\"Execute a task to completion (or failure).\"\"\"\n        await self._load_task_state(task)\n        task.status = TaskStatus.RUNNING\n        task.started_at = task.started_at or time.time()\n        await self._update_task_status(task)\n\n        ctx = TaskContext(\n            task=task,\n            skill_registry=self.skill_registry,\n            verification_engine=self.verification_engine,\n            extra=context or {},\n        )\n\n        try:\n            for node in self._topological_order(task.nodes):\n                if task.status in (TaskStatus.CANCELLED, TaskStatus.PAUSED):\n                    break\n                if node.status == \"success\":\n                    continue\n                task.current_node = node.id\n                await self._update_task_current(task)\n                await self._run_node(node, ctx)\n                await self._persist_node(node, task.id)\n                await self._checkpoint(task)\n                if node.status == \"failed\":\n                    task.status = TaskStatus.FAILED\n                    task.error = node.error\n                    break\n            else:\n                task.status = TaskStatus.COMPLETED\n        except asyncio.CancelledError:\n            task.status = TaskStatus.PAUSED\n            raise\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            task.status = TaskStatus.FAILED\n            task.error = str(exc)\n            logger.exception(\"Task %s failed\", task.id)\n        finally:\n            task.finished_at = time.time()\n            await self._update_task_status(task)\n        return task\n\n    async def cancel(self, task_id: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark a task as cancelled.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\"SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id = ?\", (task_id,))\n            row = await cur.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return False\n            if row[\"status\"] not in (TaskStatus.PENDING.value, TaskStatus.RUNNING.value, TaskStatus.PAUSED.value):\n                return False\n            await db.execute(\n                \"UPDATE tasks SET status = ?, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?\",\n                (TaskStatus.CANCELLED.value, task_id),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n            return True\n\n    async def get(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[Task]:\n        \"\"\"Load a task from the database.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\"SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = ?\", (task_id,))\n            row = await cur.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return None\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"SELECT * FROM task_nodes WHERE task_id = ? ORDER BY id\", (task_id,)\n            )\n            node_rows = await cur.fetchall()\n        nodes = [\n            TaskNode(\n                id=r[\"id\"],\n                node_type=NodeType(r[\"node_type\"]),\n                skill_id=r[\"skill_id\"],\n                depends_on=json.loads(r[\"depends_on\"]) if r[\"depends_on\"] else [],\n                inputs=json.loads(r[\"input_json\"]) if r[\"input_json\"] else {},\n                outputs=json.loads(r[\"output_json\"]) if r[\"output_json\"] else {},\n                status=r[\"status\"],\n                attempts=r[\"attempts\"],\n                error=r[\"error\"],\n            )\n            for r in node_rows\n        ]\n        return Task(\n            id=row[\"id\"],\n            name=row[\"name\"],\n            nodes=nodes,\n            status=TaskStatus(row[\"status\"]),\n            current_node=row[\"current_node\"],\n            checkpoint=json.loads(row[\"checkpoint_json\"]) if row[\"checkpoint_json\"] else {},\n            error=row[\"error\"],\n            command_id=row[\"command_id\"],\n        )\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Internals\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _run_node(self, node: TaskNode, ctx: TaskContext) -> None:\n        node.started_at = time.time()\n        node.attempts += 1\n        node.status = \"running\"\n        handler = self.node_handlers.get(node.node_type)\n        try:\n            if handler is None:\n                # Default: act nodes call the skill registry; others are no-ops.\n                if node.node_type == NodeType.ACT and node.skill_id:\n                    result = await self._default_act(node, ctx)\n                    node.outputs = result.outputs\n                    node.status = \"success\" if result.status == SkillStatus.SUCCESS else \"failed\"\n                    node.error = result.error\n                else:\n                    node.status = \"success\"\n            else:\n                outputs = await handler(node, ctx)\n                node.outputs = outputs or {}\n                node.status = \"success\"\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            node.status = \"failed\"\n            node.error = str(exc)\n            logger.exception(\"Node %s failed\", node.id)\n        finally:\n            node.finished_at = time.time()\n\n    async def _default_act(self, node: TaskNode, ctx: TaskContext) -> SkillRunResult:\n        \"\"\"Default act handler: invoke the skill via the registry.\"\"\"\n        from app.skills.runtime import SkillRuntime\n\n        runtime: SkillRuntime = ctx.extra.get(\"skill_runtime\")  # type: ignore[assignment]\n        if runtime is None:\n            return SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=node.skill_id or \"\",\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                error=\"no skill_runtime in context\",\n            )\n        return await runtime.execute(\n            node.skill_id or \"\",\n            node.inputs,\n            task_id=ctx.task.id,\n            node_id=node.id,\n        )\n\n    def _topological_order(self, nodes: List[TaskNode]) -> List[TaskNode]:\n        by_id = {n.id: n for n in nodes}\n        visited: Set[str] = set()\n        order: List[TaskNode] = []\n\n        def visit(n: TaskNode) -> None:\n            if n.id in visited:\n                return\n            visited.add(n.id)\n            for dep in n.depends_on:\n                if dep in by_id:\n                    visit(by_id[dep])\n            order.append(n)\n\n        for n in nodes:\n            visit(n)\n        return order\n\n    async def _persist_task(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO tasks (id, command_id, name, status, plan_json, current_node)\n                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    task.id,\n                    task.command_id,\n                    task.name,\n                    task.status.value,\n                    json.dumps([n.__dict__ for n in task.nodes], default=str),\n                    task.current_node,\n                ),\n            )\n            for n in task.nodes:\n                await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO task_nodes (\n                        id, task_id, node_type, skill_id, depends_on, input_json, status\n                    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (\n                        n.id,\n                        task.id,\n                        n.node_type.value,\n                        n.skill_id,\n                        json.dumps(n.depends_on),\n                        json.dumps(n.inputs, default=str),\n                        n.status,\n                    ),\n                )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def _persist_node(self, node: TaskNode, task_id: str) -> None:\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                UPDATE task_nodes SET\n                    status = ?, output_json = ?, attempts = ?, error = ?,\n                    started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),\n                    finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n                WHERE id = ? AND task_id = ?\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    node.status,\n                    json.dumps(node.outputs, default=str),\n                    node.attempts,\n                    node.error,\n                    node.id,\n                    task_id,\n                ),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def _update_task_status(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                UPDATE tasks SET\n                    status = ?, current_node = ?, error = ?,\n                    started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),\n                    finished_at = CASE WHEN ? IN ('completed','failed','cancelled')\n                                      THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE finished_at END\n                WHERE id = ?\n                \"\"\",\n                (\n                    task.status.value,\n                    task.current_node,\n                    task.error,\n                    task.status.value,\n                    task.id,\n                ),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def _update_task_current(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"UPDATE tasks SET current_node = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (task.current_node, task.id),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def _checkpoint(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        task.checkpoint = {\n            \"current_node\": task.current_node,\n            \"node_statuses\": {n.id: n.status for n in task.nodes},\n            \"ts\": time.time(),\n        }\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"UPDATE tasks SET checkpoint_json = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (json.dumps(task.checkpoint, default=str), task.id),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def _load_task_state(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Reload node statuses from DB so resume works.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"SELECT id, status FROM task_nodes WHERE task_id = ?\", (task.id,)\n            )\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n        statuses = {r[\"id\"]: r[\"status\"] for r in rows}\n        for n in task.nodes:\n            if n.id in statuses:\n                n.status = statuses[n.id]\n"}

The runtime imports it, validates inputs, runs it\nwith retry/timeout, runs verification, and records the run.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport importlib\nimport Awaitable[Dict[str, Any]]]\n\n\nclass SkillRuntime:\n    \"\"\"Executes skills with retry, timeout, and verification.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        registry: SkillRegistry,\n        verification: VerificationEngine,\n        handler_overrides: Optional[Dict[str, SkillHandler]] = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.registry = registry\n        self.verification = verification\n        self._handler_overrides = handler_overrides or {}\n        self._handler_cache: Dict[str, SkillHandler] = {}\n\n    async def execute(\n        self,\n        skill_id: str,\n        inputs: end-to-end.\"\"\"\n        skill = await self.registry.get(skill_id)\n        if skill is None:\n            return SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                error=f\"unknown skill: {skill_id}\",\n            )\n        if not skill.enabled:\n            return SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.BLOCKED,\n                error=\"skill disabled\",\n            )\n\n        # Validate inputs\n        missing = [\n            inp.name\n            for inp in skill.inputs\n            if inp.required and inp.name not in inputs\n        ]\n        if missing:\n            return SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                error=f\"missing required inputs: {missing}\",\n            )\n\n        handler = self._resolve_handler(skill)\n        if handler is None:\n            return SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                error=f\"handler not found: {skill.handler}\",\n            )\n\n        attempts = 0\n        last_error: Optional[str] = None\n        outputs: Dict[str, Any] = {}\n        start = time.time()\n        while attempts <= skill.retry_limit:\n            attempts += 1\n            try:\n                outputs = await asyncio.wait_for(\n                    handler(**inputs),\n                    timeout=skill.timeout_sec,\n                )\n                outputs = outputs or {}\n                last_error = None\n                break\n            except asyncio.TimeoutError:\n                last_error = f\"timeout after {skill.timeout_sec}s\"\n                logger.warning(\"Skill %s timed out (attempt %d)\", skill_id, attempts)\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                last_error = str(exc)\n                logger.warning(\n                    \"Skill %s failed (attempt %d): %s\", skill_id, attempts, exc\n                )\n        duration_ms = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)\n\n        if last_error is not None:\n            result = SkillRunResult(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                error=last_error,\n                duration_ms=duration_ms,\n                attempts=attempts,\n            )\n            await self.registry.record_run(\n                skill_id=skill_id,\n                status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                inputs=inputs,\n                outputs={},\n                duration_ms=duration_ms,\n                task_id=task_id,\n                node_id=node_id,\n                command_id=command_id,\n                error=last_error,\n            )\n            return result\n\n        # Verification\n        verification_passed: Optional[bool] = None\n        verification_details: list = []\n        if skill.verification:\n            v = await self.verification.verify(skill.verification, outputs)\n            verification_passed = bool(v.get(\"passed\"))\n            verification_details = v.get(\"checks\", [])\n            if not verification_passed:\n                result = SkillRunResult(\n                    skill_id=skill_id,\n                    status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                    outputs=outputs,\n                    error=\"verification failed\",\n                    duration_ms=duration_ms,\n                    attempts=attempts,\n                    verification_passed=False,\n                    verification_details=verification_details,\n                )\n                await self.registry.record_run(\n                    skill_id=skill_id,\n                    status=SkillStatus.FAILED,\n                    inputs=inputs,\n                    outputs=outputs,\n                    duration_ms=duration_ms,\n                    task_id=task_id,\n                    node_id=node_id,\n                    command_id=command_id,\n                    error=\"verification failed\",\n                )\n                return result\n\n        result = SkillRunResult(\n            skill_id=skill_id,\n            status=SkillStatus.SUCCESS,\n            outputs=outputs,\n            duration_ms=duration_ms,\n            attempts=attempts,\n            verification_passed=verification_passed,\n            verification_details=verification_details,\n        )\n        await self.registry.record_run(\n node_id=node_id,\n            command_id=command_id,\n        )\n        return result\n\n    def _resolve_handler(self, skill: SkillDefinition) -> Optional[SkillHandler]:\n        if skill.id in self._handler_overrides:\n            return self._handler_overrides[skill.id]\n        if skill.id in self._handler_cache:\n            return self._handler_cache[skill.id]\n        try:\n            module_path, _, attr = skill.handler.rpartition(\".\")\n            if not module_path:\n                return None\n            module = importlib.import_module(module_path)\n            fn = uniformly.\n                async def _async_wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n                    out = fn(*args, **kwargs)\n                    if not isinstance(out, dict):\n                        return {\"result\": out}\n                    return out\n\n                self._handler_cache[skill.id] = _async_wrapper\n                return _async_wrapper\n            self._handler_cache[skill.id] = fn\n            return fn\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            logger.error(\"Failed to import handler %s: %s\", skill.handler, exc)\n Memory entries store user facts, preferences,\nand corrections that survive across sessions.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom app.db.database import db_session\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass MemoryEngine:\n    \"\"\"Persistent memory + workflow templates.\"\"\"\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Memory entries\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def remember(\n        self,\n        kind: str,\n        key: str,\n        value: str,\n        confidence: float = 1.0,\n        source: str = \"user\",\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Insert or update a memory entry.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO memory_entries (kind, key, value, confidence, source)\n                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                ON CONFLICT(kind, key) DO UPDATE SET\n                    value = excluded.value,\n                    confidence = excluded.confidence,\n                    source = excluded.source,\n                    last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n                \"\"\",\n                (kind, key, value, confidence, source),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def recall(self, kind: str, key: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch a memory entry by kind+key.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"SELECT * FROM memory_entries WHERE kind = ? AND key = ?\",\n                (kind, key),\n            )\n            row = await cur.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return None\n            await db.execute(\n                \"UPDATE memory_entries SET last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?\",\n                (row[\"id\"],),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n            return dict(row)\n\n    async def search_memory(\n        self,\n        query: str,\n        kind: Optional[str] = None,\n        limit: int = 20,\n    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Search memory entries by substring.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            sql = \"SELECT * FROM memory_entries WHERE (key LIKE ? OR value LIKE ?)\"\n            params: List[Any] = [f\"%{query}%\", f\"%{query}%\"]\n            if kind:\n                sql += \" AND kind = ?\"\n                params.append(kind)\n            sql += \" ORDER BY last_used_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?\"\n            params.append(max(1, min(limit, 200)))\n            cur = await db.execute(sql, params)\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\n\n    async def forget(self, kind: str, key: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Delete a memory entry.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"DELETE FROM memory_entries WHERE kind = ? AND key = ?\",\n                (kind, key),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n            return (cur.rowcount or 0) > 0\n\n    async def list_memory(self, kind: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"List all memory entries, optionally filtered by kind.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            if kind:\n                cur = await db.execute(\n                    \"SELECT * FROM memory_entries WHERE kind = ? ORDER BY id DESC\",\n                    (kind,),\n                )\n            else:\n                cur = await db.execute(\n                    \"SELECT * FROM memory_entries ORDER BY id DESC\"\n                )\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Workflow templates\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def save_template(\n        self,\n        template_id: str,\n        name: str,\n        plan: List[Dict[str, Any]],\n        description: str = \"\",\n        trigger_text: str = \"\",\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Insert or update a workflow template.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, trigger_text, plan_json)\n                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET\n                    name = excluded.name,\n                    description = excluded.description,\n                    trigger_text = excluded.trigger_text,\n                    plan_json = excluded.plan_json\n                \"\"\",\n                (template_id, name, description, trigger_text, json.dumps(plan, default=str)),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    async def get_template(self, template_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Fetch a workflow template by id.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"SELECT * FROM workflow_templates WHERE id = ?\", (template_id,)\n            )\n            row = await cur.fetchone()\n            if not row:\n                return None\n            d = dict(row)\n            d[\"plan\"] = json.loads(d.pop(\"plan_json\")) if d.get(\"plan_json\") else []\n            return d\n\n    async def list_templates(self, enabled_only: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"List workflow templates.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            sql = \"SELECT * FROM workflow_templates\"\n            if enabled_only:\n                sql += \" WHERE enabled = 1\"\n            sql += \" ORDER BY use_count DESC, id DESC\"\n            cur = await db.execute(sql)\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n            results = []\n            for r in rows:\n                d = dict(r)\n                d[\"plan\"] = json.loads(d.pop(\"plan_json\")) if d.get(\"plan_json\") else []\n                results.append(d)\n            return results\n\n    async def match_template(self, text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Find a template whose trigger_text matches the user command.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"SELECT * FROM workflow_templates WHERE enabled = 1\"\n            )\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n        text_lower = text.lower().strip()\n        best: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None\n        best_score = 0\n        for r in rows:\n            trigger = (r[\"trigger_text\"] or \"\").lower().strip()\n            if not trigger:\n                continue\n            score = self._trigger_score(text_lower, trigger)\n            if score > best_score:\n                best_score = score\n                d = dict(r)\n                d[\"plan\"] = json.loads(d.pop(\"plan_json\")) if d.get(\"plan_json\") else []\n                best = d\n        if best is not None:\n            await self._bump_template_usage(best[\"id\"])\n        return best\n\n    async def record_template_use(self, template_id: str) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Increment use_count and update last_used_at.\"\"\"\n        await self._bump_template_usage(template_id)\n\n    async def _bump_template_usage(self, template_id: str) -> None:\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                UPDATE workflow_templates\n                SET use_count = use_count + 1, last_used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n                WHERE id = ?\n                \"\"\",\n                (template_id,),\n            )\n            await db.commit()\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _trigger_score(text: str, trigger: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Simple word-overlap score between user text and trigger.\"\"\"\n        text_words = set(text.split())\n        trigger_words = set(trigger.split())\n        if not trigger_words:\n            return 0\n        overlap = len(text_words & trigger_words)\n        return overlap\n"}
