{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\observability\\tracer.py","content":"\"\"\"Observability - structured trace events for replay and debugging.\n\nEvery meaningful step in the agent pipeline emits a trace event.\nEvents are persisted to the trace_events table and can be replayed\nto reconstruct what happened during a task.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\nfrom app.db.database import db_session\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass Tracer:\n    \"\"\"Lightweight structured event recorder.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._enabled = True\n\n    async def event(\n        self,\n        event_type: str,\n        task_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        node_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        skill_id: Optional[str] = None,\n        payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,\n        duration_ms: Optional[int] = None,\n    ) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Record a trace event.\"\"\"\n        if not self._enabled:\n            return 0\n        try:\n            async with db_session() as db:\n                cur = await db.execute(\n                    \"\"\"\n                    INSERT INTO trace_events (\n                        task_id, node_id, skill_id, event_type, payload_json, duration_ms\n                    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n                    \"\"\",\n                    (\n                        task_id,\n                        node_id,\n                        skill_id,\n                        event_type,\n                        json.dumps(payload, default=str) if payload else None,\n                        duration_ms,\n                    ),\n                )\n                await db.commit()\n                return cur.lastrowid or 0\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            logger.debug(\"Tracer event failed: %s\", exc)\n            return 0\n\n    async def trace_task(self, task_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Return all events for a task grouped by type.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                SELECT id, event_type, node_id, skill_id, payload_json, duration_ms, created_at\n                FROM trace_events WHERE task_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC\n                \"\"\",\n                (task_id,),\n            )\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n        events = []\n        for r in rows:\n            d = dict(r)\n            if d.get(\"payload_json\"):\n                try:\n                    d[\"payload\"] = json.loads(d.pop(\"payload_json\"))\n                except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                    d[\"payload\"] = None\n            events.append(d)\n        return {\n            \"task_id\": task_id,\n            \"event_count\": len(events),\n            \"events\": events,\n        }\n\n    async def recent_events(self, limit: int = 100) -> list:\n        \"\"\"Return recent events across all tasks.\"\"\"\n        async with db_session() as db:\n            cur = await db.execute(\n                \"\"\"\n                SELECT id, task_id, event_type, skill_id, created_at\n                FROM trace_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?\n                \"\"\",\n                (max(1, min(limit, 500)),),\n            )\n            rows = await cur.fetchall()\n            return [dict(r) for r in rows]\n\n    def disable(self) -> None:\n        self._enabled = False\n\n    def enable(self) -> None:\n        self._enabled = True\n"}

Seed into a fresh registry\n    registry2 = SkillRegistry()\n    registry2.invalidate_cache()\n    seeded = await seed_mvp_skills(registry2)\n    if seeded != 50:\n        failures.append(f\"seed_mvp_skills should seed 50, got {seeded}\")\n    all_skills = await registry2.list(enabled_only=False)\n    if len(all_skills) != 50:\n        failures.append(f\"after seed, registry should have 50, got {len(all_skills)}\")\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Task graph\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    executor = TaskGraphExecutor(registry2, engine)\n    task = await executor.create_task(\n        \"echo-twice\",\n        [\n            {\n                \"id\": \"n1\",\n                \"node_type\": \"act\",\n                \"skill_id\": \"meta.echo\",\n                \"inputs\": {\"text\": \"first\"},\n            },\n            {\n                \"id\": \"n2\",\n                \"node_type\": \"act\",\n                \"skill_id\": \"meta.echo\",\n                \"depends_on\": [\"n1\"],\n                \"inputs\": {\"text\": \"second\"},\n            },\n        ],\n    )\n    ctx = {\"skill_runtime\": runtime}\n    task = await executor.run(task, ctx)\n    if task.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED:\n        failures.append(f\"task should complete: {task.status} {task.error}\")\n    if task.nodes[0].outputs.get(\"echo\") != \"first\":\n        failures.append(\"node n1 wrong output\")\n    if task.nodes[1].outputs.get(\"echo\") != \"second\":\n        failures.append(\"node n2 wrong output\")\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Memory engine\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    mem = MemoryEngine()\n    await mem.remember(\"fact\", \"user_name\", \"Alice\")\n    entry = await mem.recall(\"fact\", \"user_name\")\n    if entry is None or entry[\"value\"] != \"Alice\":\n        failures.append(\"memory.remember/recall failed\")\n    await mem.save_template(\n        \"tpl-echo\",\n        \"Echo template\",\n        [{\"node_type\": \"act\", \"skill_id\": \"meta.echo\", \"inputs\": {\"text\": \"hi\"}}],\n        trigger_text=\"say hi\",\n    )\n    matched = await mem.match_template(\"please say hi to everyone\")\n    if matched is None or matched[\"id\"] != \"tpl-echo\":\n        failures.append(\"memory.match_template failed\")\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Tracer\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    tracer = Tracer()\n    eid = await tracer.event(\"plan\", task_id=task.id, payload={\"x\": 1})\n    if eid <= 0:\n        failures.append(\"tracer.event failed\")\n    trace = await tracer.trace_task(task.id)\n    if trace[\"event_count\"] < 1:\n        failures.append(\"tracer.trace_task returned no events\")\n\n    await close_db()\n    if failures:\n        print(\"FAILURES:\")\n        for f in failures:\n            print(f\"  - {f}\")\n        return 1\n    print(\"All new-spec tests passed.\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(asyncio.run(_run()))\n"}

## Summary

The Screen-AI backend now has a formal **skill registry, DAG task executor, layered verification engine, persistent memory engine, and structured tracer** layered on top of the existing pipeline.

### New Modules (12 files)

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `app/skills/contracts.py` | Pydantic types: `SkillDefinition`, `SkillInputSpec`, `SkillOutputSpec`, `SkillVerificationSpec`, `SkillPermission`, `SkillStatus`, `SkillRunRequest`, `SkillRunResult` |
| `app/skills/registry.py` | SQLite-backed `SkillRegistry`: register, get, list, search, enable, delete, record_run, metrics, recent_runs |
| `app/skills/verification.py` | `VerificationEngine` with 8 built-in verifiers: file_exists, file_contains, http_status, json_path, process_healthy, ocr_text, dom_state, screenshot_diff |
| `app/skills/runtime.py` | `SkillRuntime`: handler resolution, retry, timeout, verification, metrics recording |
| `app/skills/handlers.py` | Async wrappers around existing tools (20 handlers) |
| `app/skills/mvp_pack.py` | 50-skill MVP pack across 6 domains |
| `app/agent/task_graph.py` | DAG executor with 7 node types: observe, decide, act, verify, rollback, ask_user, summarize |
| `app/agent/memory_engine.py` | `MemoryEngine`: remember, recall, search, forget, workflow templates |
| `app/observability/tracer.py` | `Tracer`: structured trace events for replay and debugging |

### New DB Tables (13)

`skills`, `skill_inputs`, `skill_outputs`, `skill_dependencies`, `skill_verification_methods`, `skill_permissions`, `skill_runs`, `skill_metrics`, `tasks`, `task_nodes`, `evidence`, `workflow_templates`, `memory_entries`, `trace_events`

### New REST Endpoints (13)

`GET /skills`, `POST /skills/execute`, `GET /skills/{id}/metrics`, `POST /tasks`, `GET /tasks/{id}`, `POST /tasks/{id}/cancel`, `POST /memory/remember`, `GET /memory/recall`, `GET /memory/search`, `POST /workflows`, `GET /workflows`, `GET /workflows/match`

### Verification

```powershell
python -u .\ai_pc_operator\backend\test_new_spec.py
# All new-spec tests passed.

python -u .\ai_pc_operator\backend\test_basic.py
# All tests passed! [ok]
```

### Key Implementation Notes

- **Pydantic v2**: All `BaseModel` constructors use keyword arguments (`SkillInputSpec(name="x", type="string")`)
- **SQL bindings**: The `record_run` metrics INSERT has 5 `?` in VALUES + 3 `?` in ON CONFLICT = 8 bindings total
- **MVP seeding**: The 50-skill pack is seeded once on startup; subsequent boots are idempotent
- **DAG nodes**: Tasks can be `observe`, `decide`, `act`, `verify`, `rollback`, `ask_user`, or `summarize`
- **Memory**: Entries support tags for filtered recall
- **Workflows**: Templates match by keyword overlap with incoming commands

'wss:' : 'ws:';\n\n    // ─── Event Bus ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    // Lightweight pub/sub so UI components can react to API events\n    // without tight coupling.\n    const listeners = new Map();\n\n    function on(event, handler) {\n        if (!listeners.has(event)) listeners.set(event, new Set());\n        listeners.get(event).add(handler);\n        return () => listeners.get(event).delete(handler);\n    }\n\n    function emit(event, payload) {\n        const set = listeners.get(event);\n        if (!set) return;\n        for (const handler of set) {\n            try { handler(payload); } catch (e) { console.warn(`[api] listener for ${event} threw:`, e); }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ─── Token + Device State ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n    const tokenStore = {\n        get deviceId() { return sessionStorage.getItem('device_id') || null; },\n        get token() { return sessionStorage.getItem('token') || null; },\n        get devicePublicKey() { return localStorage.getItem('device_public_key') || null; },\n        get trustUntil() { return localStorage.getItem('trust_until') || null; },\n        get lastDeviceId() { return localStorage.getItem('last_device_id') || null; },\n        set(deviceId, token, publicKey, trustUntil) {\n            if (deviceId) sessionStorage.setItem('device_id', deviceId);\n            if (token) sessionStorage.setItem('token', token);\n            if (deviceId) localStorage.setItem('last_device_id', deviceId);\n            if (publicKey) localStorage.setItem('device_public_key', publicKey);\n            if (trustUntil) localStorage.setItem('trust_until', trustUntil);\n            emit('session:changed', { deviceId, token });\n        },\n        clear() {\n            sessionStorage.removeItem('device_id');\n            sessionStorage.removeItem('token');\n            localStorage.removeItem('last_device_id');\n            localStorage.removeItem('device_public_key');\n            localStorage.removeItem('trust_until');\n            emit('session:cleared', null);\n        },\n        hasSession() {\n            return !!(sessionStorage.getItem('device_id') && sessionStorage.getItem('token'));\n        },\n    };\n\n    // ─── HTTP Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    async function request(path, options = {}) {\n        const url = path.startsWith('http') ? path : `${API_BASE}${path}`;\n        const headers = {\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n            ...(options.headers || {}),\n        };\n        if (tokenStore.token && !options.skipAuth) {\n            headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${tokenStore.token}`;\n        }\n\n        const controller = new AbortController();\n        const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 30000;\n        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);\n\n        try {\n            const response = await fetch(url, {\n                ...options,\n                headers,\n                signal: controller.signal,\n            });\n            clearTimeout(timer);\n\n            const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';\n            const isJson = contentType.includes('application/json');\n            const data = isJson ? await response.json() : await response.text();\n\n            if (!response.ok) {\n                const error = new Error(\n                    (data && data.detail) || response.statusText || `HTTP ${response.status}`\n                );\n                error.status = response.status;\n                error.data = ## Summary

The Screen-AI mobile remote frontend has been completely redesigned with a proper JS architecture. All work is complete and verified.

### What was built

**New JS modules (no direct fetch/prompt calls):**

| File | Size | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| `api.js` | 19 KB | Centralized HTTP/WebSocket client covering all 31 backend endpoints |
| `ui.js` | 11 KB | Theme manager, toast notifications, modal dialogs, DOM helpers |
| `app.js` | 40 KB | Refactored to use `ScreenAI.api` and `ScreenAI.ui` instead of direct calls |

**Updated files:**

- `styles.css` (37 KB) — Modern design with dark/light/midnight themes, glassmorphism, gradient accents
- `index.html` (9 KB) — Theme toggle button, toast/modal containers, script tags for new modules

### Key improvements

1. **No more direct `fetch()`** — All HTTP calls go through `api.pairing.*`, `api.commands.*`, `api.approvals.*`, etc.
2. **No more `alert()`/`confirm()`/`prompt()`** — Replaced with `ui.toast()`, `ui.confirm()`, `ui.prompt()` (Promise-based, customizable)
3. **No more raw WebSocket code** — `ws.connect()`, `ws.onMessage()`, `events.on('ws:state')` handle connection state
4. **No more localStorage token juggling** — `session` module manages `deviceId`, `token`, `devicePublicKey`, `trustUntil`
5. **Theme switching** — Three themes (dark/light/midnight) with no-flash inline script
6. **All existing features preserved** — PWA, Service Worker, Web Worker, IndexedDB, command memory, plan preview, history search, approvals, emergency stop, token rotation, QR scanner, trusted device reconnect

### Verification

- ✅ All three JS files pass `node --check` syntax validation
- ✅ `index.html` correctly references `api.js`, `ui.js`, `app.js` in order
- ✅ Theme toggle, toast container, and modal container are present in HTML
- ✅ No features were removed or shrunk — only the implementation was modernized

Pairing...', 'info');\n\n        await api.pairing.completeQRSession(payload.pid, device.getName(), true);\n\n        setStatus('qr-status', 'Paired successfully. Draft saved locally; reconnect and press Send again.';\n            responseDiv.textContent = offlineText;\n            if (workingMessage) workingMessage.querySelector('.message-text').textContent = offlineText;\n            scrollChatToBottom();\n        } else {\n            renderProgress([\n                { label: 'Command received from phone', status: 'success' },\n                { label: `Network error after ${elapsed}ms`, status: 'failed' },\n            ]);\n            const errorText = 'Error: ' + error.message;\n            responseDiv.textContent = errorText;\n            if (workingMessage) workingMessage.querySelector('.message-text').textContent = errorText;\n            scrollChatToBottom();\n            toast(`Command failed: ${error.message}`, 'error');\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nasync function previewCurrentCommand() {\n    const input = $('#command-text');\n    const text = input?.value.trim();\n    if (!text || !session.deviceId || !session.token) {\n        renderPlanPreview(null);\n        return;\n    }\n    renderLocalRouteHint(text);\n    if (!navigator.onLine) {\n        renderPlanPreview({ status: 'offline', message: 'Offline. 'mobile approval needed' : 'no approval needed',\n        `${data.step_count || 0} step(s)`,\n    ].forEach((label, index) => {\n        const chip = el('span', {\n            class: `plan-chip ${index === 1 ? riskClass : ''}`,\n            text: label,\n        });\n        meta.appendChild(chip);\n    });\n    box.appendChild(meta);\n    appendText(box, 'div', data.message || 'Plan preview ready.');\n    if (data.plan) {\n        const pre = el('pre', { text: JSON.stringify(data.plan, null, 2) });\n        box.appendChild(pre);\n    }\n    if (data.model_plan) {\n        const plan = data.model_plan;\n        const modelBox = el('div', { class: 'model-route' });\n        appendText(modelBox, 'div', 'Model route', 'memory-title');\n        const chips = el('div', { class: 'meta' });\n        [\n            `budget: ${plan.budget_mode || 'auto'}`,\n            `model MB: ${plan.model_budget_mb || 0}`,\n            ...(plan.recommended || []).slice(0, 6).map(name => `model: ${name}`),\n        ].forEach(label => {\n            const chip = el('span', { class: 'plan-chip', text: label });\n            chips.appendChild(chip);\n        });\n        modelBox.appendChild(chips);\n        (plan.lanes || []).forEach(lane => {\n            const laneModels = (lane.models || []).join(' + ');\n            const row = el('div', {\n                class: 'progress-step pending',\n                text: `${lane.lane || 'lane'}: ${laneModels} (${lane.mode || 'auto'})`,\n            });\n            modelBox.appendChild(row);\n        });\n        if (plan.teacher_fallback) {\n            appendText(\n                modelBox,\n                'div',\n                `Teacher fallback: ${plan.teacher_fallback.enabled_by_default ? run(name, ctx) {\n    const pipeline = this.get(name);\n    if (!pipeline) throw new Error(`Pipeline not found: ${name}`);\n    return pipeline.run(ctx);\n  }\n}\n\n// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// EXPORTS\n// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\nmodule.exports = {\n  // requireMiddleware,\n  requireVars,\n  tolerateErrors,\n  metricsMiddleware,\n};\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\graph_schema.py","content":"\"\"\"Execution-graph schema for the planning-engine layer.\n\nThis module mirrors the Node.js planning-engine schema in\n``pipeline/operations.js`` so the Python backend can produce and consume\nthe same execution-graph format.\n\nNode types:\n    observe, decide, parallel, act, verify, retry, rollback,\n    checkpoint, approval, wait, replan, finish\n\nRisk levels (0-4):\n    0 = read-only\n    1 = safe local\n    2 = local destructive\n    3 = external communication\n    4 = financial / credentials / security / irreversible\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\n\n# ─── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nNODE_TYPES = frozenset({\n    \"observe\",\n    \"decide\",\n    \"parallel\",\n    \"act\",\n    \"verify\",\n    \"retry\",\n    \"rollback\",\n    \"checkpoint\",\n    \"approval\",\n    \"wait\",\n    \"replan\",\n    \"finish\",\n})\n\nRISK_LEVELS = {\n    \"READ_ONLY\": 0,\n    \"SAFE_LOCAL\": 1,\n    \"LOCAL_DESTRUCTIVE\": 2,\n    \"EXTERNAL\": 3,\n    \"CRITICAL\": 4,\n}\n\n# Risk threshold above which an approval node must be inserted upstream.\nAPPROVAL_REQUIRED_RISK = 3\n\n\n# ─── Data classes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n@dataclass\nclass VerificationSpec:\n    method: str\n    success: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, str]:\n        return {\"method\": self.method, \"success\": self.success}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ExecutionNode:\n    id: str\n    type: str\n    objective: str\n    reason: str = \"\"\n    preferred_skill: Optional[str] = None\n    alternative_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    dependencies: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    expected_result: str = \"\"\n    verification: VerificationSpec = field(default_factory=lambda: VerificationSpec(method=\"always\", success=\"true\"))\n    failure_conditions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    recovery: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    risk: int = 1\n    estimated_duration: int = 5\n    confidence: float = 0.8\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        if self.type not in NODE_TYPES:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Invalid node type: {self.type}\")\n        if not self.id:\n            raise ValueError(\"Node must have an id\")\n        if not self.objective:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Node {self.id} must have an objective\")\n        if not self.verification.method:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Node {self.id} must have verification.method\")\n        if not self.recovery:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Node {self.id} must have at least one recovery option\")\n        if self.risk < 0 or self.risk > 4:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Node {self.id}: risk must be 0-4\")\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        d = asdict(self)\n        d[\"verification\"] = self.verification.to_dict()\n        return d\n\n\n# ─── Builder helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef build_node(spec: Dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutionNode:\n    \"\"\"Build an ExecutionNode from a dict spec.\"\"\"\n    verification = spec.get(\"verification\") or {}\n    if isinstance(verification, dict):\n        verification = VerificationSpec(\n            method=verification.get(\"method\", \"always\"),\n            success=verification.get(\"success\", \"\"),\n        )\n    return ExecutionNode(\n        id=spec[\"id\"],\n        type=spec[\"type\"],\n        objective=spec[\"objective\"],\n        reason=spec.get(\"reason\", \"\"),\n        preferred_skill=spec.get(\"preferred_skill\"),\n        alternative_skills=list(spec.get(\"alternative_skills\", [])),\n        dependencies=list(spec.get(\"dependencies\", [])),\n        parameters=dict(spec.get(\"parameters\", {})),\n        expected_result=spec.get(\"expected_result\", \"\"),\n        verification=verification,\n        failure_conditions=list(spec.get(\"failure_conditions\", [])),\n        recovery=list(spec.get(\"recovery\", [])),\n        risk=int(spec.get(\"risk\", 1)),\n        estimated_duration=int(spec.get(\"estimated_duration\", 5)),\n        confidence=float(spec.get(\"confidence\", 0.8)),\n    )\n\n\ndef validate_node(node_or_graph) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Validate a single node or a list of nodes.\n\n    Returns ``{\"ok\": bool, \"errors\": [str, ...]}``.\n    \"\"\"\n    errors: List[str] = []\n    nodes = node_or_graph if isinstance(node_or_graph, list) else [node_or_graph]\n\n    for node in nodes:\n        if not isinstance(node, dict):\n            errors.append(\"node is not a dict\")\n            continue\n        if node.get(\"type\") not in NODE_TYPES:\n            errors.append(f\"node {node.get('id', '?')}: invalid type {node.get('type')}\")\n        if not node.get(\"id\"):\n            errors.append(\"node missing id\")\n        if not node.get(\"objective\"):\n            errors.append(f\"node {node.get('id', '?')}: missing objective\")\n        v = node.get(\"verification\") or {}\n        if not v.get(\"method\"):\n            errors.append(f\"node {node.get('id', '?')}: missing verification.method\")\n        if not node.get(\"recovery\"):\n            errors.append(f\"node {node.get('id', '?')}: missing recovery[]\")\n        risk = node.get(\"risk\", 0)\n        if isinstance(risk, int) and (risk < 0 or risk > 4):\n            errors.append(f\"node {node.get('id', '?')}: risk must be 0-4\")\n\n    if isinstance(node_or_graph, list) and len(node_or_graph) > 1:\n        ids = set()\n        for n in node_or_graph:\n            if n.get(\"id\") in ids:\n                errors.append(f\"duplicate node id: {n.get('id')}\")\n            ids.add(n.get(\"id\"))\n        for n in node_or_graph:\n            for dep in n.get(\"dependencies\", []) or []:\n                if dep not in ids:\n                    errors.append(f\"node {n.get('id')}: unknown dependency {dep}\")\n        # High-risk nodes must have an upstream approval node\n        for n in node_or_graph:\n            if (n.get(\"risk\") or 0) >= APPROVAL_REQUIRED_RISK:\n                deps = n.get(\"dependencies\", []) or []\n                has_approval_dep = any(\n                    (m.get(\"id\") in deps and m.get(\"type\") == \"approval\")\n                    for m in node_or_graph\n                )\n                if not has_approval_dep:\n                    errors.append(\n                        f\"node {n.get('id')}: risk {n.get('risk')} requires an upstream approval node\"\n                    )\n\n    return {\"ok\": not errors, \"errors\": errors}\n\n\ndef insert_approval_nodes(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Auto-insert approval nodes before any high-risk action.\"\"\"\n    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n    next_id = max(\n        (int(str(n.get(\"id\", \"0\")).replace(\"auto_approval_\", \"\").replace(\"node_\", \"\") or 0)\n         for n in nodes),\n        default=0,\n    ) + 1\n\n    for node in nodes:\n        if (node.get(\"risk\") or 0) >= APPROVAL_REQUIRED_RISK:\n            approval_id = f\"auto_approval_{next_id}\"\n            next_id += 1\n            approval = {\n                \"id\": approval_id,\n                \"type\": \"approval\",\n                \"objective\": f\"Request mobile approval for {node.get('objective')}\",\n                \"reason\": f\"Auto-inserted because node {node.get('id')} has risk {node.get('risk')} >= {APPROVAL_REQUIRED_RISK}\",\n                \"preferred_skill\": \"approvals.manager.create_approval\",\n                \"alternative_skills\": [\"approvals.manager.wait_for_approval\"],\n                \"dependencies\": list(node.get(\"dependencies\", []) or []),\n                \"parameters\": {\n                    \"risk_level\": node.get(\"risk\"),\n                    \"action_type\": node.get(\"objective\"),\n                },\n                \"expected_result\": \"User approves or rejects the action\",\n                \"verification\": {\"method\": \"approval_resolved\", \"success\": \"approval status is approved\"},\n                \"recovery\": [\n                    \"If rejected, return rejected status to caller\",\n                    \"If timeout, abort the downstream action\",\n                ],\n                \"risk\": RISK_LEVELS[\"READ_ONLY\"],\n                \"estimated_duration\": 30,\n                \"confidence\": 0.95,\n            }\n            out.append(approval)\n            node[\"dependencies\"] = list(node.get(\"dependencies\", []) or []) + [approval_id]\n        out.append(node)\n    return out\n\n\n# ─── Plan → graph conversion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef plan_to_graph(plan: Dict[str, Any], risk_level: int = 1) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Convert a legacy plan (with ``steps``) into an execution graph.\n\n    Each step becomes an ``act`` node. If the plan's risk is >= 3, an\n    approval node is auto-inserted upstream.\n    \"\"\"\n    steps = plan.get(\"steps\", []) or []\n    nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n\n    # Observe node — captures the plan intent\n    nodes.append({\n        \"id\": \"observe_plan\",\n        \"type\": \"observe\",\n        \"objective\": f\"Interpret plan: {plan.get('intent', 'unknown')}\",\n        \"preferred_skill\": \"agent.planner\",\n        \"parameters\": {\"plan\": plan},\n        \"expected_result\": \"Plan interpretation\",\n        \"verification\": {\"method\": \"returns_object\", \"success\": \"plan has steps\"},\n        \"recovery\": [\"Use empty plan\", \"Ask user for clarification\"],\n        \"risk\": 0,\n        \"estimated_duration\": 1,\n        \"confidence\": 0.95,\n    })\n\n    # Act nodes — one per step\n    for i, step in enumerate(steps):\n        tool = step.get(\"tool\", f\"step_{i}\")\n        nodes.append({\n            \"id\": f\"act_{i}_{tool.replace('.', '_')}\",\n            \"type\": \"act\",\n            \"objective\": f\"Execute {tool}\",\n            \"preferred_skill\": tool,\n            \"dependencies\": [\"observe_plan\"] if i == 0 else [f\"act_{i - 1}_{steps[i - 1].get('tool', f'step_{i - 1}').replace('.', '_')}\"],\n            \"parameters\": step.get(\"args\", {}),\n            \"expected_result\": f\"{tool} succeeded\",\n            \"verification\": {\"method\": \"tool_success\", \"success\": \"result.status == success\"},\n            \"recovery\": [\n                \"Retry once\",\n                \"Use alternative skill\",\n                \"Report failure to user\",\n            ],\n            \"risk\": int(step.get(\"risk\", risk_level)),\n            \"estimated_duration\": int(step.get(\"estimated_duration\", 5)),\n            \"confidence\": float(step.get(\"confidence\", 0.85)),\n        })\n\n    # Verify node — checks all steps succeeded\n    if steps:\n        last_id = f\"act_{len(steps) - 1}_{steps[-1].get('tool', f'step_{len(steps) - 1}').replace('.', '_')}\"\n        nodes.append({\n            \"id\": \"verify_all\",\n            \"type\": \"verify\",\n            \"objective\": \"Verify all steps succeeded\",\n            \"dependencies\": [n[\"id\"] for n in nodes if n[\"type\"] == \"act\"],\n            \"verification\": {\"method\": \"all_success\", \"success\": \"every act node returned success\"},\n            \"recovery\": [\"Re-run failed act node\", \"Report partial success\"],\n            \"risk\": 0,\n            \"estimated_duration\": 1,\n            \"confidence\": 0.95,\n        })\n\n    # Finish node\n    finish_deps = [\"verify_all\"] if steps else [\"observe_plan\"]\n    nodes.append({\n        \"id\": \"finish\",\n        \"type\": \"finish\",\n        \"objective\": \"Plan complete\",\n        \"dependencies\": finish_deps,\n        \"verification\": {\"method\": \"always\", \"success\": \"true\"},\n        \"recovery\": [\"No-op\"],\n        \"risk\": 0,\n        \"estimated_duration\": 0,\n        \"confidence\": 1.0,\n    })\n\n    # Auto-insert approval nodes for high-risk actions\n    nodes = insert_approval_nodes(nodes)\n    return nodes\n\n\ndef graph_to_dict_list(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Return a JSON-serializable list of node dicts.\"\"\"\n    return [dict(n) for n in nodes]\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\engine.js","oldString":"// ─── Pipeline Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nclass PipelineRegistry {\n  constructor() {\n    this.pipelines = new Map();\n  }\n\n  register(name, pipeline) {\n    this.pipelines.set(name, pipeline);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  get(name) {\n    return this.pipelines.get(name);\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.pipelines.keys());\n  }\n\n  async run(name, ctx) {\n    const pipeline = this.get(name);\n    if (!pipeline) throw new Error(`Pipeline not found: ${name}`);\n    return pipeline.run(ctx);\n  }\n}","newString":"// ─── Pipeline Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nclass PipelineRegistry {\n  constructor() {\n    this.pipelines = new Map();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a pipeline. Accepts either (name, pipeline) or (pipeline).\n   * If a pipeline object is passed, its .name property is used as the key.\n   */\n  register(nameOrPipeline, maybePipeline) {\n    if (maybePipeline !== undefined) {\n      this.pipelines.set(nameOrPipeline, maybePipeline);\n    } else if (nameOrPipeline && typeof nameOrPipeline === 'object' && nameOrPipeline.name) {\n      this.pipelines.set(nameOrPipeline.name, nameOrPipeline);\n    } else if (typeof nameOrPipeline === 'string') {\n      // Register a placeholder by name\n      this.pipelines.set(nameOrPipeline, null);\n    }\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  has(name) {\n    return this.pipelines.has(name);\n  }\n\n  get(name) {\n    return this.pipelines.get(name);\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.pipelines.keys());\n  }\n\n  run(name, ctx) {\n    const pipeline = this.get(name);\n    if (!pipeline) throw new Error(`Pipeline not found: ${name}`);\n    return pipeline.run(ctx);\n  }\n\n  runSequence(names, ctx) {\n    const results = [];\n    for (const name of names) {\n      results.push(this.run(name, ctx));\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n}"}

### Test Results

| Test Suite | Result |
|------------|--------|
| `pipeline/test_pipeline.js` | **43/43 passed** |
| `test_basic.py` | **All passed** |

| CLI `validate` sample graph | **✓ Valid (5 nodes)** |

### What Was Implemented

**New Node Types** (12): `observe`, `decide`, `parallel`, `act`, `verify`, `retry`, `rollback`, `checkpoint`, `approval`, `wait`, `replan`, `finish`

**Risk Levels** (5): `READ_ONLY(0)`, `SAFE_LOCAL(1)`, `LOCAL_DESTRUCTIVE(2)`, `EXTERNAL(3)`, `CRITICAL(4)`

**Key Files**:
- [pipeline/operations.js](pipeline/operations.js) — `NODE_TYPES`, `buildNode`, `validateNode`, `insertApprovalNodes`, `OPERATIONS` registry
- [pipeline/engine.js](pipeline/engine.js) — `ExecutionGraphRunner` + fixed legacy `Pipeline` for backward compat
- [pipeline/cli.js](pipeline/cli.js) — `--graph`, `--auto-approve`, `--vars`, `validate` commands
- [pipeline/screenai_pipelines.js](pipeline/screenai_pipelines.js) — graph pipelines (`scaffoldFullGraph`, `backupDatabaseGraph`, `cleanGraph`, `researchCollectGraph`)
- [graph_schema.py](ai_pc_operator/backend/app/agent/graph_schema.py) — Python mirror of planning-engine schema
- [router.py](ai_pc_operator/backend/app/agent/router.py) — `AgentRouter` now emits `execution_graph` in responses

### Key Fixes Applied

1. **Middleware factory detection** — `.use()` now detects factories by arity (0-1 args = factory, 2+ args = direct middleware)
2. **Step name tagging** — step functions tagged with `_stepName` so middleware can access the step name
3. **Default error behavior** — unhandled errors stop the pipeline and store in `ctx.errors` (don't throw)
4. **`ctx.elapsed`** — pipeline now records total elapsed time
5. **Pipeline descriptions** — added descriptions to `scaffold-full`, `build-frontend` for CLI `describe` command

### Auto-Approval Insertion

Any node with `risk >= 3` automatically gets an upstream `approval` node inserted before it, ensuring high-risk actions always have a gate.

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\graph_schema.py","oldString":"def insert_approval_nodes(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Auto-insert approval nodes before any high-risk action.\"\"\"\n    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n    next_id = max(\n        (int(str(n.get(\"id\", \"0\")).replace(\"auto_approval_\", \"\").replace(\"node_\", \"\") or 0)\n         for n in nodes),\n        default=0,\n    ) + 1","newString":"def insert_approval_nodes(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Auto-insert approval nodes before any high-risk action.\"\"\"\n    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []\n    # Find the highest numeric suffix in existing auto_approval_/node_ IDs\n    next_id = 0\n    for n in nodes:\n        nid = str(n.get(\"id\", \"\"))\n        for prefix in (\"auto_approval_\", \"node_\"):\n            if nid.startswith(prefix):\n                try:\n                    next_id = max(next_id, int(nid[len(prefix):]))\n                except ValueError:\n                    pass\n    next_id += 1"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\registry.js","content":"/**\n * core/registry.js — Pipeline Registry\n *\n * Central in-memory store for pipeline definitions.\n * Supports registration, lookup, listing, namespacing, and metadata.\n *\n * Design:\n *   - Pipelines are stored by name (string) in a Map.\n *   - Each entry holds { pipeline, meta } where meta is arbitrary metadata.\n *   - Namespaces are supported via \"namespace:name\" keys.\n *   - Lookup is O(1) via Map.\n *   - Iteration order is insertion order (Map semantics).\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nclass PipelineRegistry {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this._pipelines = new Map();\n    this._aliases = new Map();\n    this._tags = new Map(); // tag -> Set<name>\n    this._listeners = new Set();\n    this._frozen = !!opts.frozen;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a pipeline.\n   * @param {string} name - pipeline name (may include \"namespace:name\")\n   * @param {Object} pipeline - pipeline definition (must have .name or be a function)\n   * @param {Object} [meta] - optional metadata { description, tags, version, ... }\n   * @returns {PipelineRegistry} this\n   */\n  register(name, pipeline, meta = {}) {\n    if (this._frozen) {\n      throw new Error('PipelineRegistry is frozen');\n    }\n    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) {\n      throw new TypeError('Pipeline name must be a non-empty string');\n    }\n    if (pipeline === null || pipeline === undefined) {\n      throw new TypeError(`Pipeline \"${name}\" cannot be null/undefined`);\n    }\n\n    const entry = {\n      pipeline,\n      meta: {\n        name,\n        description: meta.description || '',\n        tags: Array.isArray(meta.tags) ? [...meta.tags] : [],\n        version: meta.version || '1.0.0',\n        registeredAt: Date.now(),\n        ...meta,\n      },\n    };\n\n    this._pipelines.set(name, entry);\n\n    // Index tags\n    for (const tag of entry.meta.tags) {\n      if (!this._tags.has(tag)) this._tags.set(tag, new Set());\n      this._tags.get(tag).add(name);\n    }\n\n    this._emit({ type: 'register', name, meta: entry.meta });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register an alias that points to another pipeline name.\n   */\n  alias(aliasName, targetName) {\n    if (!this._pipelines.has(targetName)) {\n      throw new Error(`Cannot alias unknown pipeline: ${targetName}`);\n    }\n    this._aliases.set(aliasName, targetName);\n    this._emit({ type: 'alias', alias: aliasName, target: targetName });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if a pipeline (or alias) exists.\n   */\n  has(name) {\n    return this._pipelines.has(name) || this._aliases.has(name);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a pipeline by name. Follows aliases.\n   * @returns {{ pipeline: *, meta: Object } | null}\n   */\n  get(name) {\n    if (this._pipelines.has(name)) {\n      return this._pipelines.get(name);\n    }\n    if (this._aliases.has(name)) {\n      const target = this._aliases.get(name);\n      return this._pipelines.get(target) || null;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List all registered pipeline names.\n   */\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this._pipelines.keys());\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List pipelines filtered by tag.\n   */\n  listByTag(tag) {\n    const set = this._tags.get(tag);\n    return set ? Array.from(set) : [];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List all aliases.\n   */\n  listAliases() {\n    return Array.from(this._aliases.entries()).map(([alias, target]) => ({ alias, target }));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Remove a pipeline.\n   */\n  unregister(name) {\n    const entry = this._pipelines.get(name);\n    if (!entry) return false;\n    for (const tag of entry.meta.tags || []) {\n      const set = this._tags.get(tag);\n      if (set) {\n        set.delete(name);\n        if (set.size === 0) this._tags.delete(tag);\n      }\n    }\n    this._pipelines.delete(name);\n    this._emit({ type: 'unregister', name });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear all pipelines.\n   */\n  clear() {\n    this._pipelines.clear();\n    this._aliases.clear();\n    this._tags.clear();\n    this._emit({ type: 'clear' });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Freeze the registry — no further registrations allowed.\n   */\n  freeze() {\n    this._frozen = true;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to registry events.\n   */\n  on(listener) {\n    this._listeners.add(listener);\n    return () => this._listeners.delete(listener);\n  }\n\n  _emit(event) {\n    for (const fn of this._listeners) {\n      try { fn(event); } catch (_) { /* swallow listener errors */ }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a snapshot of the registry state.\n   */\n  snapshot() {\n    return {\n      count: this._pipelines.size,\n      pipelines: Array.from(this._pipelines.entries()).map(([name, entry]) => ({\n        name,\n        meta: { ...entry.meta },\n      })),\n      aliases: this.listAliases(),\n      tags: Array.from(this._tags.entries()).map(([tag, set]) => ({ tag, count: set.size })),\n      frozen: this._frozen,\n    };\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = PipelineRegistry;\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\loader.js","content":"/**\n * core/loader.js — Pipeline Loader\n *\n * Loads pipeline definitions from disk (JSON files, JS modules) and registers\n * them into a PipelineRegistry.\n *\n * Supported sources:\n *   - Single JSON file: { name, steps, ... }\n *   - Single JS module: exports a pipeline object or factory function\n *   - Directory: scans for *.pipeline.json / *.pipeline.js files\n *   - Inline definition: passed directly to load()\n *\n * Loader is intentionally simple — it does not execute pipelines, only\n * parses and registers them. Execution is the Executor's job.\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nclass PipelineLoader {\n  constructor(registry, opts = {}) {\n    if (!registry) throw new TypeError('PipelineLoader requires a PipelineRegistry');\n    this.registry = registry;\n    this.opts = {\n      extensions: opts.extensions || ['.pipeline.json', '.pipeline.js', '.json', '.js'],\n      recursive: opts.recursive !== false,\n      validate: opts.validate !== false,\n      logger: opts.logger || null,\n    };\n    this._loaded = []; // history of loaded sources\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single file or inline definition.\n   * @param {string|Object} source - file path or inline definition\n   * @returns {Array<string>} names of registered pipelines\n   */\n  load(source) {\n    if (source === null || source === undefined) {\n      throw new TypeError('load() requires a source');\n    }\n\n    if (typeof source === 'object') {\n      return this._loadInline(source);\n    }\n\n    if (typeof source !== 'string') {\n      throw new TypeError('load() source must be a string path or object');\n    }\n\n    const stat = fs.existsSync(source) ? fs.statSync(source) : null;\n    if (!stat) {\n      throw new Error(`Pipeline source not found: ${source}`);\n    }\n\n    if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n      return this.loadDirectory(source);\n    }\n\n    return this._loadFile(source);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load all pipeline files from a directory.\n   */\n  loadDirectory(dir) {\n    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n      throw new Error(`Directory not found: ${dir}`);\n    }\n    const names = [];\n    const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });\n    for (const entry of entries) {\n      const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);\n      if (entry.isDirectory() && this.opts.recursive) {\n        names.push(...this.loadDirectory(full));\n      } else if (entry.isFile()) {\n        const ext = path.extname(entry.name);\n        if (this.opts.extensions.includes(ext)) {\n          try {\n            names.push(...this._loadFile(full));\n          } catch (e) {\n            this._log('error', `Failed to load ${full}: ${e.message}`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return names;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single file by path.\n   */\n  _loadFile(filePath) {\n    const ext = path.extname(filePath);\n    let defs;\n    if (ext === '.json') {\n      const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');\n      defs = JSON.parse(raw);\n    } else if (ext === '.js') {\n      // Clear require cache so re-loading picks up edits\n      delete require.cache[require.resolve(filePath)];\n      const mod = require(filePath);\n      defs = mod.default || mod.pipeline || mod;\n    } else {\n      throw new Error(`Unsupported pipeline file extension: ${ext}`);\n    }\n\n    const names = this._registerDefinitions(defs, filePath);\n    this._loaded.push({ source: filePath, names, at: Date.now() });\n    return names;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load an inline definition (object or array of objects).\n   */\n  _loadInline(def) {\n    const names = this._registerDefinitions(def, '<inline>');\n    this._loaded.push({ source: '<inline>', names, at: Date.now() });\n    return names;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalize and register one or more definitions.\n   * Accepts: single object, array of objects, or { pipelines: [...] } wrapper.\n   */\n  _registerDefinitions(def, source) {\n    let list;\n    if (Array.isArray(def)) {\n      list = def;\n    } else if (def && Array.isArray(def.pipelines)) {\n      list = def.pipelines;\n    } else if (def && (def.name || def.steps || def.nodes)) {\n      list = [def];\n    } else {\n      throw new Error(`Invalid pipeline definition in ${source}`);\n    }\n\n    const names = [];\n    for (const p of list) {\n      if (this.opts.validate) this._validate(p, source);\n      const name = p.name || `pipeline_${names.length + 1}`;\n      this.registry.register(name, p, {\n        description: p.description || '',\n        tags: p.tags || [],\n        version: p.version || '1.0.0',\n        source,\n      });\n      names.push(name);\n    }\n    return names;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Lightweight structural validation.\n   */\n  _validate(p, source) {\n    if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') {\n      throw new Error(`Pipeline in ${source} is not an object`);\n    }\n    if (!p.name && !p.steps && !p.nodes) {\n      throw new Error(`Pipeline in ${source} must have name, steps, or nodes`);\n    }\n    if (p.steps && !Array.isArray(p.steps)) {\n      throw new Error(`Pipeline \"${p.name}\" steps must be an array`);\n    }\n    if (p.nodes && !Array.isArray(p.nodes)) {\n      throw new Error(`Pipeline \"${p.name}\" nodes must be an array`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the load history.\n   */\n  history() {\n    return [...this._loaded];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear load history.\n   */\n  clearHistory() {\n    this._loaded = [];\n  }\n\n  _log(level, msg) {\n    if (this.opts.logger && typeof this.opts.logger[level] === 'function') {\n      this.opts.logger[level](msg);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = PipelineLoader;\n"}

Holds:\n *   - vars: arbitrary key/value bag (inputs, intermediate state)\n *   - results: per-step/node results keyed by id\n *   - log: ordered list of log entries\n *   - errors: collected errors\n *   - metrics: timing and counters\n *   - checkpoints: snapshots for rollback\n *   - meta: pipeline-level metadata (name, startedAt, ...)\n *\n * Context is passed by reference but exposes a snapshot() method for\n * safe serialization. Mutations are tracked so the executor can decide\n * whether to checkpoint.\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nclass PipelineContext {\n  constructor(initial = {}) {\n    this.vars = initial.vars || {};\n    this.results = initial.results || {};\n    this.log = initial.log || [];\n    this.errors = initial.errors || [];\n    this.metrics = initial.metrics || this._defaultMetrics();\n    this.checkpoints = initial.checkpoints || [];\n    this.meta = initial.meta || this._defaultMeta();\n    this._frozen = false;\n  }\n\n  _defaultMetrics() {\n    return {\n      totalMs: 0,\n      steps: 0,\n      succeeded: 0,\n      failed: 0,\n      retried: 0,\n      rolledBack: 0,\n      perStep: {},\n    };\n  }\n\n  _defaultMeta() {\n    return {\n      pipelineName: null,\n      startedAt: Date.now(),\n      finishedAt: null,\n      status: 'pending', // pending | running | completed | failed | cancelled\n      dryRun: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set a variable.\n   */\n  set(key, value) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.vars[key] = value;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a variable with optional default.\n   */\n  get(key, defaultValue) {\n    return this.vars[key] !== undefined ? this.vars[key] : defaultValue;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if a variable exists.\n   */\n  has(key) {\n    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.vars, key);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Delete a variable.\n   */\n  unset(key) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    delete this.vars[key];\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Merge multiple variables at once.\n   */\n  mergeVars(obj) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    Object.assign(this.vars, obj);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record a step/node result.\n   */\n  setResult(id, result) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.results[id] = result;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a step/node result.\n   */\n  getResult(id) {\n    return this.results[id];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Append a log entry.\n   */\n  log_(level, message, data) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.log.push({\n      level,\n      message,\n      data: data || null,\n      at: Date.now(),\n    });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record an error.\n   */\n  addError(stepName, error) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.errors.push({\n      step: stepName,\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : null,\n      at: Date.now(),\n    });\n    this.metrics.failed += 1;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record a successful step.\n   */\n  recordSuccess(stepName, elapsedMs) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.metrics.succeeded += 1;\n    this.metrics.perStep[stepName] = elapsedMs;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record a retry.\n   */\n  recordRetry(stepName) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.metrics.retried += 1;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record a rollback.\n   */\n  recordRollback(checkpointId) {\n    this._assertMutable();\n    this.metrics.rolledBack += 1;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Save a checkpoint snapshot.\n   */\n  checkpoint(label) {\n    const snap = this.snapshot();\n    snap.label = label || `cp_${this.checkpoints.length + 1}`;\n    snap.id = `cp_${Date.now()}_${this.checkpoints.length}`;\n    this.checkpoints.push(snap);\n    return snap.id;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Restore from a checkpoint by id.\n   */\n  restore(checkpointId) {\n    const cp = this.checkpoints.find(c => c.id === checkpointId);\n    if (!cp) throw new Error(`Checkpoint not found: ${checkpointId}`);\n    this.vars = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cp.vars));\n    this.results = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cp.results));\n    this.log = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cp.log));\n    this.errors = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cp.errors));\n    this.metrics = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cp.metrics));\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Mark the context as finished.\n   */\n  finish(status) {\n    this.meta.finishedAt = Date.now();\n    this.meta.status = status || 'completed';\n    this.metrics.totalMs = this.meta.finishedAt - this.meta.startedAt;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Freeze the context — no further mutations allowed.\n   */\n  freeze() {\n    this._frozen = true;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _assertMutable() {\n    if (this._frozen) {\n      throw new Error('PipelineContext is frozen');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Take a deep-cloned snapshot of the context.\n   */\n  snapshot() {\n    return {\n      vars: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.vars)),\n      results: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.results)),\n      log: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.log)),\n      errors: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.errors)),\n      metrics: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.metrics)),\n      checkpoints: this.checkpoints.map(c => ({ id: c.id, label: c.label, at: c.at })),\n      meta: { ...this.meta },\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Serialize to a plain JSON string.\n   */\n  toJSON() {\n    return JSON.stringify(this.snapshot());\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = PipelineContext;\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\event_bus.js","content":"/**\n * core/event_bus.js — Event Bus\n *\n * A typed pub/sub bus for pipeline events. Unlike Node's EventEmitter,\n * this bus:\n *   - Supports namespaced event names (\"pipeline.start\", \"step.complete\")\n *   - Supports wildcard subscriptions (\"pipeline.*\", \"*\")\n *   - Supports async listeners (awaits each one)\n *   - Buffers events when no listeners are attached (optional)\n *   - Records a history of recent events for debugging\n *\n * The bus is intentionally decoupled from any specific pipeline so that\n * the Logger, Retry Manager, Rollback Manager, and Executor can all\n * publish/subscribe without coupling.\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nclass EventBus {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this._listeners = new Map(); // event -> Set<fn>\n    this._wildcardListeners = new Set();\n    this._history = [];\n    this._maxHistory = opts.maxHistory || 500;\n    this._buffer = opts.buffer === true;\n    this._buffered = [];\n    this._maxBuffer = opts.maxBuffer || 100;\n    this._async = opts.async !== false; // await listeners by default\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to an event or pattern.\n   * Pattern may end with \".*\" for namespace match, or be \"*\" for all events.\n   * Returns an unsubscribe function.\n   */\n  on(pattern, listener) {\n    if (typeof pattern !== 'string') throw new TypeError('pattern must be a string');\n    if (typeof listener !== 'function') throw new TypeError('listener must be a function');\n\n    if (pattern === '*') {\n      this._wildcardListeners.add(listener);\n      return () => this._wildcardListeners.delete(listener);\n    }\n\n    if (pattern.endsWith('.*')) {\n      const ns = pattern.slice(0, -2);\n      const wrapped = (event) => {\n        if (event.type && event.type.startsWith(ns + '.') || event.type === ns) {\n          return listener(event);\n        }\n      };\n      this._wildcardListeners.add(wrapped);\n      return () => this._wildcardListeners.delete(wrapped);\n    }\n\n    if (!this._listeners.has(pattern)) this._listeners.set(pattern, new Set());\n    this._listeners.get(pattern).add(listener);\n    return () => {\n      const set = this._listeners.get(pattern);\n      if (set) set.delete(listener);\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Subscribe to a single occurrence, then auto-unsubscribe.\n   */\n  once(pattern, listener) {\n    const off = this.on(pattern, (event) => {\n      off();\n      return listener(event);\n    });\n    return off;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Publish an event.\n   * @param {string} type - event type (e.g. \"pipeline.start\")\n   * @param {Object} [payload] - event data\n   */\n  async emit(type, payload = {}) {\n    const event = {\n      type,\n      payload,\n      at: Date.now(),\n      id: `evt_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n    };\n\n    // Record in history\n    this._history.push(event);\n    if (this._history.length > this._maxHistory) {\n      this._history.shift();\n    }\n\n    // Buffer if no listeners and buffering is enabled\n    const hasExact = this._listeners.has(type) && this._listeners.get(type).size > 0;\n    const hasWild = this._wildcardListeners.size > 0;\n    if (!hasExact && !hasWild && this._buffer) {\n      this._buffered.push(event);\n      if (this._buffered.length > this._maxBuffer) this._buffered.shift();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Notify exact listeners\n    const exact = this._listeners.get(type);\n    if (exact) {\n      for (const fn of exact) {\n        try {\n          const r = fn(event);\n          if (this._async && r && typeof r.then === 'function') await r;\n        } catch (e) {\n          // Listener errors must not break the bus\n          // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n          console.error(`[EventBus] listener error for ${type}:`, e.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Notify wildcard listeners\n    for (const fn of this._wildcardListeners) {\n      try {\n        const r = fn(event);\n        if (this._async && r && typeof r.then === 'function') await r;\n      } catch (e) {\n        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n        console.error(`[EventBus] wildcard listener error:`, e.message);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Synchronous emit (does not await listeners).\n   */\n  emitSync(type, payload = {}) {\n    const event = { type, payload, at: Date.now() };\n    this._history.push(event);\n    if (this._history.length > this._maxHistory) this._history.shift();\n\n    const exact = this._listeners.get(type);\n    if (exact) {\n      for (const fn of exact) {\n        try { fn(event); } catch (_) { /* swallow */ }\n      }\n    }\n    for (const fn of this._wildcardListeners) {\n      try { fn(event); } catch (_) { /* swallow */ }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Drain buffered events (replay them to current listeners).\n   */\n  async drainBuffer() {\n    const buffered = this._buffered.slice();\n    this._buffered = [];\n    for (const event of buffered) {\n      await this.emit(event.type, event.payload);\n    }\n    return buffered.length;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get recent event history.\n   */\n  history(limit) {\n    if (limit && limit > 0) return this._history.slice(-limit);\n    return [...this._history];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Clear all listeners and history.\n   */\n  clear() {\n    this._listeners.clear();\n    this._wildcardListeners.clear();\n    this._history = [];\n    this._buffered = [];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Count listeners for a pattern.\n   */\n  listenerCount(pattern) {\n    if (pattern === '*') return this._wildcardListeners.size;\n    return (this._listeners.get(pattern) || new Set()).size;\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = EventBus;\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\logger.js","content":"/**\n * core/logger.js — Logger\n *\n * Structured logger for pipeline execution. Supports:\n *   - Levels: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal\n *   - Multiple sinks: console, file, memory ring buffer, custom\n *   - Per-pipeline child loggers with inherited config\n *   - Structured fields (timestamp, level, pipeline, step, ...)\n *   - Level filtering\n *\n * The Logger is decoupled from console so tests can capture output\n * without polluting stdout.\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nconst LEVELS = Object.freeze({\n  TRACE: 10,\n  DEBUG: 20,\n  INFO: 30,\n  WARN: 40,\n  ERROR: 50,\n  FATAL: 60,\n});\n\nconst LEVEL_NAMES = Object.freeze({\n  10: 'trace', 20: 'debug', 30: 'info', 40: 'warn', 50: 'error', 60: 'fatal',\n});\n\nclass Logger {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this.level = LEVELS[opts.level?.toUpperCase()] || LEVELS.INFO;\n    this.sinks = [];\n    this.fields = opts.fields || {};\n    this._children = new Map();\n\n    // Default sinks\n    if (opts.console !== false) {\n      this.addSink(new ConsoleSink(opts.consoleOpts || {}));\n    }\n    if (opts.file) {\n      this.addSink(new FileSink(opts.file));\n    }\n    if (opts.memory !== false) {\n      this.addSink(new MemorySink(opts.memorySize || 500));\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Add a sink.\n   */\n  addSink(sink) {\n    if (!sink || typeof sink.write !== 'function') {\n      throw new TypeError('Sink must implement write(entry)');\n    }\n    this.sinks.push(sink);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Remove a sink.\n   */\n  removeSink(sink) {\n    const i = this.sinks.indexOf(sink);\n    if (i >= 0) {\n      this.sinks.splice(i, 1);\n      return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a child logger with additional fields.\n   */\n  child(fields) {\n    const child = new Logger({\n      console: false,\n      memory: false,\n      level: LEVEL_NAMES[this.level],\n    });\n    child.fields = { ...this.fields, ...fields };\n    child.sinks = this.sinks.slice(); // share sinks\n    child._parent = this;\n    return child;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set log level.\n   */\n  setLevel(level) {\n    this.level = typeof level === 'string' ? LEVELS[level.toUpperCase()] : level;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Log at a specific level.\n   */\n  log(level, message, data = {}) {\n    const lvl = typeof level === 'string' ? LEVELS[level.toUpperCase()] : level;\n    if (lvl < this.level) return;\n\n    const entry = {\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      level: LEVEL_NAMES[lvl] || String(lvl),\n      levelValue: lvl,\n      message,\n      ...this.fields,\n      ...data,\n    };\n\n    for (const sink of this.sinks) {\n      try {\n        sink.write(entry);\n      } catch (e) {\n        // Sink errors must not break logging\n        // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n        console.error('[Logger] sink error:', e.message);\n      }\n    }\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  trace(msg, data) { return this.log('trace', msg, data); }\n  debug(msg, data) { return this.log('debug', msg, data); }\n  info(msg, data)  { return this.log('info',  msg, data); }\n  warn(msg, data)  { return this.log('warn',  msg, data); }\n  error(msg, data) { return this.log('error', msg, data); }\n  fatal(msg, data) { return this.log('fatal', msg, data); }\n}\n\n// ─── Sinks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nclass ConsoleSink {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this.colors = opts.colors !== false;\n    this.stderrLevels = new Set(['warn', 'error', 'fatal']);\n  }\n  write(entry) {\n    const line = this._format(entry);\n    if (this.stderrLevels.has(entry.level)) {\n      process.stderr.write(line + '\\n');\n    } else {\n      process.stdout.write(line + '\\n');\n    }\n  }\n  _format(entry) {\n    if (!this.colors) {\n      return `${entry.timestamp} ${entry.level.toUpperCase().padEnd(5)} ${entry.message}`;\n    }\n    const colors = {\n      trace: '\\x1b[90m', debug: '\\x1b[36m', info: '\\x1b[32m',\n      warn: '\\x1b[33m', error: '\\x1b[31m', fatal: '\\x1b[35m',\n    };\n    const reset = '\\x1b[0m';\n    const c = colors[entry.level] || '';\n    return `${entry.timestamp} ${c}${entry.level.toUpperCase().padEnd(5)}${reset} ${entry.message}`;\n  }\n}\n\nclass FileSink {\n  constructor(filePath) {\n    this.path = filePath;\n    this._dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n    if (!fs.existsSync(this._dir)) fs.mkdirSync(this._dir, { recursive: true });\n    this._stream = fs.createWriteStream(filePath, { flags: 'a' });\n  }\n  write(entry) {\n    this._stream.write(JSON.stringify(entry) + '\\n');\n  }\n  close() {\n    return new Promise(resolve => this._stream.end(resolve));\n  }\n}\n\nclass MemorySink {\n  constructor(maxSize = 500) {\n    this.maxSize = maxSize;\n    this.entries = [];\n  }\n  write(entry) {\n    this.entries.push(entry);\n    if (this.entries.length > this.maxSize) this.entries.shift();\n  }\n  /** Get recent entries, optionally filtered by level. */\n  recent(limit, level) {\n    let filtered = this.entries;\n    if (level) {\n      const minLevel = LEVELS[level.toUpperCase()] || 0;\n      filtered = filtered.filter(e => e.levelValue >= minLevel);\n    }\n    if (limit && limit > 0) return filtered.slice(-limit);\n    return filtered.slice();\n  }\n  clear() {\n    this.entries = [];\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = Logger;\nmodule.exports.LEVELS = LEVELS;\nmodule.exports.LEVEL_NAMES = LEVEL_NAMES;\nmodule.exports.ConsoleSink = ConsoleSink;\nmodule.exports.FileSink = FileSink;\nmodule.exports.MemorySink = MemorySink;\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\dependency_resolver.js","content":"/**\n * core/dependency_resolver.js — Dependency Resolver\n *\n * Resolves execution order for nodes/steps based on declared dependencies.\n * Produces a topological ordering and groups nodes into execution waves\n * (parallel branches).\n *\n * Features:\n *   - Topological sort with cycle detection\n *   - Wave grouping (nodes whose deps are all in earlier waves run together)\n *   - Optional priority ordering within a wave\n *   - Optional critical-path highlighting\n *   - Validation of dependency references\n *\n * Pure functions — no side effects, no I/O.\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nclass DependencyResolver {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this.strict = opts.strict !== false; // throw on unknown deps\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Topologically sort nodes by dependencies.\n   * @param {Array} nodes - each must have { id, dependencies? }\n   * @returns {Array} nodes in execution order\n   */\n  topoSort(nodes) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) throw new TypeError('nodes must be an array');\n    const byId = new Map();\n    for (const n of nodes) {\n      if (!n || !n.id) throw new Error('Each node must have an id');\n      byId.set(n.id, n);\n    }\n\n    const visited = new Set();\n    const visiting = new Set();\n    const order = [];\n\n    const visit = (id, path) => {\n      if (visited.has(id)) return;\n      if (visiting.has(id)) {\n        throw new Error(`Cycle detected: ${path.join(' -> ')} -> ${id}`);\n      }\n      const node = byId.get(id);\n      if (!node) {\n        if (this.strict) throw new Error(`Unknown node id: ${id}`);\n        return;\n      }\n      visiting.add(id);\n      for (const dep of node.dependencies || []) {\n        visit(dep, [...path, id]);\n      }\n      visiting.delete(id);\n      visited.add(id);\n      order.push(node);\n    };\n\n    for (const node of nodes) {\n      visit(node.id, []);\n    }\n    return order;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Group nodes into execution waves.\n   * Each wave contains nodes whose dependencies are all in earlier waves.\n   * @returns {Array<Array>} waves\n   */\n  buildWaves(nodes) {\n    const byId = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));\n    const remaining = new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));\n    const waves = [];\n\n    while (remaining.size > 0) {\n      const wave = [];\n      for (const id of remaining) {\n        const node = byId.get(id);\n        const deps = node.dependencies || [];\n        const ready = deps.every(d => !remaining.has(d));\n        if (ready) wave.push(node);\n      }\n      if (wave.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('No nodes ready — possible cycle in execution graph');\n      }\n\n      // Sort within wave by priority (lower number = higher priority)\n      wave.sort((a, b) => (a.priority || 0) - (b.priority || 0));\n      waves.push(wave);\n      for (const n of wave) remaining.delete(n.id);\n    }\n    return waves;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate that all dependency references exist.\n   */\n  validate(nodes) {\n    const errors = [];\n    const ids = new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));\n    for (const n of nodes) {\n      for (const dep of n.dependencies || []) {\n        if (!ids.has(dep)) {\n          errors.push(`Node \"${n.id}\" depends on unknown node \"${dep}\"`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return { ok: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Detect cycles and return the cycle path if found.\n   */\n  detectCycles(nodes) {\n    const byId = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));\n    const WHITE = 0, GRAY = 1, BLACK = 2;\n    const color = new Map();\n    const parent = new Map();\n\n    for (const n of nodes) color.set(n.id, WHITE);\n\n    const dfs = (id, path) => {\n      color.set(id, GRAY);\n      const node = byId.get(id);\n      if (!node) return null;\n      for (const dep of node.dependencies || []) {\n        if (!byId.has(dep)) continue;\n        if (color.get(dep) === GRAY) {\n          // Found cycle — reconstruct path\n          const cyclePath = [dep, id];\n          let cur = id;\n          while (parent.has(cur) && parent.get(cur) !== dep) {\n            cur = parent.get(cur);\n            cyclePath.push(cur);\n          }\n          cyclePath.reverse();\n          return cyclePath;\n        }\n        if (color.get(dep) === WHITE) {\n          parent.set(dep, id);\n          const found = dfs(dep, [...path, id]);\n          if (found) return found;\n        }\n      }\n      color.set(id, BLACK);\n      return null;\n    };\n\n    for (const n of nodes) {\n      if (color.get(n.id) === WHITE) {\n        const cycle = dfs(n.id, []);\n        if (cycle) return cycle;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Compute the critical path (longest dependency chain).\n   */\n  criticalPath(nodes) {\n    const byId = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));\n    const dist = new Map();\n    const order = this.topoSort(nodes);\n\n    for (const n of order) {\n      const deps = n.dependencies || [];\n      const maxDepDist = deps.length === 0\n        ? 0\n        : Math.max(...deps.map(d => dist.get(d) || 0));\n      dist.set(n.id, maxDepDist + (n.estimated_duration || 1));\n    }\n\n    // Find the node with max distance\n    let endNode = null;\n    let maxDist = -1;\n    for (const [id, d] of dist) {\n      if (d > maxDist) {\n        maxDist = d;\n        endNode = id;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Reconstruct path\n    const path = [];\n    let cur = endNode;\n    while (cur) {\n      path.unshift(cur);\n      const node = byId.get(cur);\n      const deps = (node && node.dependencies) || [];\n      if (deps.length === 0) break;\n      cur = deps.reduce((a, b) => (dist.get(a) || 0) >= (dist.get(b) || 0) ? a : b);\n    }\n    return { path, totalDuration: maxDist };\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = DependencyResolver;\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\core\\retry_manager.js","content":"/**\n * core/retry_manager.js — Retry Manager\n *\n * Wraps a step/node handler with retry logic.\n *\n * Features:\n *   - Configurable max attempts\n *   - Exponential backoff with jitter\n *   - Custom retry predicate (decide which errors are retryable)\n *   - Per-attempt timeout\n *   - Records each attempt in the context\n *   - Emits retry events on the event bus\n *\n * Pure orchestration — does not execute steps itself; the Executor\n * calls into RetryManager.runWithRetry().\n */\n\n'use strict';\n\nclass RetryManager {\n  constructor(opts = {}) {\n    this.defaultMaxAttempts = opts.maxAttempts || 3;\n    this.defaultBackoffMs = opts.backoffMs || 100;\n    this.defaultBackoffMultiplier = opts.backoffMultiplier || 2;\n    this.defaultMaxBackoffMs = opts.maxBackoffMs || 30000;\n    this.defaultJitter = opts.jitter !== false;\n    this.defaultTimeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs || 0; // 0 = no timeout\n    this.eventBus = opts.eventBus || null;\n    this.logger = opts.logger || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Run a handler with retry logic.\n   *\n   * @param {Function} handler - async (ctx) => result\n   * @param {Object} opts\n   * @param {string} opts.name - step/node name (for logging)\n   * @param {number} [opts.maxAttempts]\n   * @param {number} [opts.backoffMs]\n   * @param {number} [opts.backoffMultiplier]\n   * @param {number} [opts.maxBackoffMs]\n   * @param {boolean} [opts.jitter]\n   * @param {number} [opts.timeoutMs]\n   * @param {Function} [opts.shouldRetry] - (error, attempt) => bool\n   * @param {Object} opts.ctx - PipelineContext\n   * @returns {Promise<{ result: *, attempts: number, errors: Array }>}\n   */\n  async runWithRetry(handler, opts) {\n    if (typeof handler !== 'function') {\n      throw new TypeError('handler must be a function');\n    }\n    const name = opts.name || 'anonymous';\n    const maxAttempts = opts.maxAttempts || this.defaultMaxAttempts;\n    const backoffMs = opts.backoffMs || this.defaultBackoffMs;\n    const multiplier = opts.backoffMultiplier || this.defaultBackoffMultiplier;\n    const maxBackoff = opts.maxBackoffMs || this.defaultMaxBackoffMs;\n    const jitter = opts.jitter !== undefined ? opts.jitter : this.defaultJitter;\n    const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs || this.defaultTimeoutMs;\n    const shouldRetry = opts.shouldRetry || ((err) => true);\n    const ctx = opts.ctx;\n\n    const errors = [];\n    let attempt = 0;\n    let lastResult = null;\n\n    while (attempt < maxAttempts) {\n      attempt += 1;\n      const startedAt = Date.now();\n\n      try {\n        const result = timeoutMs > 0\n          ? await this._withTimeout(handler(ctx), timeoutMs, name, attempt)\n          : await handler(ctx);\n\n        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;\n        if (ctx) ctx.recordSuccess(name, elapsed);\n\n        if (attempt > 1) {\n          this._log('info', `${name} succeeded on attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}`);\n          this._emit('retry.success', { name, attempt, elapsed });\n        }\n        return { result, attempts: attempt, errors };\n      } catch (err) {\n        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;\n        const errorInfo = {\n          attempt,\n          message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err),\n          stack: err && err.stack ? err.stack : null,\n          elapsed,\n          at: Date.now(),\n        };\n        errors.push(errorInfo);\n\n        this._log('warn', `${name} failed on attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}: ${errorInfo.message}`);\n        this._emit('retry.attempt', { name, attempt, error: errorInfo });\n\n        if (ctx) ctx.recordRetry(name);\n\n        const retryable = shouldRetry(err, attempt);\n        if (!retryable || attempt >= maxAttempts) {\n          this._log('error', `${name} giving up after ${attempt} attempts`);\n          this._emit('retry.exhausted', { name, attempts: attempt, errors });\n          return { result: null, attempts: attempt, errors };\n        }\n\n        // Compute backoff\n        const delay = this._computeBackoff(attempt, backoffMs, multiplier, maxBackoff, jitter);\n        this._log('debug', `${name} backing off ${delay}ms before retry`);\n        await this._sleep(delay);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { result: lastResult, attempts: attempt, errors };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Compute backoff delay with optional jitter.\n   */\n  _computeBackoff(attempt, base, multiplier, max, jitter) {\n    const exp = base * Math.pow(multiplier, attempt - 1);\n    const capped = Math.min(exp, max);\n    if (!jitter) return capped;\n    // Full jitter: random between 0 and capped\n    return Math.floor(Math.random() * capped);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Wrap a promise with a timeout.\n   */\n  _withTimeout(promise, ms, name, attempt) {\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n        reject(new Error(`${name} timed out after ${ms}ms (attempt ${attempt})`));\n      }, ms);\n      promise.then(\n        (v) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(v); },\n        (e) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(e); }\n      );\n    });\n  }\n\n  _sleep(ms) {\n    return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));\n  }\n\n  _log(level, msg) {\n    if (this.logger && typeof this.logger[level] === 'function') {\n      this.logger[level](msg);\n    }\n  }\n\n  _emit(type, payload) {\n    if (this.eventBus && typeof this.eventBus.emitSync === 'function') {\n      this.eventBus.emitSync(type, payload);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = RetryManager;\n"}
