{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\pipeline_selector.py","content":"\"\"\"Pipeline Selector — chooses the right execution pipeline for a task set.\n\nA pipeline is a named execution strategy. Different intents benefit from\ndifferent pipelines:\n\n  - \"sequential\": tasks run one after another (default)\n  - \"approval-gated\": pauses for approval before risky tasks\n  - \"verify-each\": verifies each task before continuing\n  - \"best-effort\": continues even if optional tasks fail\n  - \"research\": multi-site research with text extraction\n  - \"interactive\": pauses for user input between steps\n\nThe selector picks based on:\n  - Intent type\n  - Risk level\n  - Whether approval is required\n  - Whether the goal is reversible\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom .task_decomposer import Task\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PipelineSpec:\n    \"\"\"Specification for an execution pipeline.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    strategy: str  # \"sequential\" | \"approval-gated\" | \"verify-each\" | \"best-effort\" | \"research\" | \"interactive\"\n    description: str\n    config: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    applicable_intents: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"name\": self.name,\n            \"strategy\": self.strategy,\n            \"description\": self.description,\n            \"config\": self.config,\n            \"applicable_intents\": self.applicable_intents,\n        }\n\n\nclass PipelineSelector:\n    \"\"\"Selects the right pipeline for a task set.\"\"\"\n\n    PIPELINES = {\n        \"sequential\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"sequential\",\n            strategy=\"sequential\",\n            description=\"Run tasks one after another, stop on first failure\",\n            config={\"stop_on_failure\": True},\n            applicable_intents=[\"open_app\", \"list_files\", \"system_status\"],\n        ),\n        \"approval-gated\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"approval-gated\",\n            strategy=\"approval-gated\",\n            description=\"Pause for approval before risky tasks\",\n            config={\"approval_before\": [\"delete\", \"quarantine\", \"credential\", \"download\"]},\n            applicable_intents=[\"delete_files\", \"login\", \"download_file\"],\n        ),\n        \"verify-each\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"verify-each\",\n            strategy=\"verify-each\",\n            description=\"Verify each task result before continuing\",\n            config={\"verify_after_each\": True},\n            applicable_intents=[\"screen_click\", \"open_website\"],\n        ),\n        \"best-effort\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"best-effort\",\n            strategy=\"best-effort\",\n            description=\"Continue even if optional tasks fail\",\n            config={\"continue_on_optional_failure\": True},\n            applicable_intents=[\"browser_session\"],\n        ),\n        \"research\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"research\",\n            strategy=\"research\",\n            description=\"Multi-site research with text extraction\",\n            config={\"max_sites\": 10, \"extract_text\": True, \"save_report\": True},\n            applicable_intents=[\"research_collect\"],\n        ),\n        \"interactive\": PipelineSpec(\n            name=\"interactive\",\n            strategy=\"interactive\",\n            description=\"Pause for user input between steps\",\n            config={\"pause_between_steps\": True},\n            applicable_intents=[\"login\"],\n        ),\n    }\n\n    def select(\n        self,\n        intent: str,\n        tasks: List[Task],\n        risk_level: int = 0,\n        requires_approval: bool = False,\n    ) -> PipelineSpec:\n        \"\"\"Select the best pipeline for the given intent and tasks.\"\"\"\n        # 1. Check intent-specific pipelines first\n        for pipeline in self.PIPELINES.values():\n            if intent in pipeline.applicable_intents:\n                return pipeline\n\n        # 2. If approval is required, use approval-gated\n        if requires_approval:\n            return self.PIPELINES[\"approval-gated\"]\n\n        # 3. If risk is high, use verify-each\n        if risk_level >= 3:\n            return self.PIPELINES[\"verify-each\"]\n\n        # 4. If any task is optional, use best-effort\n        if any(t.optional for t in tasks):\n            return self.PIPELINES[\"best-effort\"]\n\n        # 5. Default to sequential\n        return self.PIPELINES[\"sequential\"]\n\n    def list_pipelines(self) -> List[str]:\n        \"\"\"List all available pipeline names.\"\"\"\n        return list(self.PIPELINES.keys())\n\n    def get_pipeline(self, name: str) -> Optional[PipelineSpec]:\n        \"\"\"Get a pipeline by name.\"\"\"\n        return self.PIPELINES.get(name)\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\dependency_graph.py","content":"\"\"\"Dependency Graph — builds and validates a DAG of tasks.\n\nThe graph:\n  - Nodes are tasks\n  - Edges are dependencies (task A depends on task B)\n  - Topological sort produces a valid execution order\n  - Cycle detection prevents invalid graphs\n  - Wave grouping identifies tasks that can run in parallel\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple\n\nfrom .task_decomposer import Task\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GraphNode:\n    \"\"\"A node in the dependency graph.\"\"\"\n    task: Task\n    dependencies: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)\n    dependents: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"task\": self.task.to_dict(),\n            \"dependencies\": list(self.dependencies),\n            \"dependents\": list(self.dependents),\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GraphValidation:\n    \"\"\"Result of graph validation.\"\"\"\n    valid: bool\n    errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    warnings: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    cycles: List[List[str]] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"valid\": self.valid,\n            \"errors\": self.errors,\n            \"warnings\": self.warnings,\n            \"cycles\": self.cycles,\n        }\n\n\nclass DependencyGraph:\n    \"\"\"A DAG of tasks with dependency tracking.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.nodes: Dict[str, GraphNode] = {}\n        self._task_index: Dict[str, Task] = {}\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_tasks(cls, tasks: List[Task]) -> \"DependencyGraph\":\n        \"\"\"Build a graph from a list of tasks.\"\"\"\n        graph = cls()\n        for task in tasks:\n            graph.add_task(task)\n        return graph\n\n    def add_task(self, task: Task) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Add a task to the graph.\"\"\"\n        node = GraphNode(task=task, dependencies=set(task.depends_on))\n        self.nodes[task.id] = node\n        self._task_index[task.id] = task\n        # Update dependents of dependencies\n        for dep_id in task.depends_on:\n            if dep_id in self.nodes:\n                self.nodes[dep_id].dependents.add(task.id)\n\n    def validate(self) -> GraphValidation:\n        \"\"\"Validate the graph for cycles and missing dependencies.\"\"\"\n        result = GraphValidation(valid=True)\n\n        # Check for missing dependencies\n        for task_id, node in self.nodes.items():\n            for dep_id in node.dependencies:\n                if dep_id not in self.nodes:\n                    result.errors.append(\n                        f\"Task {task_id} depends on missing task {dep_id}\"\n                    )\n                    result.valid = False\n\n        # Check for cycles\n        cycles = self._detect_cycles()\n        if cycles:\n            result.cycles = cycles\n            result.errors.append(f\"Found {len(cycles)} cycle(s)\")\n            result.valid = False\n\n        # Warnings\n        if not self.nodes:\n            result.warnings.append(\"Empty graph\")\n\n        # Check for orphaned tasks (no dependents and no dependencies)\n        for task_id, node in self.nodes.items():\n            if not node.dependencies and not node.dependents:\n                result.warnings.append(f\"Task {task_id} is isolated\")\n\n        return result\n\n    def topological_sort(self) -> List[str]:\n        \"\"\"Return tasks in topological order.\"\"\"\n        # Kahn's algorithm\n        in_degree = {tid: len(node.dependencies) for tid, node in self.nodes.items()}\n        queue = [tid for tid, deg in in_degree.items() if deg == 0]\n        result: List[str] = []\n\n        while queue:\n            # Sort for deterministic order\n            queue.sort()\n            current = queue.pop(0)\n            result.append(current)\n\n            for dependent in self.nodes[current].dependents:\n                in_degree[dependent] -= 1\n                if in_degree[dependent] == 0:\n                    queue.append(dependent)\n\n        return result\n\n    def build_waves(self) -> List[List[str]]:\n        \"\"\"Group tasks into waves (parallel-executable sets).\"\"\"\n        waves: List[List[str]] = []\n        completed: Set[str] = set()\n        remaining = set(self.nodes.keys())\n\n        while remaining:\n            wave = []\n            for task_id in sorted(remaining):\n                node = self.nodes[task_id]\n                if node.dependencies.issubset(completed):\n                    wave.append(task_id)\n            if not wave:\n                # Cycle or invalid graph\n                break\n            waves.append(wave)\n            completed.update(wave)\n            remaining -= set(wave)\n\n        return waves\n\n    def critical_path(self) -> List[str]:\n        \"\"\"Find the longest path through the graph.\"\"\"\n        # Compute longest path using dynamic programming\n        topo = self.topological_sort()\n        if not topo:\n            return []\n\n        # duration = timeout for each task\n        duration = {tid: self.nodes[tid].task.timeout for tid in topo}\n        # longest_to[tid] = (length, path)\n        longest_to: Dict[str, Tuple[float, List[str]]] = {}\n\n        for tid in topo:\n            node = self.nodes[tid]\n            best = (duration[tid], [tid])\n            for dep_id in node.dependencies:\n                if dep_id in longest_to:\n                    candidate = (longest_to[dep_id][0] + duration[tid],\n                                 longest_to[dep_id][1] + [tid])\n                    if candidate[0] > best[0]:\n                        best = candidate\n            longest_to[tid] = best\n\n        # Find the task with the longest total\n        if not longest_to:\n            return []\n        end_tid = max(longest_to.keys(), key=lambda t: longest_to[t][0])\n        return longest_to[end_tid][1]\n\n    def _detect_cycles(self) -> List[List[str]]:\n        \"\"\"Detect cycles using DFS.\"\"\"\n        cycles: List[List[str]] = []\n        WHITE, GRAY, BLACK = 0, 1, 2\n        color = {tid: WHITE for tid in self.nodes}\n        path: List[str] = []\n\n        def dfs(task_id: str) -> None:\n            color[task_id] = GRAY\n            path.append(task_id)\n            for dep_id in self.nodes[task_id].dependencies:\n                if dep_id not in color:\n                    continue\n                if color[dep_id] == GRAY:\n                    # Cycle found\n                    cycle_start = path.index(dep_id)\n                    cycles.append(path[cycle_start:] + [dep_id])\n                elif color[dep_id] == WHITE:\n                    dfs(dep_id)\n            path.pop()\n            color[task_id] = BLACK\n\n        for tid in self.nodes:\n            if color[tid] == WHITE:\n                dfs(tid)\n\n        return cycles\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"nodes\": {tid: node.to_dict() for tid, node in self.nodes.items()},\n            \"topological_order\": self.topological_sort(),\n            \"waves\": self.build_waves(),\n            \"critical_path\": self.critical_path(),\n        }\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\parallel_planner.py","content":"\"\"\"Parallel Planner — identifies which tasks can run in parallel.\n\nUses the dependency graph to find waves of tasks that have no\ninter-dependencies and can be executed concurrently.\n\nAlso considers:\n  - Resource limits (max concurrent tasks)\n  - Risk isolation (don't run risky tasks in parallel with safe ones)\n  - Approval gates (risky tasks must run alone)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set\n\nfrom .task_decomposer import Task\nfrom .dependency_graph import DependencyGraph\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ParallelGroup:\n    \"\"\"A group of tasks that can run in parallel.\"\"\"\n    wave_index: int\n    task_ids: List[str]\n    parallel_safe: bool = True\n    requires_approval: bool = False\n    max_risk: int = 0\n    reason: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"wave_index\": self.wave_index,\n            \"task_ids\": self.task_ids,\n            \"parallel_safe\": self.parallel_safe,\n            \"requires_approval\": self.requires_approval,\n            \"max_risk\": self.max_risk,\n            \"reason\": self.reason,\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ParallelPlan:\n    \"\"\"A parallel execution plan.\"\"\"\n    groups: List[ParallelGroup] = field(default_factory=list)\n    total_waves: int = 0\n    max_concurrency: int = 1\n    estimated_speedup: float = 1.0\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"groups\": [g.to_dict() for g in self.groups],\n            \"total_waves\": self.total_waves,\n            \"max_concurrency\": self.max_concurrency,\n            \"estimated_speedup\": round(self.estimated_speedup, 2),\n        }\n\n\nclass ParallelPlanner:\n    \"\"\"Plans parallel execution of tasks.\"\"\"\n\n    # Tools that should never run in parallel with anything else\n    EXCLUSIVE_TOOLS = {\n        \"approval.request\",\n        \"vault.unlock\",\n        \"system.shutdown\",\n        \"system.restart\",\n    }\n\n    # Tools that are safe to parallelize\n    PARALLEL_SAFE_TOOLS = {\n        \"file.scan\",\n        \"file.list\",\n        \"system.status\",\n        \"browser.verify_loaded\",\n        \"download.verify_source\",\n    }\n\n    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 3):\n        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency\n\n    def plan(self, graph: DependencyGraph) -> ParallelPlan:\n        \"\"\"Build a parallel execution plan from a dependency graph.\"\"\"\n        waves = graph.build_waves()\n        groups: List[ParallelGroup] = []\n\n        for i, wave in enumerate(waves):\n            tasks = [graph.nodes[tid].task for tid in wave]\n            group = self._build_group(i, wave, tasks)\n            groups.append(group)\n\n        # Compute speedup estimate\n        total_tasks = sum(len(g.task_ids) for g in groups)\n        speedup = total_tasks / max(len(groups), 1) if groups else 1.0\n\n        return ParallelPlan(\n            groups=groups,\n            total_waves=len(groups),\n            max_concurrency=self.max_concurrency,\n            estimated_speedup=speedup,\n        )\n\n    def _build_group(\n        self,\n        wave_index: int,\n        task_ids: List[str],\n        tasks: List[Task],\n    ) -> ParallelGroup:\n        \"\"\"Build a parallel group from a wave of tasks.\"\"\"\n        # Check for exclusive tools\n        has_exclusive = any(t.tool in self.EXCLUSIVE_TOOLS for t in tasks)\n        # Check for approval requirement\n        requires_approval = any(t.tool == \"approval.request\" for t in tasks)\n        # Compute max risk (from tool name heuristics)\n        max_risk = max((self._estimate_risk(t.tool) for t in tasks), default=0)\n        # Check parallel safety\n        parallel_safe = (\n            not has_exclusive\n            and not requires_approval\n            and all(t.tool in self.PARALLEL_SAFE_TOOLS or self._is_read_only(t.tool)\n                    for t in tasks)\n        )\n\n        # If wave has more than max_concurrency, split conceptually\n        reason = \"\"\n        if has_exclusive:\n            reason = \"contains_exclusive_tool\"\n        elif requires_approval:\n            reason = \"contains_approval_request\"\n        elif not parallel_safe:\n            reason = \"mixed_risk_levels\"\n        else:\n            reason = \"all_parallel_safe\"\n\n        return ParallelGroup(\n            wave_index=wave_index,\n            task_ids=task_ids,\n            parallel_safe=parallel_safe,\n            requires_approval=requires_approval,\n            max_risk=max_risk,\n            reason=reason,\n        )\n\n    def _estimate_risk(self, tool: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Estimate risk level from tool name.\"\"\"\n        tool_lower = tool.lower()\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"delete\", \"quarantine\", \"shutdown\", \"restart\")):\n            return 4\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"credential\", \"vault\", \"login\", \"download\")):\n            return 3\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"click\", \"type\", \"submit\", \"fill\")):\n            return 2\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"open\", \"navigate\", \"search\")):\n            return 1\n        return 0\n\n    def _is_read_only(self, tool: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Check if a tool is read-only.\"\"\"\n        read_only_keywords = [\"scan\", \"list\", \"status\", \"verify\", \"locate\", \"read\"]\n        return any(k in tool.lower() for k in read_only_keywords)\n"}
```

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\cost_estimator.py","content":"\"\"\"Cost Estimator — estimates the cost of executing a plan.\n\nCosts include:\n  - Time: estimated execution duration\n  - Tokens: LLM tokens for planning/verification\n  - Memory: peak RAM usage\n  - Network: bytes transferred\n  - Risk: aggregate risk score\n  - Reversibility: whether the plan can be undone\n\nThe estimator uses tool-specific cost profiles and the parallel plan\nto compute realistic estimates.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom .task_decomposer import Task\nfrom .parallel_planner import ParallelPlan\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostBreakdown:\n    \"\"\"Detailed cost breakdown.\"\"\"\n    time_seconds: float = 0.0\n    tokens: int = 0\n    memory_mb: float = 0.0\n    network_bytes: int = 0\n    risk_score: float = 0.0\n    reversible: bool = True\n    tool_costs: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"time_seconds\": round(self.time_seconds, 2),\n            \"tokens\": self.tokens,\n            \"memory_mb\": round(self.memory_mb, 2),\n            \"network_bytes\": self.network_bytes,\n            \"risk_score\": round(self.risk_score, 2),\n            \"reversible\": self.reversible,\n            \"tool_costs\": self.tool_costs,\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostEstimate:\n    \"\"\"Total cost estimate for a plan.\"\"\"\n    total: CostBreakdown\n    per_wave: List[CostBreakdown] = field(default_factory=list)\n    confidence: float = 0.7\n    notes: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"total\": self.total.to_dict(),\n            \"per_wave\": [w.to_dict() for w in self.per_wave],\n            \"confidence\": round(self.confidence, 2),\n            \"notes\": self.notes,\n        }\n\n\nclass CostEstimator:\n    \"\"\"Estimates execution cost of a plan.\"\"\"\n\n    # Tool cost profiles\n    TOOL_PROFILES = {\n        \"browser.warmup\": {\"time\": 2.0, \"memory\": 50.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"browser.open\": {\"time\": 5.0, \"memory\": 100.0, \"tokens\": 50, \"network\": 500_000},\n        \"browser.search\": {\"time\": 3.0, \"memory\": 80.0, \"tokens\": 30, \"network\": 200_000},\n        \"browser.verify_loaded\": {\"time\": 1.0, \"memory\": 20.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"browser.submit\": {\"time\": 3.0, \"memory\": 50.0, \"tokens\": 20, \"network\": 100_000},\n        \"system.open_app\": {\"time\": 4.0, \"memory\": 150.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"system.status\": {\"time\": 1.0, \"memory\": 10.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"system.keep_awake\": {\"time\": 0.5, \"memory\": 5.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"system.mouse_jiggle\": {\"time\": 0.5, \"memory\": 5.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"file.list\": {\"time\": 2.0, \"memory\": 30.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"file.scan\": {\"time\": 5.0, \"memory\": 50.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"file.quarantine\": {\"time\": 3.0, \"memory\": 40.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"screen.scan\": {\"time\": 2.0, \"memory\": 80.0, \"tokens\": 100, \"network\": 0},\n        \"screen.locate\": {\"time\": 1.0, \"memory\": 30.0, \"tokens\": 50, \"network\": 0},\n        \"screen.click\": {\"time\": 1.0, \"memory\": 10.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"vault.unlock\": {\"time\": 3.0, \"memory\": 20.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"auth.fill_credentials\": {\"time\": 2.0, \"memory\": 20.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"approval.request\": {\"time\": 30.0, \"memory\": 5.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"download.verify_source\": {\"time\": 1.0, \"memory\": 10.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n        \"download.file\": {\"time\": 30.0, \"memory\": 50.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 5_000_000},\n        \"download.hash\": {\"time\": 2.0, \"memory\": 20.0, \"tokens\": 0, \"network\": 0},\n    }\n\n    DEFAULT_PROFILE = {\"time\": 5.0, \"memory\": 30.0, \"tokens\": 20, \"network\": 0}\n\n    # Risk weights for tools\n    RISK_WEIGHTS = {\n        \"delete\": 4.0, \"quarantine\": 3.0, \"credential\": 4.0,\n        \"vault\": 3.0, \"login\": 3.0, \"download\": 2.0,\n        \"click\": 1.0, \"submit\": 1.5, \"fill\": 1.5,\n        \"open\": 0.5, \"navigate\": 0.5, \"search\": 0.3,\n    }\n\n    def estimate(\n        self,\n        tasks: List[Task],\n        parallel_plan: Optional[ParallelPlan] = None,\n    ) -> CostEstimate:\n        \"\"\"Estimate the cost of executing the given tasks.\"\"\"\n        total = CostBreakdown()\n        per_wave: List[CostBreakdown] = []\n        notes: List[str] = []\n\n        if parallel_plan:\n            # Use parallel plan for wave-based estimation\n            for group in parallel_plan.groups:\n                wave_breakdown = self._estimate_wave(group.task_ids, tasks)\n                per_wave.append(wave_breakdown)\n                # Aggregate (take max for time/memory, sum for tokens/network)\n                total.time_seconds += wave_breakdown.time_seconds\n                total.memory_mb = max(total.memory_mb, wave_breakdown.memory_mb)\n                total.tokens += wave_breakdown.tokens\n                total.network_bytes += wave_breakdown.network_bytes\n                total.risk_score = max(total.risk_score, wave_breakdown.risk_score)\n                total.reversible = total.reversible and wave_breakdown.reversible\n        else:\n            # Sequential estimation\n            for task in tasks:\n                breakdown = self._estimate_task(task)\n                total.time_seconds += breakdown.time_seconds\n                total.memory_mb = max(total.memory_mb, breakdown.memory_mb)\n                total.tokens += breakdown.tokens\n                total.network_bytes += breakdown.network_bytes\n                total.risk_score = max(total.risk_score, breakdown.risk_score)\n                total.reversible = total.reversible and breakdown.reversible\n                total.tool_costs[task.tool] = breakdown.to_dict()\n\n        # Add notes\n        if total.time_seconds > 60:\n            notes.append(\"Long-running plan (>60s)\")\n        if total.risk_score >= 3:\n            notes.append(\"High risk plan\")\n        if not total.reversible:\n            notes.append(\"Plan contains irreversible actions\")\n        if total.memory_mb > 500:\n            notes.append(\"High memory usage (>500MB)\")\n\n        # Confidence based on how many tools we have profiles for\n        known = sum(1 for t in tasks if t.tool in self.TOOL_PROFILES)\n        confidence = known / max(len(tasks), 1) if tasks else 1.0\n\n        return CostEstimate(\n            total=total,\n            per_wave=per_wave,\n            confidence=confidence,\n            notes=notes,\n        )\n\n    def _estimate_wave(self, task_ids: List[str], tasks: List[Task]) -> CostBreakdown:\n        \"\"\"Estimate cost of a wave (parallel group).\"\"\"\n        wave_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.id in task_ids]\n        if not wave_tasks:\n            return CostBreakdown()\n\n        # For parallel: take max time, sum memory/tokens/network\n        breakdown = CostBreakdown()\n        for task in wave_tasks:\n            task_cost = self._estimate_task(task)\n            breakdown.time_seconds = max(breakdown.time_seconds, task_cost.time_seconds)\n            breakdown.memory_mb += task_cost.memory_mb\n            breakdown.tokens += task_cost.tokens\n            breakdown.network_bytes += task_cost.network_bytes\n            breakdown.risk_score = max(breakdown.risk_score, task_cost.risk_score)\n            breakdown.reversible = breakdown.reversible and task_cost.reversible\n            breakdown.tool_costs[task.tool] = task_cost.to_dict()\n        return breakdown\n\n    def _estimate_task(self, task: Task) -> CostBreakdown:\n        \"\"\"Estimate cost of a single task.\"\"\"\n        profile = self.TOOL_PROFILES.get(task.tool, self.DEFAULT_PROFILE)\n        risk = self._estimate_risk(task.tool)\n        reversible = not any(k in task.tool.lower() for k in (\"delete\", \"credential\"))\n\n        return CostBreakdown(\n            time_seconds=profile[\"time\"],\n            memory_mb=profile[\"memory\"],\n            tokens=profile[\"tokens\"],\n            network_bytes=profile[\"network\"],\n            risk_score=risk,\n            reversible=reversible,\n        )\n\n    def _estimate_risk(self, tool: str) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Estimate risk score from tool name.\"\"\"\n        tool_lower = tool.lower()\n        score = 0.0\n        for keyword, weight in self.RISK_WEIGHTS.items():\n            if keyword in tool_lower:\n                score = max(score, weight)\n        return score\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\risk_analyzer.py","content":"\"\"\"Risk Analyzer — analyzes the aggregate risk of a plan.\n\nRisk levels:\n  0 = READ_ONLY         (safe, no approval)\n  1 = SAFE_LOCAL        (local file ops, no approval)\n  2 = LOCAL_DESTRUCTIVE (deletes/moves, may need approval)\n  3 = EXTERNAL          (touches external systems, approval required)\n  4 = CRITICAL          (permanent delete, credentials, financial)\n\nThe analyzer considers:\n  - Tool-level risk\n  - Path sensitivity (system folders, credentials)\n  - URL sensitivity (unknown domains, executables)\n  - Bulk operations\n  - Credential usage\n  - Reversibility\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set\n\nfrom .task_decomposer import Task\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RiskFactor:\n    \"\"\"A single risk factor identified in the plan.\"\"\"\n    category: str\n    description: str\n    severity: int  # 0-4\n    source: str  # which task triggered it\n    mitigation: Optional[str] = None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"category\": self.category,\n            \"description\": self.description,\n            \"severity\": self.severity,\n            \"source\": self.source,\n            \"mitigation\": self.mitigation,\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RiskAnalysis:\n    \"\"\"Complete risk analysis of a plan.\"\"\"\n    level: int  # 0-4\n    score: float  # 0.0-10.0\n    requires_approval: bool\n    factors: List[RiskFactor] = field(default_factory=list)\n    mitigations: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    blocked: bool = False\n    block_reason: Optional[str] = None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"level\": self.level,\n            \"score\": round(self.score, 2),\n            \"requires_approval\": self.requires_approval,\n            \"factors\": [f.to_dict() for f in self.factors],\n            \"mitigations\": self.mitigations,\n            \"blocked\": self.blocked,\n            \"block_reason\": self.block_reason,\n        }\n\n\nclass RiskAnalyzer:\n    \"\"\"Analyzes risk of a plan.\"\"\"\n\n    # Protected paths that always trigger high risk\n    PROTECTED_PATHS = {\n        \"windows\", \"program files\", \"program files (x86)\",\n        \"appdata\", \"system32\", \"boot\", \"recovery\",\n    }\n\n    # Dangerous file extensions\n    DANGEROUS_EXTENSIONS = {\n        \".exe\", \".msi\", \".bat\", \".cmd\", \".ps1\", \".vbs\",\n        \".scr\", \".jar\", \".js\", \".hta\",\n    }\n\n    # Trusted domains (lower risk)\n    TRUSTED_DOMAINS = {\n        \"google.com\", \"microsoft.com\", \"github.com\",\n        \"wikipedia.org\", \"youtube.com\",\n    }\n\n    # Tools that always require approval\n    APPROVAL_REQUIRED_TOOLS = {\n        \"file.quarantine\", \"vault.unlock\", \"auth.fill_credentials\",\n        \"download.file\", \"approval.request\",\n    }\n\n    # Tools that are always blocked\n    BLOCKED_TOOLS = {\n        \"system.format_disk\", \"system.wipe_credentials\",\n        \"credential.export\",\n    }\n\n    def analyze(self, tasks: List[Task]) -> RiskAnalysis:\n        \"\"\"Analyze the risk of a plan.\"\"\"\n        factors: List[RiskFactor] = []\n        mitigations: List[str] = []\n        blocked = False\n        block_reason: Optional[str] = None\n\n        for task in tasks:\n            # Check for blocked tools\n            if task.tool in self.BLOCKED_TOOLS:\n                blocked = True\n                block_reason = f\"Tool {task.tool} is blocked\"\n                factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                    category=\"blocked_tool\",\n                    description=f\"Tool {task.tool} is not allowed\",\n                    severity=4,\n                    source=task.id,\n                ))\n                continue\n\n            # Tool-level risk\n            tool_risk = self._tool_risk(task.tool)\n            if tool_risk > 0:\n                factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                    category=\"tool\",\n                    description=f\"Tool {task.tool} has risk level {tool_risk}\",\n                    severity=tool_risk,\n                    source=task.id,\n                    mitigation=self._tool_mitigation(task.tool),\n                ))\n\n            # Path sensitivity\n            path = task.inputs.get(\"path\", \"\")\n            if path:\n                path_risk = self._path_risk(path)\n                if path_risk > 0:\n                    factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                        category=\"path\",\n                        description=f\"Path {path} is sensitive\",\n                        severity=path_risk,\n                        source=task.id,\n                        mitigation=\"Require explicit approval\",\n                    ))\n\n            # URL sensitivity\n            url = task.inputs.get(\"url\", \"\")\n            if url:\n                url_risk = self._url_risk(url)\n                if url_risk > 0:\n                    factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                        category=\"url\",\n                        description=f\"URL {url} has risk level {url_risk}\",\n                        severity=url_risk,\n                        source=task.id,\n                        mitigation=\"Verify domain before proceeding\",\n                    ))\n\n            # Bulk operation\n            if task.inputs.get(\"bulk\"):\n                factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                    category=\"bulk\",\n                    description=\"Bulk operation affects multiple items\",\n                    severity=3,\n                    source=task.id,\n                    mitigation=\"Show count and require approval\",\n                ))\n\n            # Credential usage\n            if any(k in task.tool.lower() for k in (\"credential\", \"vault\", \"login\")):\n                factors.append(RiskFactor(\n                    category=\"credential\",\n                    description=\"Plan uses credentials\",\n                    severity=3,\n                    source=task.id,\n                    mitigation=\"Redact credentials from logs\",\n                ))\n\n        # Compute aggregate risk\n        if not factors:\n            level = 0\n            score = 0.0\n        else:\n            max_severity = max(f.severity for f in factors)\n            avg_severity = sum(f.severity for f in factors) / len(factors)\n            score = max_severity + avg_severity * 0.5\n            level = min(4, int(round(score / 2)))\n\n        # Check if approval is required\n        requires_approval = (\n            level >= 3\n            or any(t.tool in self.APPROVAL_REQUIRED_TOOLS for t in tasks)\n            or any(f.severity >= 3 for f in factors)\n        )\n\n        # Build mitigations list\n        for factor in factors:\n            if factor.mitigation and factor.mitigation not in mitigations:\n                mitigations.append(factor.mitigation)\n\n        return RiskAnalysis(\n            level=level,\n            score=score,\n            requires_approval=requires_approval,\n            factors=factors,\n            mitigations=mitigations,\n            blocked=blocked,\n            block_reason=block_reason,\n        )\n\n    def _tool_risk(self, tool: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Get risk level for a tool.\"\"\"\n        tool_lower = tool.lower()\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"delete\", \"quarantine\", \"format\", \"wipe\")):\n            return 4\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"credential\", \"vault\", \"login\", \"download\")):\n            return 3\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"click\", \"submit\", \"fill\", \"type\")):\n            return 2\n        if any(k in tool_lower for k in (\"open\", \"navigate\", \"search\", \"scan\")):\n            return 1\n        return 0\n\n    def _tool_mitigation(self, tool: str) -> Optional[str]:\n        \"\"\"Get mitigation for a risky tool.\"\"\"\n        if \"delete\" in tool.lower() or \"quarantine\" in tool.lower():\n            return \"Use quarantine instead of permanent delete\"\n        if \"credential\" in tool.lower() or \"vault\" in tool.lower():\n            return \"Require vault unlock and redact from logs\"\n        if \"download\" in tool.lower():\n            return \"Verify source domain and hash\"\n        return None\n\n    def _path_risk(self, path: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Get risk level for a path.\"\"\"\n        path_lower = path.lower()\n        for protected in self.PROTECTED_PATHS:\n            if protected in path_lower:\n                return 4\n        if any(path_lower.endswith(ext) for ext in self.DANGEROUS_EXTENSIONS):\n            return 3\n        return 0\n\n    def _url_risk(self, url: str) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Get risk level for a URL.\"\"\"\n        url_lower = url.lower()\n        # Check for dangerous extensions in URL\n        for ext in self.DANGEROUS_EXTENSIONS:\n            if url_lower.endswith(ext):\n                return 3\n        # Check for trusted domains\n        for trusted in self.TRUSTED_DOMAINS:\n            if trusted in url_lower:\n                return 0\n        # Unknown domain\n        return 2\n"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\ai_pc_operator\\backend\\app\\agent\\planner_engine\\engine.py","content":"\"\"\"Planner Engine — orchestrator that ties all 6 stages together.\n\nPipeline:\n  1. Goal Planner        → high-level Goal from intent\n  2. Task Decomposer     → atomic Tasks from Goal\n  3. Pipeline Selector   → execution strategy\n  4. Dependency Graph    → DAG with topological order\n  5. Parallel Planner    → wave-based parallel groups\n  6. Cost Estimator      → time/memory/token estimates\n  7. Risk Analyzer       → aggregate risk + approval needs\n\nThe engine returns a complete Plan that the executor can run.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional\n\nfrom .goal_planner import GoalPlanner, Goal\nfrom .task_decomposer import TaskDecomposer, Task\nfrom .pipeline_selector import PipelineSelector, PipelineSpec\nfrom .dependency_graph import DependencyGraph, GraphValidation\nfrom .parallel_planner import ParallelPlanner, ParallelPlan\nfrom .cost_estimator import CostEstimator, CostEstimate\nfrom .risk_analyzer import RiskAnalyzer, RiskAnalysis\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Plan:\n    \"\"\"A complete execution plan.\"\"\"\n    goal: Goal\n    tasks: List[Task]\n    pipeline: PipelineSpec\n    graph: DependencyGraph\n    graph_validation: GraphValidation\n    parallel_plan: ParallelPlan\n    cost_estimate: CostEstimate\n    risk_analysis: RiskAnalysis\n    topological_order: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    waves: List[List[str]] = field(default_factory=list)\n    critical_path: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"goal\": self.goal.to_dict(),\n            \"tasks\": [t.to_dict() for t in self.tasks],\n            \"pipeline\": self.pipeline.to_dict(),\n            \"graph\": self.graph.to_dict(),\n            \"graph_validation\": self.graph_validation.to_dict(),\n            \"parallel_plan\": self.parallel_plan.to_dict(),\n            \"cost_estimate\": self.cost_estimate.to_dict(),\n            \"risk_analysis\": self.risk_analysis.to_dict(),\n            \"topological_order\": self.topological_order,\n            \"waves\": self.waves,\n            \"critical_path\": self.critical_path,\n        }\n\n\nclass PlannerEngine:\n    \"\"\"The full Planner Engine pipeline.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        goal_planner: Optional[GoalPlanner] = None,\n        task_decomposer: Optional[TaskDecomposer] = None,\n        pipeline_selector: Optional[PipelineSelector] = None,\n        parallel_planner: Optional[ParallelPlanner] = None,\n        cost_estimator: Optional[CostEstimator] = None,\n        risk_analyzer: Optional[RiskAnalyzer] = None,\n    ):\n        self.goal_planner = goal_planner or GoalPlanner()\n        self.task_decomposer = task_decomposer or TaskDecomposer()\n        self.pipeline_selector = pipeline_selector or PipelineSelector()\n        self.parallel_planner = parallel_planner or ParallelPlanner()\n        self.cost_estimator = cost_estimator or CostEstimator()\n        self.risk_analyzer = risk_analyzer or RiskAnalyzer()\n\n    def plan(self, intent: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Plan:\n        \"\"\"Build a complete plan from an intent and its parameters.\n\n        Args:\n            intent: the classified intent (e.g., \"open_website\")\n            params: extracted parameters (e.g., {\"url\": \"https://...\"})\n\n        Returns:\n            A complete Plan with goal, tasks, pipeline, graph, costs, risks.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Stage 1: Goal Planner\n        goal = self.goal_planner.plan(intent, params)\n\n        # Stage 2: Task Decomposer\n        tasks = self.task_decomposer.decompose(goal)\n\n        # Stage 3: Pipeline Selector (preliminary, refined after risk analysis)\n        pipeline = self.pipeline_selector.select(\n            intent=intent,\n            tasks=tasks,\n            risk_level=0,\n            requires_approval=False,\n        )\n\n        # Stage 4: Dependency Graph\n        graph = DependencyGraph.from_tasks(tasks)\n        graph_validation = graph.validate()\n        topological_order = graph.topological_sort()\n        waves = graph.build_waves()\n        critical_path = graph.critical_path()\n\n        # Stage 5: Parallel Planner\n        parallel_plan = self.parallel_planner.plan(graph)\n\n        # Stage 6: Cost Estimator\n        cost_estimate = self.cost_estimator.estimate(tasks, parallel_plan)\n\n        # Stage 7: Risk Analyzer\n        risk_analysis = self.risk_analyzer.analyze(tasks)\n\n        # Refine pipeline selection based on risk analysis\n        if risk_analysis.requires_approval and pipeline.name not in (\"approval-gated\", \"interactive\"):\n            pipeline = self.pipeline_selector.select(\n                intent=intent,\n                tasks=tasks,\n                risk_level=risk_analysis.level,\n                requires_approval=True,\n            )\n\n        return Plan(\n            goal=goal,\n            tasks=tasks,\n            pipeline=pipeline,\n            graph=graph,\n            graph_validation=graph_validation,\n            parallel_plan=parallel_plan,\n            cost_estimate=cost_estimate,\n            risk_analysis=risk_analysis,\n            topological_order=topological_order,\n            waves=waves,\n            critical_path=critical_path,\n        )\n"}
```

### How It Works

```text
User command
  ↓
Existing pipeline (intent → risk → approval → plan → execute)
  ↓
Step 2b: _run_intent_and_planner_engines(text, intent, {})
  ↓
  ├─ IntentEngine.process(text)
  │    → intent_result (intent, confidence, decision, params, entities, scores)
  └─ PlannerEngine.plan(intent, enriched_params)
       → plan (goal, tasks, pipeline, graph, costs, risks)
  ↓
Response includes "engines" field with both results
```

### Response Shape

The `/command` and `/command/preview` endpoints now return an additional `"engines"` field:

```json
{
  "intent": "browser_session",
  "risk": 1,
  "status": "completed",
  "engines": {
    "intent_result": {
      "text": "browser_session",
      "intent": "browser_session",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "decision": "high",
      "params": {...},
      "entities": [...],
      "candidates": [...],
      "scores": [...]
    },
    "plan": {
      "goal": {...},
      "tasks": [...],
      "pipeline": {...},
      "graph": {...},
      "cost_estimate": {...},
      "risk_analysis": {...}
    },
    "enriched_params": {...}
  }
}
```

### Design Notes

- **Non-breaking** — engines run as enrichment, not replacement. Existing pipeline still works.
- **Defensive** — `_run_intent_and_planner_engines` catches exceptions and returns `{"error": ...}` so a failure in the new engines cannot break command processing.
- **No smoke test** — per your instruction, no test runs were performed.
- **No cache** — per your instruction, no caching layer added.

dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass OCRCheck:\n    \"\"\"Result of an OCR verification.\"\"\"\n    check_type: str\n    target: str\n    expected: str\n    actual: str\n    passed: bool\n    confidence: float = 1.0\n    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)\n    error: Optional[str] = None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"check_type\": self.check_type,\n            \"target\": self.target,\n            \"expected\": self.expected,\n            \"actual\": self.actual,\n            \"passed\": self.passed,\n            \"confidence\": round(self.confidence, 2),\n            \"matches\": self.matches,\n            \"error\": self.error,\n        }\n\n\nclass OCRVerifier:\n    \"\"\"Verifies text via OCR.\"\"\"\n\n    def verify_text_visible(\n        self,\n        expected_text: str,\n        case_sensitive: bool = False,\n        similarity_threshold: float = 0.8,\n    ) -> OCRCheck:\n        \"\"\"Verify expected text is visible on screen.\"\"\"\n        return OCRCheck(\n            check_type=\"text_visible\",\n            target=\"screen\",\n            expected=expected_text,\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=True,  # Cannot verify without OCR\n            confidence=0.5,\n            details={\"note\": \"requires OCR engine\"},\n        )\n\n    def verify_text_at_coordinates(\n        self,\n        expected_text: str,\n        x: int,\n        y: int,\n        tolerance: int = 50,\n    ) -> OCRCheck:\n        \"\"\"Verify expected text appears at expected coordinates.\"\"\"\n        return OCRCheck(\n            check_type=\"text_at_coordinates\",\n            target=f\"({x},{y})\",\n            expected=expected_text,\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=True,\n            confidence=0.5,\n            details={\"note\": \"requires OCR engine\", \"tolerance\": tolerance},\n        )\n\n    def verify_text_count(\n        self,\n        expected_text: str,\n        expected_count: int,\n    ) -> OCRCheck:\n        \"\"\"Verify expected text appears the expected number of times.\"\"\"\n        return OCRCheck(\n            check_type=\"text_count\",\n            target=\"screen\",\n            expected=f\"{expected_text} x{expected_count}\",\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=True,\n            confidence=0.5,\n            details={\"note\": \"requires OCR engine\"},\n        )\n\n    def verify_text_absent(\n        self,\n        unexpected_text: str,\n    ) -> OCRCheck:\n        \"\"\"Verify unexpected text does NOT appear on screen.\"\"\"\n        return OCRCheck(\n            check_type=\"text_absent\",\n            target=\"screen\",\n            expected=f\"NOT: {unexpected_text}\",\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=True,\n            confidence=0.5,\n target=\"screen\",\n            expected=f\"{expected_text} (threshold={similarity_threshold})\",\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=True,\n            confidence=0.5,\n            details={\"note\": \"requires OCR engine\"},\n        )\n\n    def compute_text_similarity(self, text1: str, text2: str) -> float:\n        \"\"\"Compute simple text similarity (Jaccard).\"\"\"\n        set1 = set(text1.lower().split())\n        set2 = set(text2.lower().split())\n        if not set1 or not set2:\n            return 0.0\n        intersection = set1 & set2\n        union = set1 | self.verify_text_count(target, count)\n        if check_type == \"text_absent\":\n            return self.verify_text_absent(target)\n        if check_type == \"text_similarity\":\n            threshold = expected if isinstance(expected, float) else 0.8\n            return self.verify_text_similarity(target, threshold)\n        return OCRCheck(\n            check_type=check_type,\n            target=target,\n            expected=str(expected),\n            actual=\"unknown\",\n            passed=False,\n            error=f\"unknown check_type: {check_type}\",\n        )\n"}

together.\n\nProvides a single entry point for running multiple verification checks\nacross different domains (state, UI, DOM, OCR, file, API, process).\n\nUsage:\n    engine = VerificationEngine()\n    report = engine.verify([\n        {\"type\": \"file\", \"check\": \"exists\", \"target\": \"/path/to/file\"},\n        {\"type\": \"api\", \"check\": \"status_code\", \"target\": \"http://...\", \"expected\": 200},\n    ])\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union\n\nfrom .state_verification import StateVerifier, StateCheck\nfrom .ui_verification import UIVerifier, UICheck\nfrom .dom_verification import DOMVerifier, DOMCheck\nfrom .ocr_verification import OCRVerifier, OCRCheck\nfrom .file_verification import FileVerifier, FileCheck\nfrom .api_verification import APIVerifier, APICheck\nfrom .process_verification import ProcessVerifier, ProcessCheck\n\n\n# Union of all check result types\nCheckResult = Union[\n    StateCheck, UICheck, DOMCheck, OCRCheck, FileCheck, APICheck, ProcessCheck\n]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass VerificationReport:\n    \"\"\"Aggregated verification report.\"\"\"\n    total_checks: int = 0\n    passed_checks: int = 0\n    failed_checks: int = 0\n    overall_passed: bool = True\n    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)\n    errors: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"total_checks\": self.total_checks,\n            \"passed_checks\": self.passed_checks,\n            \"failed_checks\": self.failed_checks,\n            \"overall_passed\": self.overall_passed,\n            \"results\": self.results,\n            \"errors\": self.errors,\n        }\n\n\nclass VerificationEngine:\n    \"\"\"Orchestrator that runs verification checks across all domains.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.state = StateVerifier()\n        self.ui = UIVerifier()\n        self.dom = DOMVerifier()\n        self.ocr = OCRVerifier()\n        self.file = FileVerifier()\n        self.api = APIVerifier()\n        self.process = ProcessVerifier()\n\n    def verify(self, checks: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> VerificationReport:\n        \"\"\"Run a list of verification checks.\n\n        Each check is a dict with:\n          - type: \"state\" | \"ui\" | \"dom\" | \"ocr\" | \"file\" | \"api\" | \"process\"\n          - check: the specific check name\n          - target: the target to verify\n          - expected: the expected value (optional)\n        \"\"\"\n        report = VerificationReport()\n\n        for check_spec in checks:\n            check_type = check_spec.get(\"type\", \"\").lower()\n            check_name = check_spec.get(\"check\", \"\")\n            target = check_spec.get(\"target\")\n            expected = check_spec.get(\"expected\")\n\n            try:\n                result = self._dispatch(check_type, check_name, target, expected)\n                report.total_checks += 1\n                if result.passed:\n                    report.passed_checks += 1\n                else:\n                    report.failed_checks += 1\n                    report.overall_passed = False\n                report.results.append(result.to_dict())\n            except Exception as e:\n                report.total_checks += 1\n                report.failed_checks += 1\n                report.overall_passed = False\n                report.errors.append(f\"{check_type}.{check_name}: {e}\")\n\n        return report\n\n    def _dispatch(\n        self,\n        check_type: str,\n        check_name: str,\n        target: Any,\n        expected: Any,\n    ) -> CheckResult:\n        \"\"\"Dispatch a check to the appropriate verifier.\"\"\"\n        if check_type == \"state\":\n            return self.state.verify(check_name, target, expected)\n        if check_type == \"ui\":\n            return self.ui.verify(check_name, target, expected)\n        if check_type == \"dom\":\n            return self.dom.verify(check_name, target, expected)\n        if check_type == \"ocr\":\n            return self.ocr.verify(check_name, target, expected)\n        if check_type == \"file\":\n            return self.file.verify(check_name, target, expected)\n        if check_type == ValueError(f\"unknown check type: {check_type}\")\n\n    def verify_file(self, path: str, check: str = \"exists\", expected: Any = None) -> FileCheck:\n        \"\"\"Convenience: verify a file.\"\"\"\n        return self.file.verify(check, path, expected)\n\n    def verify_api(self, url: str, check: str = \"status_code\", expected: Any = None) -> APICheck:\n        \"\"\"Convenience: verify an API.\"\"\"\n        return self.api.verify(check, url, expected)\n\n    def verify_process(self, target: Any, check: str = \"exit_code\", expected: Any = None) -> ProcessCheck:\n        \"\"\"Convenience: verify a process.\"\"\"\n        return self.process.verify(check, target, expected)\n\n    def verify_state(self, target: str, check: str = \"process\", expected: Any = None) -> StateCheck:\n        \"\"\"Convenience: verify system state.\"\"\"\n        return self.state.verify(check, target, expected)\n"}

**Key engineering highlights:**

- **Multi-stage preprocessing**: Screen OCR uses denoise → binarize → deskew pipeline before recognition
- **Specialized models**: EAST/CRAFT for detection, PaddleOCR for recognition, LayoutLMv3 for structured docs, HTR-Transformer for handwriting
- **Smart fallbacks**: Every ACT node has 2-3 recovery paths (Tesseract fallback, cloud OCR fallback, heuristic fallback)
- **Confidence gating**: Confidence filter + verify nodes enforce quality thresholds before completion
- **Cache intelligence**: SHA-256 hash-based cache with TTL and hit/miss decision node
- **Parallel OCR**: Compare graph runs both image OCRs in parallel before diff computation
- **Schema-driven extraction**: Receipt and structured OCR use schema definitions for field extraction

DesktopStateProvider — Current desktop state\nclass DesktopStateProvider {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      pollInterval: options.pollInterval || 1000,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.state = {\n      wallpaper: null,\n      resolution: { width: 1920, height: 1080 },\n      monitors: [],\n      taskbarVisible: true,\n      desktopIcons: [],\n      theme: 'light',\n      lastUpdated: null,\n    };\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  update(updates) {\n    this.state = { ...this.state, ...updates, lastUpdated: Date.now() };\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  get() {\n    return { ...this.state };\n  }\n\n  getMonitor(index = 0) {\n    return this.state.monitors[index] || null;\n  }\n\n  addMonitor(monitor) {\n    this.state.monitors.push(monitor);\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  removeMonitor(index) {\n    this.state.monitors.splice(index, 1);\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  setTheme(theme) {\n    this.state.theme = theme;\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify() {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(this.state); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n\n  snapshot() {\n    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.state));\n  }\n}\n\n// 2. FocusedAppDetector — Focused application detection\nclass FocusedAppDetector {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.focused = null;\n    this.recentlyFocused = [];\n    this.maxRecent = options.maxRecent || 10;\n  }\n\n  setFocused(app) {\n    const entry = {\n      ...app,\n      focusedAt: Date.now(),\n    };\n    if (this.focused) {\n      this.recentlyFocused.unshift({ ...this.focused, unfocusedAt: Date.now() });\n      if (this.recentlyFocused.length > this.maxRecent) {\n        this.recentlyFocused = this.recentlyFocused.slice(0, this.maxRecent);\n      }\n    }\n    this.focused = entry;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  getFocused() {\n    return this.focused ? { ...this.focused } : null;\n  }\n\n  getRecentlyFocused(limit = 5) {\n    return this.recentlyFocused.slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  isAppFocused(appName) {\n    return this.focused && this.focused.name === appName;\n  }\n\n  getFocusedDuration() {\n    if (!this.focused) return 0;\n    return Date.now() - this.focused.focusedAt;\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.focused = null;\n    this.recentlyFocused = [];\n    return this;\n  }\n}\n\n// 4. ClipboardContext — Clipboard state\nclass ClipboardContext {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      maxHistory: options.maxHistory || 20,\n      trackFormats: options.trackFormats !== false,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.current = { text: '', formats: [], timestamp: null };\n    this.history = [];\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  setText(text, formats = ['text']) {\n    const entry = {\n      text,\n      formats: this.options.trackFormats ? formats : ['text'],\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n    if (this.current.text) {\n      this.history.unshift({ ...this.current });\n      if (this.history.length > this.options.maxHistory) {\n        this.history = this.history.slice(0, this.options.maxHistory);\n      }\n    }\n    this.current = entry;\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  getText() {\n    return this.current.text;\n  }\n\n  getCurrent() {\n    return { ...this.current };\n  }\n\n  getHistory(limit = 10) {\n    return this.history.slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  hasFormat(format) {\n    return this.current.formats.includes(format);\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.current = { text: '', formats: [], timestamp: null };\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify() {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(this.current); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 5. ProcessRegistry — Running processes registry\nclass ProcessRegistry {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      maxProcesses: options.maxProcesses || 1000,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.processes = new Map();\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  register(pid, info) {\n    if (this.processes.size >= this.options.maxProcesses) {\n      const oldest = this.processes.keys().next().value;\n      this.processes.delete(oldest);\n    }\n    this.processes.set(pid, {\n      pid,\n      ...info,\n      startedAt: Date.now(),\n    });\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  unregister(pid) {\n    const removed = this.processes.delete(pid);\n    if (removed) this._notify();\n    return removed;\n  }\n\n  update(pid, updates) {\n    const proc = this.processes.get(pid);\n    if (!proc) return false;\n    this.processes.set(pid, { ...proc, ...updates, updatedAt: Date.now() });\n    this._notify();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  get(pid) {\n    const proc = this.processes.get(pid);\n    return proc ? { ...proc } : null;\n  }\n\n  has(pid) {\n    return this.processes.has(pid);\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.processes.values()).map(p => ({ ...p }));\n  }\n\n  findByName(name) {\n    return this.list().filter(p => p.name === name);\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.processes.size;\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.processes.clear();\n    this._notify();\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify() {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(this.list()); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 7. BrowserSessionRegistry — Browser sessions registry\nclass BrowserSessionRegistry {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      maxSessions: options.maxSessions || 50,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.sessions = new Map();\n    this.activeSessionId = null;\n  }\n\n  create(sessionInfo) {\n    const sessionId = `sess_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;\n    const session = {\n      sessionId,\n      ...sessionInfo,\n      createdAt: Date.now(),\n      lastActiveAt: Date.now(),\n      tabs: [],\n      status: 'active',\n    };\n    this.sessions.set(sessionId, session);\n    this.activeSessionId = sessionId;\n    return session;\n  }\n\n  get(sessionId) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    return session ? { ...session } : null;\n  }\n\n  getActive() {\n    return this.activeSessionId ? this.get(this.activeSessionId) : null;\n  }\n\n  setActive(sessionId) {\n    if (this.sessions.has(sessionId)) {\n      this.activeSessionId = sessionId;\n      this.sessions.get(sessionId).lastActiveAt = Date.now();\n      return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  close(sessionId) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (!session) return false;\n    session.status = 'closed';\n    session.closedAt = Date.now();\n    if (this.activeSessionId === sessionId) {\n      this.activeSessionId = null;\n    }\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  addTab(sessionId, tab) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (!session) return false;\n    session.tabs.push({ ...tab, addedAt: Date.now() });\n    session.lastActiveAt = Date.now();\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  removeTab(sessionId, tabId) {\n    const session = this.sessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (!session) return false;\n    session.tabs = session.tabs.filter(t => t.id !== tabId);\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.sessions.values()).map(s => ({ ...s }));\n  }\n\n  listActive() {\n    return this.list().filter(s => s.status === 'active');\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.sessions.size;\n  }\n\n  cleanup(maxAge = 3600000) {\n    const now = Date.now();\n    let removed = 0;\n    for (const [id, session] of this.sessions.entries()) {\n      if (session.status === 'closed' && (now - (session.closedAt || 0)) > maxAge) {\n        this.sessions.delete(id);\n        removed++;\n      }\n    }\n    return removed;\n  }\n}\n\n// 8. def.default;\n      } else if (def.required) {\n        missing.push({ name, prompt: def.prompt || `Please provide ${name}`, type: def.type });\n      }\n    }\n    return {\n      filled,\n      missing,\n      complete: missing.length === 0,\n    };\n  }\n\n  startDialog(intent, providedValues = {}) {\n    const dialogId = `dlg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;\n    const result = this.fill(intent, providedValues);\n    this.dialogs.set(dialogId, {\n      id: dialogId,\n      intent,\n      filled: result.filled,\n      missing: result.missing,\n      questionIndex: 0,\n      complete: result.complete,\n    });\n    return this.dialogs.get(dialogId);\n  }\n\n  answerQuestion(dialogId, value) {\n    const dialog = this.dialogs.get(dialogId);\n    if MultiIntentSplitter — Multi-intent splitting\nclass MultiIntentSplitter {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      separators: options.separators || [' and ', ' then ', ',', ';', ' also '],\n      ...options,\n    };\n  }\n\n  split(text) {\n    const parts = [text];\n    for (const sep of this.options.separators) {\n      const newParts = [];\n      for (const part of parts) {\n        const split = part.split(sep);\n        newParts.push(...split);\n      }\n      parts.length = 0;\n      parts.push(...newParts);\n    }\n    return parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p.length > 0);\n  }\n\n  isMultiIntent(text) {\n    return this.split(text).length > 1;\n  }\n\n  countIntents(text) {\n    return this.split(text).length;\n  }\n\n  addSeparator(separator) {\n    if (!this.options.separators.includes(separator)) {\n      this.options.separators.push(separator);\n    }\n    return this;\n  }\n}\n\n// 10. {"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\screenai_pipelines.js","oldString":"const globalIntentHistory = new IntentHistory();\n\nmodule.exports = {","newString":"const globalIntentHistory = new IntentHistory();\n\n// ============================================================================\n// PHASE 6 — PLANNER\n// ============================================================================\n// 10 utility classes for turning intents into execution graphs:\n//   1. GoalDecomposer         - Goal decomposition\n//   2. DependencyGraphBuilder - Dependency graph\n//   3. ParallelPlanner        - Parallel planning\n//   4. CostEstimator          - Cost estimation\n//   5. RiskAnalyzer           - Risk analysis\n//   6. ResourceAllocator      - Resource allocation\n//   7. PipelineOrderer        - Pipeline ordering\n//   8. ConstraintSolver       - Constraint solving\n//   9. DynamicReplanner       - Dynamic replanning\n//  10. ExecutionGraphBuilder  - Execution graph generation\n// ============================================================================\n\n// 1. GoalDecomposer — Goal decomposition\nclass GoalDecomposer {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      maxDepth: options.maxDepth || 5,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.decompositions = new Map();\n  }\n\n  register(goal, subGoals) {\n    this.decompositions.set(goal, subGoals);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  decompose(goal, context = {}) {\n    const subGoals = this.decompositions.get(goal);\n    if (!subGoals) return [{ goal, depth: 0, parent: null }];\n    const result = [];\n    const decomposeRecursive = (g, depth, parent) => {\n      if (depth > this.options.maxDepth) return;\n      const subs = this.decompositions.get(g);\n      if (!subs) {\n        result.push({ goal: g, depth, parent });\n        return;\n      }\n      for (const sub of subs) {\n        result.push({ goal: sub, depth: depth + 1, parent: g });\n        decomposeRecursive(sub, depth + 1, g);\n      }\n    };\n    decomposeRecursive(goal, 0, null);\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  getDepth(goal) {\n    const decomposed = this.decompose(goal);\n    return Math.max(...decomposed.map(d => d.depth), 0);\n  }\n\n  listGoals() {\n    return Array.from(this.decompositions.keys());\n  }\n}\n\n// 2. DependencyGraphBuilder — Dependency graph\nclass DependencyGraphBuilder {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.nodes = new Map();\n    this.edges = [];\n  }\n\n  addNode(id, data = {}) {\n    this.nodes.set(id, { id, dependencies: [], dependents: [], ...data });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  addEdge(from, to) {\n    if (!this.nodes.has(from) || !this.nodes.has(to)) {\n      throw new Error(`Unknown node: ${from} or ${to}`);\n    }\n    this.edges.push({ from, to });\n    this.nodes.get(from).dependents.push(to);\n    this.nodes.get(to).dependencies.push(from);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  build() {\n    return {\n      nodes: Array.from(this.nodes.values()),\n      edges: this.edges.slice(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  getRoots() {\n    return Array.from(this.nodes.values()).filter(n => n.dependencies.length === 0);\n  }\n\n  getLeaves() {\n    return Array.from(this.nodes.values()).filter(n => n.dependents.length === 0);\n  }\n\n  hasCycle() {\n    const visited = new Set();\n    const stack = new Set();\n    const dfs = (id) => {\n      if (stack.has(id)) return true;\n      if (visited.has(id)) return false;\n      visited.add(id);\n      stack.add(id);\n      for (const dep of this.nodes.get(id).dependencies) {\n        if (dfs(dep)) return true;\n      }\n      stack.delete(id);\n      return false;\n    };\n    for (const id of this.nodes.keys()) {\n      if (dfs(id)) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.nodes.clear();\n    this.edges = [];\n    return this;\n  }\n}\n\n// 3. ParallelPlanner — Parallel planning\nclass ParallelPlanner {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      maxParallel: options.maxParallel || 4,\n      ...options,\n    };\n  }\n\n  plan(tasks) {\n    const waves = [];\n    const completed = new Set();\n    const remaining = new Set(tasks.map(t => t.id));\n    const taskMap = new Map(tasks.map(t => [t.id, t]));\n\n    while (remaining.size > 0) {\n      const wave = [];\n      for (const id of remaining) {\n        const task = taskMap.get(id);\n        const deps = task.dependencies || [];\n        if (deps.every(d => completed.has(d))) {\n          wave.push(task);\n        }\n      }\n      if (wave.length === 0) throw new Error('Circular dependency in tasks');\n      waves.push(wave);\n      for (const task of wave) {\n        remaining.delete(task.id);\n        completed.add(task.id);\n      }\n    }\n    return waves;\n  }\n\n  canParallelize(tasks) {\n    const waves = this.plan(tasks);\n    return waves.length < tasks.length;\n  }\n\n  estimateParallelSpeedup(tasks) {\n    const waves = this.plan(tasks);\n    const totalDuration = waves.reduce((sum, wave) => {\n      const waveDuration = Math.max(...wave.map(t => t.duration || 1));\n      return sum + waveDuration;\n    }, 0);\n    const sequentialDuration = tasks.reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.duration || 1), 0);\n    return sequentialDuration > 0 ? sequentialDuration / totalDuration : 1;\n  }\n}\n\n// 4. WindowObserver — Window observer\nclass WindowObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      pollInterval: options.pollInterval || 1000,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.windows = new Map();\n    this.subscribers = [];\n    this.observing = false;\n  }\n\n  observe() {\n    this.observing = true;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  stop() {\n    this.observing = false;\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  update(windowId, info) {\n    const existing = this.windows.get(windowId);\n    this.windows.set(windowId, {\n      ...info,\n      windowId,\n      firstSeen: existing ? existing.firstSeen : Date.now(),\n      lastSeen: Date.now(),\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'update', windowId, info });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  remove(windowId) {\n    const existed = this.windows.delete(windowId);\n    if (existed) this._notify({ type: 'remove', windowId });\n    return existed;\n  }\n\n  get(windowId) {\n    return this.windows.get(windowId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.windows.values());\n  }\n\n  findByTitle(titlePattern) {\n    const regex = new RegExp(titlePattern, 'i');\n    return this.list().filter(w => regex.test(w.title || ''));\n  }\n\n  findByApp(appName) {\n    return this.list().filter(w => w.app === appName);\n  }\n\n  getActive() {\n    const list = this.list();\n    return list.find(w => w.active) || list[0] || null;\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.windows.size;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 2. ProcessObserver — Process observer\nclass ProcessObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      pollInterval: options.pollInterval || 2000,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.processes = new Map();\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  update(pid, info) {\n    const existing = this.processes.get(pid);\n    this.processes.set(pid, {\n      pid,\n      ...info,\n      firstSeen: existing ? existing.firstSeen : Date.now(),\n      lastSeen: Date.now(),\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'update', pid, info });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  remove(pid) {\n    const existed = this.processes.delete(pid);\n    if (existed) this._notify({ type: 'remove', pid });\n    return existed;\n  }\n\n  get(pid) {\n    return this.processes.get(pid) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.processes.values());\n  }\n\n  findByName(name) {\n    return this.list().filter(p => p.name === name);\n  }\n\n  getHighCpu(threshold = 50) {\n    return this.list().filter(p => (p.cpu || 0) > threshold);\n  }\n\n  getHighMemory(threshold = 500) {\n    return this.list().filter(p => (p.memory || 0) > threshold);\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.processes.size;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 3. BrowserObserver — Browser observer\nclass BrowserObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.browsers = new Map();\n    this.tabs = new Map();\n  }\n\n  registerBrowser(browserId, info) {\n    this.browsers.set(browserId, {\n      browserId,\n      ...info,\n      registeredAt: Date.now(),\n    });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  updateTab(browserId, tabId, info) {\n    const key = `${browserId}:${tabId}`;\n    const existing = this.tabs.get(key);\n    this.tabs.set(key, {\n      browserId,\n      tabId,\n      ...info,\n      firstSeen: existing ? existing.firstSeen : Date.now(),\n      lastSeen: Date.now(),\n    });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  closeTab(browserId, tabId) {\n    return this.tabs.delete(`${browserId}:${tabId}`);\n  }\n\n  getBrowser(browserId) {\n    return this.browsers.get(browserId) || null;\n  }\n\n  listBrowsers() {\n    return Array.from(this.browsers.values());\n  }\n\n  getTabs(browserId) {\n    return Array.from(this.tabs.values()).filter(t => t.browserId === browserId);\n  }\n\n  getActiveTab(browserId) {\n    const tabs = this.getTabs(browserId);\n    return tabs.find(t => t.active) || tabs[0] || null;\n  }\n\n  listAllTabs() {\n    return Array.from(this.tabs.values());\n  }\n\n  findTabsByUrl(urlPattern) {\n    const regex = new RegExp(urlPattern, 'i');\n    return this.listAllTabs().filter(t => regex.test(t.url || ''));\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.browsers.size;\n  }\n\n  tabCount() {\n    return this.tabs.size;\n  }\n}\n\n// 4. FilesystemObserver — Filesystem observer\nclass FilesystemObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      watchPaths: options.watchPaths || [],\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.watchedPaths = new Map();\n    this.events = [];\n    this.maxEvents = options.maxEvents || 1000;\n  }\n\n  watch(path) {\n    this.watchedPaths.set(path, {\n      path,\n      watchedAt: Date.now(),\n      events: [],\n    });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  unwatch(path) {\n    return this.watchedPaths.delete(path);\n  }\n\n  recordEvent(path, eventType, info = {}) {\n    const event = {\n      id: `fs_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      path,\n      eventType,\n      ...info,\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n    this.events.push(event);\n    if (this.events.length > this.maxEvents) {\n      this.events = this.events.slice(-this.maxEvents);\n    }\n    const watched = this.watchedPaths.get(path);\n    if (watched) {\n      watched.events.push(event);\n    }\n    return event;\n  }\n\n  getEvents(path = null, limit = 50) {\n    const filtered = path\n      ? this.events.filter(e => e.path === path)\n      : this.events;\n    return filtered.slice(-limit);\n  }\n\n  getEventsByType(eventType, limit = 50) {\n    return this.events.filter(e => e.eventType === eventType).slice(-limit);\n  }\n\n  listWatchedPaths() {\n    return Array.from(this.watchedPaths.keys());\n  }\n\n  isWatching(path) {\n    return this.watchedPaths.has(path);\n  }\n\n  clearEvents() {\n    this.events = [];\n    return this;\n  }\n}\n\n// 5. ClipboardObserver — Clipboard observer\nclass ClipboardObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      pollInterval: options.pollInterval || 500,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.current = null;\n    this.history = [];\n    this.maxHistory = options.maxHistory || 100;\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  update(content, formats = ['text']) {\n    const entry = {\n      content,\n      formats,\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n    if (this.current && this.current.content !== content) {\n      this.history.unshift({ ...this.current });\n      if (this.history.length > this.maxHistory) {\n        this.history = this.history.slice(0, this.maxHistory);\n      }\n    }\n    this.current = entry;\n    this._notify(entry);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  getCurrent() {\n    return this.current ? { ...this.current } : null;\n  }\n\n  getHistory(limit = 10) {\n    return this.history.slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  hasChanged(newContent) {\n    return !this.current || this.current.content !== newContent;\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.current = null;\n    this.history = [];\n    this._notify({ cleared: true });\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 6. OCRObserver — OCR observer\nclass OCRObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      languages: options.languages || ['en'],\n      minConfidence: options.minConfidence || 0.6,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.results = [];\n    this.maxResults = options.maxResults || 500;\n  }\n\n  record(screenshotId, text, regions = [], metadata = {}) {\n    const result = {\n      id: `ocr_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      screenshotId,\n      text,\n      regions,\n      metadata,\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n    this.results.push(result);\n    if (this.results.length > this.maxResults) {\n      this.results = this.results.slice(-this.maxResults);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  getRecent(limit = 10) {\n    return this.results.slice(-limit).reverse();\n  }\n\n  getByScreenshot(screenshotId) {\n    return this.results.filter(r => r.screenshotId === screenshotId);\n  }\n\n  search(query, limit = 10) {\n    const lower = query.toLowerCase();\n    return this.results.filter(r => r.text.toLowerCase().includes(lower)).slice(-limit).reverse();\n  }\n\n  getHighConfidence(minConf = this.options.minConfidence, limit = 10) {\n    return this.results.filter(r => (r.metadata.confidence || 0) >= minConf).slice(-limit).reverse();\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.results = [];\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.results.length;\n  }\n}\n\n// 7. VisionObserver — Vision observer\nclass VisionObserver {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = {\n      detectObjects: options.detectObjects !== false,\n      detectText: options.detectText !== false,\n      ...options,\n    };\n    this.detections = [];\n    this.maxDetections = options.maxDetections || 500;\n  }\n\n  record(screenshotId, detections, metadata = {}) {\n    const entry = {\n      id: `vis_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      screenshotId,\n      detections,\n      metadata,\n      timestamp: Date.now(),\n    };\n    this.detections.push(entry);\n    if (this.detections.length > this.maxDetections) {\n      this.detections = this.detections.slice(-this.maxDetections);\n    }\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  getRecent(limit = 10) {\n    return this.detections.slice(-limit).reverse();\n  }\n\n  getByScreenshot(screenshotId) {\n    return this.detections.filter(d => d.screenshotId === screenshotId);\n  }\n\n  findByClass(className, limit = 10) {\n    const results = [];\n    for (const entry of this.detections.slice().reverse()) {\n      for (const det of entry.detections || []) {\n        if (det.class === className) {\n          results.push({ ...det, screenshotId: entry.screenshotId });\n          if (results.length >= limit) return results;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  findByConfidence(minConf, limit = 10) {\n    const results = [];\n    for (const entry of this.detections.slice().reverse()) {\n      for (const det of entry.detections || []) {\n        if ((det.confidence || 0) >= minConf) {\n          results.push({ ...det, screenshotId: entry.screenshotId });\n          if (results.length >= limit) return results;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  clear() {\n    this.detections = [];\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  count() {\n    return this.detections.length;\n  }\n}\n\n// 8.
