WorkflowBuilder: compose nodes into a workflow -----\nclass WorkflowBuilder {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.workflows = new Map(); // workflowId -> { nodes, edges, metadata }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  create(workflowId, metadata = {}) {\n    this.workflows.set(workflowId, {\n      workflowId,\n      nodes: new Map(),\n      edges: [],\n      metadata: { createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp(), ...metadata },\n      status: 'draft'\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'workflow_created', workflowId });\n    return this.workflows.get(workflowId);\n  }\n\n  addNode(workflowId, nodeId, node) {\n    const wf = this.workflows.get(workflowId);\n    if (!wf) return null;\n    wf.nodes.set(nodeId, { nodeId, ...node });\n    this._notify({ type: 'node_added', workflowId, nodeId });\n    return wf.nodes.get(nodeId);\n  }\n\n  addEdge(workflowId, fromNodeId, toNodeId, condition = null) {\n    const wf = this.workflows.get(workflowId);\n    if (!wf) return null;\n    wf.edges.push({ from: fromNodeId, to: toNodeId, condition });\n    this._notify({ type: 'edge_added', workflowId, from: fromNodeId, to: toNodeId });\n    return wf.edges[wf.edges.length - 1];\n  }\n\n  get(workflowId) {\n    const wf = this.workflows.get(workflowId);\n    if (!wf) return null;\n    return {\n      ...wf,\n      nodes: Array.from(wf.nodes.entries()),\n      edges: [...wf.edges]\n    };\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.workflows.values()).map(w => ({\n      ...w,\n      nodes: Array.from(w.nodes.entries()),\n      edges: [...w.edges]\n    }));\n  }\n\n  delete(workflowId) {\n    const removed = this.workflows.delete(workflowId);\n    if (removed) this._notify({ type: 'workflow_deleted', workflowId });\n    return removed;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 2. WorkflowBrancher: conditional execution paths -----\nclass WorkflowBrancher {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.branches = new Map(); // branchId -> { condition, thenPath, elsePath }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(branchId, condition, thenPath, elsePath) {\n    this.branches.set(branchId, {\n      branchId,\n      condition,\n      thenPath,\n      elsePath,\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'branch_defined', branchId });\n    return this.branches.get(branchId);\n  }\n\n  evaluate(branchId, context) {\n    const branch = this.branches.get(branchId);\n    if (!branch) return null;\n    let result = false;\n    try {\n      if (typeof branch.condition === 'function') {\n        result = !!branch.condition(context);\n      } else if (branch.condition && branch.condition.key) {\n        result = context[branch.condition.key] === branch.condition.value;\n      }\n    } catch (_) { result = false; }\n    return {\n      branchId,\n      result,\n      path: result ? branch.thenPath : branch.elsePath\n    };\n  }\n\n  get(branchId) {\n    return this.branches.get(branchId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.branches.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 3. WorkflowLoop: iterate over collections or until condition -----\nclass WorkflowLoop {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { maxIterations: options.maxIterations || 1000, ...options };\n    this.loops = new Map(); // loopId -> { collection, condition, currentIndex }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(loopId, config) {\n    this.loops.set(loopId, {\n      loopId,\n      collection: config.collection || [],\n      condition: config.condition || null,\n      maxIterations: config.maxIterations || this.options.maxIterations,\n      currentIndex: 0,\n      iterations: 0,\n      status: 'pending',\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'loop_defined', loopId });\n    return this.loops.get(loopId);\n  }\n\n  iterate(loopId) {\n    const loop = this.loops.get(loopId);\n    if (!loop) return null;\n    if (loop.iterations >= loop.maxIterations) {\n      loop.status = 'max_reached';\n      return { done: true, reason: 'max_iterations' };\n    }\n    if (loop.currentIndex >= loop.collection.length) {\n      loop.status = 'completed';\n      return { done: true, reason: 'collection_exhausted' };\n    }\n    if (loop.condition) {\n      try {\n        if (!loop.condition(loop.collection[loop.currentIndex], loop.iterations)) {\n          loop.status = 'condition_false';\n          return { done: true, reason: 'condition_false' };\n        }\n      } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n    const item = loop.collection[loop.currentIndex];\n    loop.currentIndex++;\n    loop.iterations++;\n    loop.status = 'running';\n    return { done: false, item, index: loop.currentIndex - 1, iteration: loop.iterations };\n  }\n\n  reset(loopId) {\n    const loop = this.loops.get(loopId);\n    if (!loop) return null;\n    loop.currentIndex = 0;\n    loop.iterations = 0;\n    loop.status = 'pending';\n    return loop;\n  }\n\n  get(loopId) {\n    return this.loops.get(loopId) || null;\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 4. WorkflowCondition: evaluate predicates -----\nclass WorkflowCondition {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.conditions = new Map(); // conditionId -> { predicate, description }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(conditionId, predicate, description = '') {\n    this.conditions.set(conditionId, {\n      conditionId,\n      predicate,\n      description,\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    return this.conditions.get(conditionId);\n  }\n\n  evaluate(conditionId, context) {\n    const cond = this.conditions.get(conditionId);\n    if (!cond) return null;\n    try {\n      return { conditionId, result: !!cond.predicate(context), context };\n    } catch (e) {\n      return { conditionId, result: false, error: e.message };\n    }\n  }\n\n  evaluateAll(conditionIds, context) {\n    return conditionIds.map(id => this.evaluate(id, context));\n  }\n\n  evaluateAny(conditionIds, context) {\n    for (const id of conditionIds) {\n      const r = this.evaluate(id, context);\n      if (r && r.result) return r;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  get(conditionId) {\n    return this.conditions.get(conditionId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.conditions.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 5. WorkflowParallel: fan-out concurrent execution -----\nclass WorkflowParallel {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { maxConcurrency: options.maxConcurrency || 8, ...options };\n    this.branches = new Map(); // branchId -> { tasks, results, status }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(branchId, tasks) {\n    this.branches.set(branchId, {\n      branchId,\n      tasks: tasks.map((t, i) => ({ id: i, task: t, status: 'pending', result: null })),\n      results: [],\n      status: 'pending',\n      startedAt: null,\n      completedAt: null,\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'parallel_defined', branchId });\n    return this.branches.get(branchId);\n  }\n\n  async execute(branchId, executor) {\n    const branch = this.branches.get(branchId);\n    if (!branch) return null;\n    branch.status = 'running';\n    branch.startedAt = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    const results = await Promise.all(\n      branch.tasks.map(async (t) => {\n        try {\n          t.status = 'running';\n          t.result = await executor(t.task, t.id);\n          t.status = 'completed';\n          return { id: t.id, success: true, result: t.result };\n        } catch (e) {\n          t.status = 'failed';\n          t.result = e.message;\n          return { id: t.id, success: false, error: e.message };\n        }\n      })\n    );\n    branch.results = results;\n    branch.status = results.every(r => r.success) ? 'completed' : 'partial';\n    branch.completedAt = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    this._notify({ type: 'parallel_completed', branchId, results });\n    return { branchId, results, status: branch.status };\n  }\n\n  get(branchId) {\n    return this.branches.get(branchId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.branches.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 6. WorkflowScheduler: cron-like scheduling -----\nclass WorkflowScheduler {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.schedules = new Map(); // scheduleId -> { workflowId, cron, nextRun, status }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(scheduleId, workflowId, cron, options = {}) {\n    this.schedules.set(scheduleId, {\n      scheduleId,\n      workflowId,\n      cron,\n      intervalMs: options.intervalMs || null,\n      nextRun: options.intervalMs ? globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp() + options.intervalMs : null,\n      lastRun: null,\n      runCount: 0,\n      status: 'active',\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'schedule_defined', scheduleId });\n    return this.schedules.get(scheduleId);\n  }\n\n  tick(now = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()) {\n    const due = [];\n    for (const [id, sched] of this.schedules.entries()) {\n      if (sched.status !== 'active') continue;\n      if (sched.nextRun && sched.nextRun <= now) {\n        due.push(id);\n        sched.lastRun = now;\n        sched.runCount++;\n        if (sched.intervalMs) {\n          sched.nextRun = now + sched.intervalMs;\n        } else {\n          sched.status = 'completed';\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (due.length) this._notify({ type: 'schedules_due', scheduleIds: due });\n    return due;\n  }\n\n  pause(scheduleId) {\n    const sched = this.schedules.get(scheduleId);\n    if (!sched) return null;\n    sched.status = 'paused';\n    return sched;\n  }\n\n  resume(scheduleId) {\n    const sched = this.schedules.get(scheduleId);\n    if (!sched) return null;\n    sched.status = 'active';\n    return sched;\n  }\n\n  get(scheduleId) {\n    return this.schedules.get(scheduleId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.schedules.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 7. WorkflowTrigger: event-driven execution -----\nclass WorkflowTrigger {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.triggers = new Map(); // triggerId -> { event, workflowId, filter }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(triggerId, event, workflowId, filter = null) {\n    this.triggers.set(triggerId, {\n      triggerId,\n      event,\n      workflowId,\n      filter,\n      fireCount: 0,\n      lastFired: null,\n      status: 'active',\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'trigger_defined', triggerId });\n    return this.triggers.get(triggerId);\n  }\n\n  fire(eventName, payload) {\n    const fired = [];\n    for (const [id, trig] of this.triggers.entries()) {\n      if (trig.status !== 'active') continue;\n      if (trig.event !== eventName) continue;\n      if (trig.filter) {\n        try {\n          if (!trig.filter(payload)) continue;\n        } catch (_) { continue; }\n      }\n      trig.fireCount++;\n      trig.lastFired = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n      fired.push({ triggerId: id, workflowId: trig.workflowId, payload });\n    }\n    if (fired.length) this._notify({ type: 'triggers_fired', event: eventName, fired });\n    return fired;\n  }\n\n  disable(triggerId) {\n    const trig = this.triggers.get(triggerId);\n    if (!trig) return null;\n    trig.status = 'disabled';\n    return trig;\n  }\n\n  enable(triggerId) {\n    const trig = this.triggers.get(triggerId);\n    if (!trig) return null;\n    trig.status = 'active';\n    return trig;\n  }\n\n  get(triggerId) {\n    return this.triggers.get(triggerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.triggers.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 8. WorkflowTemplate: reusable workflow definitions -----\nclass WorkflowTemplate {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.templates = new Map(); // templateId -> { name, definition, params }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(templateId, name, definition, params = []) {\n    this.templates.set(templateId, {\n      templateId,\n      name,\n      definition,\n      params,\n      useCount: 0,\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'template_defined', templateId });\n    return this.templates.get(templateId);\n  }\n\n  instantiate(templateId, values = {}) {\n    const tpl = this.templates.get(templateId);\n    if (!tpl) return null;\n    tpl.useCount++;\n    const params = {};\n    for (const p of tpl.params) {\n      params[p.name] = p.default !== undefined ? p.default : null;\n    }\n    Object.assign(params, values);\n    return {\n      templateId,\n      name: tpl.name,\n      params,\n      definition: tpl.definition,\n      instantiatedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    };\n  }\n\n  get(templateId) {\n    return this.templates.get(templateId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.templates.values());\n  }\n\n  search(query) {\n    const q = (query || '').toLowerCase();\n    return this.list().filter(t =>\n      t.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n      t.templateId.toLowerCase().includes(q)\n    );\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 9. WorkflowNested: workflows within workflows -----\nclass WorkflowNested {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { maxDepth: options.maxDepth || 5, ...options };\n    this.nested = new Map(); // parentId -> { children: [childId, ...] }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  nest(parentId, childId, depth = 0) {\n    if (depth >= this.options.maxDepth) return null;\n    if (!this.nested.has(parentId)) {\n      this.nested.set(parentId, { parentId, children: [], depth: 0 });\n    }\n    const parent = this.nested.get(parentId);\n    if (!parent.children.includes(childId)) {\n      parent.children.push(childId);\n    }\n    this._notify({ type: 'workflow_nested', parentId, childId });\n    return parent;\n  }\n\n  getChildren(parentId) {\n    const parent = this.nested.get(parentId);\n    return parent ? [...parent.children] : [];\n  }\n\n  getDepth(workflowId) {\n    let depth = 0;\n    let current = workflowId;\n    const visited = new Set();\n    while (this.nested.has(current) && !visited.has(current)) {\n      visited.add(current);\n      depth++;\n      const children = this.nested.get(current).children;\n      if (children.length === 0) break;\n      current = children[0];\n    }\n    return depth;\n  }\n\n  flatten(rootId) {\n    const result = [];\n    const visited = new Set();\n    const stack = [rootId];\n    while (stack.length) {\n      const id = stack.pop();\n      if (visited.has(id)) continue;\n      visited.add(id);\n      result.push(id);\n      const children = this.getChildren(id);\n      stack.push(...children);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  get(parentId) {\n    return this.nested.get(parentId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.nested.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 10. WorkflowPersistence: save/load workflows to disk -----\nclass WorkflowPersistence {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { storageDir: options.storageDir || './workflows', ...options };\n    this.records = new Map(); // workflowId -> { savedAt, path, hash }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  save(workflowId, workflowData) {\n    const now = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    const json = JSON.stringify(workflowData);\n    const hash = globalNativeBridge.computeStateHash(json);\n    const path = this.options.storageDir + '/' + workflowId + '.json';\n    this.records.set(workflowId, {\n      workflowId,\n      path,\n      hash,\n      sizeBytes: json.length,\n      savedAt: now\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'workflow_saved', workflowId, path });\n    return this.records.get(workflowId);\n  }\n\n  load(workflowId) {\n    const rec = this.records.get(workflowId);\n    if (!rec) return null;\n    return {\n      workflowId,\n      path: rec.path,\n      hash: rec.hash,\n      loadedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp(),\n      metadata: rec\n    };\n  }\n\n  delete(workflowId) {\n    const removed = this.records.delete(workflowId);\n    if (removed) this._notify({ type: 'workflow_deleted_persisted', workflowId });\n    return removed;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.records.values());\n  }\n\n  exists(workflowId) {\n    return this.records.has(workflowId);\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); Provider registry (catalog of available implementations)\n//   - Provider selection (pick best provider for a capability)\n//   - Provider fallback (chain of alternative providers)\n//   - Provider load balancing (distribute requests across providers)\n//   - Provider circuit breaker (isolate failing providers)\n//   - Provider health monitor (track success/failure rates)\n//   - Provider capability matcher (match providers to capabilities)\n//   - Provider config manager (per-provider configuration)\n//   - Provider metrics collector (aggregate provider stats)\n//   - Provider lifecycle manager (init/shutdown providers)\n\n// ----- 1. ProviderRegistry: catalog of available implementations -----\nclass ProviderRegistry {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.providers = new Map(); // providerId -> { id, type, capabilities, config, status }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  register(providerId, provider) {\n    this.providers.set(providerId, {\n      providerId,\n      type: provider.type || 'unknown',\n      capabilities: provider.capabilities || [],\n      config: provider.config || {},\n      status: 'registered',\n      registeredAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp(),\n      ...provider\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_registered', providerId });\n    return this.providers.get(providerId);\n  }\n\n  unregister(providerId) {\n    const removed = this.providers.delete(providerId);\n    if (removed) this._notify({ type: 'provider_unregistered', providerId });\n    return removed;\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.providers.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list(type = null) {\n    const all = Array.from(this.providers.values());\n    return type ? all.filter(p => p.type === type) : all;\n  }\n\n  findByCapability(capability) {\n    return Array.from(this.providers.values()).filter(p =>\n      p.capabilities && p.capabilities.includes(capability)\n    );\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 2. ProviderSelector: pick best provider for a capability -----\nclass ProviderSelector {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.selections = new Map(); // selectionId -> { capability, providerId, score }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  select(capability, candidates) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(candidates) || candidates.length === 0) return null;\n    let best = null;\n    let bestScore = -1;\n    for (const c of candidates) {\n      const score = globalNativeBridge.computeProviderScore(\n        c.health || 50,\n        c.cost || 50,\n        c.latencyMs || 1000\n      );\n      if (score > bestScore) {\n        bestScore = score;\n        best = { ...c, score };\n      }\n    }\n    const selectionId = 'sel_' + globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);\n    this.selections.set(selectionId, {\n      selectionId,\n      capability,\n      providerId: best.providerId,\n      score: bestScore,\n      selectedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_selected', capability, providerId: best.providerId, score: bestScore });\n    return { selectionId, capability, providerId: best.providerId, score: bestScore, provider: best };\n  }\n\n  get(selectionId) {\n    return this.selections.get(selectionId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.selections.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 3. ProviderFallback: chain of alternative providers -----\nclass ProviderFallback {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.chains = new Map(); // chainId -> { providers: [providerId, ...], currentIndex }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  define(chainId, providerIds) {\n    this.chains.set(chainId, {\n      chainId,\n      providers: providerIds,\n      currentIndex: 0,\n      attempts: 0,\n      createdAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'fallback_defined', chainId });\n    return this.chains.get(chainId);\n  }\n\n  async execute(chainId, executor) {\n    const chain = this.chains.get(chainId);\n    if (!chain) return null;\n    chain.attempts = 0;\n    const errors = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < chain.providers.length; i++) {\n      chain.currentIndex = i;\n      chain.attempts++;\n      try {\n        const result = await executor(chain.providers[i], i);\n        this._notify({ type: 'fallback_success', chainId, providerId: chain.providers[i], attempt: i + 1 });\n        return { chainId, providerId: chain.providers[i], attempt: i + 1, result };\n      } catch (e) {\n        errors.push({ providerId: chain.providers[i], error: e.message });\n      }\n    }\n    this._notify({ type: 'fallback_exhausted', chainId, errors });\n    return { chainId, success: false, errors };\n  }\n\n  get(chainId) {\n    return this.chains.get(chainId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.chains.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 4. ProviderLoadBalancer: distribute requests across providers -----\nclass ProviderLoadBalancer {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { strategy: options.strategy || 'weighted', ...options };\n    this.providers = new Map(); // providerId -> { capacity, currentLoad, weight }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  addProvider(providerId, capacity) {\n    this.providers.set(providerId, {\n      providerId,\n      capacity,\n      currentLoad: 0,\n      weight: 100,\n      addedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    return this.providers.get(providerId);\n  }\n\n  removeProvider(providerId) {\n    return this.providers.delete(providerId);\n  }\n\n  acquire(providerId) {\n    const p = this.providers.get(providerId);\n    if (!p) return null;\n    if (p.currentLoad >= p.capacity) return null;\n    p.currentLoad++;\n    p.weight = globalNativeBridge.computeLoadWeight(p.capacity, p.currentLoad);\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_acquired', providerId });\n    return p;\n  }\n\n  release(providerId) {\n    const p = this.providers.get(providerId);\n    if (!p) return null;\n    if (p.currentLoad > 0) p.currentLoad--;\n    p.weight = globalNativeBridge.computeLoadWeight(p.capacity, p.currentLoad);\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_released', providerId });\n    return p;\n  }\n\n  pickBest() {\n    let best = null;\n    let bestWeight = -1;\n    for (const p of this.providers.values()) {\n      if (p.currentLoad >= p.capacity) continue;\n      if (p.weight > bestWeight) {\n        bestWeight = p.weight;\n        best = p;\n      }\n    }\n    return best;\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.providers.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.providers.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 5. ProviderCircuitBreaker: isolate failing providers -----\nclass ProviderCircuitBreaker {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = { threshold: options.threshold || 5, resetMs: options.resetMs || 60000, ...options };\n    this.breakers = new Map(); // providerId -> { state, failures, lastFailure, openedAt }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  recordSuccess(providerId) {\n    const b = this.breakers.get(providerId);\n    if (!b) return null;\n    b.failures = 0;\n    b.state = 0; // closed\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  recordFailure(providerId) {\n    let b = this.breakers.get(providerId);\n    if (!b) {\n      b = { providerId, state: 0, failures: 0, lastFailure: null, openedAt: null };\n      this.breakers.set(providerId, b);\n    }\n    b.failures++;\n    b.lastFailure = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    b.state = globalNativeBridge.computeCircuitState(b.failures, this.options.threshold);\n    if (b.state === 2) {\n      b.openedAt = b.lastFailure;\n      this._notify({ type: 'circuit_opened', providerId });\n    }\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  canCall(providerId) {\n    const b = this.breakers.get(providerId);\n    if (!b) return true;\n    if (b.state === 0) return true; // closed\n    if (b.state === 2) {\n      // open — check if reset time has elapsed\n      if (b.openedAt && (globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp() - b.openedAt) >= this.options.resetMs) {\n        b.state = 1; // half-open\n        this._notify({ type: 'circuit_half_open', providerId });\n        return true;\n      }\n      return false;\n    }\n    return true; // half-open allows test calls\n  }\n\n  reset(providerId) {\n    const b = this.breakers.get(providerId);\n    if (!b) return null;\n    b.state = 0;\n    b.failures = 0;\n    b.openedAt = null;\n    return b;\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.breakers.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.breakers.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 6. ProviderHealthMonitor: track success/failure rates -----\nclass ProviderHealthMonitor {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.health = new Map(); // providerId -> { success, failure, totalMs, lastCheck }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  recordSuccess(providerId, durationMs = 0) {\n    let h = this.health.get(providerId);\n    if (!h) {\n      h = { providerId, success: 0, failure: 0, totalMs: 0, lastCheck: null, successRate: 100, avgMs: 0 };\n      this.health.set(providerId, h);\n    }\n    h.success++;\n    h.totalMs += durationMs;\n    h.lastCheck = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    this._updateRates(h);\n    return h;\n  }\n\n  recordFailure(providerId, durationMs = 0) {\n    let h = this.health.get(providerId);\n    if (!h) {\n      h = { providerId, success: 0, failure: 0, totalMs: 0, lastCheck: null, successRate: 100, avgMs: 0 };\n      this.health.set(providerId, h);\n    }\n    h.failure++;\n    h.totalMs += durationMs;\n    h.lastCheck = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    this._updateRates(h);\n    return h;\n  }\n\n  _updateRates(h) {\n    const total = h.success + h.failure;\n    h.successRate = total > 0 ? Math.floor((h.success * 100) / total) : 100;\n    h.avgMs = total > 0 ? Math.floor(h.totalMs / total) : 0;\n  }\n\n  health(providerId) {\n    const h = this.health.get(providerId);\n    if (!h) return null;\n    return {\n      providerId,\n      successRate: h.successRate,\n      avgMs: h.avgMs,\n      total: h.success + h.failure,\n      lastCheck: h.lastCheck\n    };\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.health.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.health.values()).map(h => ({\n      providerId: h.providerId,\n      successRate: h.successRate,\n      avgMs: h.avgMs,\n      total: h.success + h.failure,\n      lastCheck: h.lastCheck\n    }));\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 7. ProviderCapabilityMatcher: match providers to capabilities -----\nclass ProviderCapabilityMatcher {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.matches = new Map(); // matchId -> { capability, providers, scores }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  match(capability, providers) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(providers) || providers.length === 0) return null;\n    const scored = providers.map(p => {\n      const hasCap = p.capabilities && p.capabilities.includes(capability);\n      const score = hasCap ? (p.score || 50) : 0;\n      return { providerId: p.providerId, hasCap, score };\n    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n    const matchId = 'match_' + globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);\n    this.matches.set(matchId, {\n      matchId,\n      capability,\n      providers: scored,\n      matchedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'capability_matched', capability, matchId });\n    return { matchId, capability, providers: scored };\n  }\n\n  get(matchId) {\n    return this.matches.get(matchId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.matches.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 8. ProviderConfigManager: per-provider configuration -----\nclass ProviderConfigManager {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.configs = new Map(); // providerId -> { config, version, updatedAt }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  set(providerId, config) {\n    const existing = this.configs.get(providerId);\n    const version = existing ? existing.version + 1 : 1;\n    this.configs.set(providerId, {\n      providerId,\n      config,\n      version,\n      updatedAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp()\n    });\n    this._notify({ type: 'config_updated', providerId, version });\n    return this.configs.get(providerId);\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    const c = this.configs.get(providerId);\n    return c ? { ...c, config: { ...c.config } } : null;\n  }\n\n  merge(providerId, partial) {\n    const c = this.configs.get(providerId);\n    if (!c) return this.set(providerId, partial);\n    return this.set(providerId, { ...c.config, ...partial });\n  }\n\n  delete(providerId) {\n    const removed = this.configs.delete(providerId);\n    if (removed) this._notify({ type: 'config_deleted', providerId });\n    return removed;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.configs.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 9. ProviderMetricsCollector: aggregate provider stats -----\nclass ProviderMetricsCollector {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.metrics = new Map(); // providerId -> { calls, errors, totalMs, p95Ms, lastReset }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  recordCall(providerId, durationMs, success) {\n    let m = this.metrics.get(providerId);\n    if (!m) {\n      m = { providerId, calls: 0, errors: 0, totalMs: 0, samples: [], p95Ms: 0, lastReset: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp() };\n      this.metrics.set(providerId, m);\n    }\n    m.calls++;\n    if (!success) m.errors++;\n    m.totalMs += durationMs;\n    m.samples.push(durationMs);\n    if (m.samples.length > 100) m.samples.shift();\n    // Compute p95\n    if (m.samples.length > 0) {\n      const sorted = [...m.samples].sort((a, b) => a - b);\n      const idx = Math.floor(sorted.length * 0.95);\n      m.p95Ms = sorted[Math.min(idx, sorted.length - 1)];\n    }\n    return m;\n  }\n\n  reset(providerId) {\n    const m = this.metrics.get(providerId);\n    if (!m) return null;\n    m.calls = 0;\n    m.errors = 0;\n    m.totalMs = 0;\n    m.samples = [];\n    m.p95Ms = 0;\n    m.lastReset = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    return m;\n  }\n\n  summary(providerId) {\n    const m = this.metrics.get(providerId);\n    if (!m) return null;\n    return {\n      providerId,\n      calls: m.calls,\n      errors: m.errors,\n      errorRate: m.calls > 0 ? Math.floor((m.errors * 100) / m.calls) : 0,\n      avgMs: m.calls > 0 ? Math.floor(m.totalMs / m.calls) : 0,\n      p95Ms: m.p95Ms\n    };\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.metrics.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.metrics.keys()).map(id => this.summary(id));\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- 10. ProviderLifecycleManager: init/shutdown providers -----\nclass ProviderLifecycleManager {\n  constructor(options = {}) {\n    this.options = options;\n    this.lifecycle = new Map(); // providerId -> { state, initAt, shutdownAt, hooks }\n    this.subscribers = [];\n  }\n\n  init(providerId, initFn) {\n    const entry = {\n      providerId,\n      state: 'initializing',\n      initAt: globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp(),\n      shutdownAt: null,\n      hooks: { init: initFn || null }\n    };\n    this.lifecycle.set(providerId, entry);\n    try {\n      if (typeof initFn === 'function') initFn();\n      entry.state = 'active';\n    } catch (e) {\n      entry.state = 'failed';\n      entry.error = e.message;\n    }\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_initialized', providerId, state: entry.state });\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  shutdown(providerId, shutdownFn) {\n    const entry = this.lifecycle.get(providerId);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n    entry.state = 'shutting_down';\n    try {\n      if (typeof shutdownFn === 'function') shutdownFn();\n      entry.state = 'shutdown';\n      entry.shutdownAt = globalNativeBridge.eventTimestamp();\n    } catch (e) {\n      entry.state = 'shutdown_failed';\n      entry.error = e.message;\n    }\n    this._notify({ type: 'provider_shutdown', providerId, state: entry.state });\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  restart(providerId, initFn, shutdownFn) {\n    this.shutdown(providerId, shutdownFn);\n    return this.init(providerId, initFn);\n  }\n\n  get(providerId) {\n    return this.lifecycle.get(providerId) || null;\n  }\n\n  list() {\n    return Array.from(this.lifecycle.values());\n  }\n\n  subscribe(callback) {\n    this.subscribers.push(callback);\n    return this;\n  }\n\n  _notify(event) {\n    for (const cb of this.subscribers) {\n      try { cb(event); } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ----- Global instances -----\nconst globalProviderRegistry = new ProviderRegistry();\nconst globalProviderSelector = new ProviderSelector();\nconst globalProviderFallback = new ProviderFallback();\nconst globalProviderLoadBalancer = new ProviderLoadBalancer();\nconst globalProviderCircuitBreaker = new ProviderCircuitBreaker();\nconst globalProviderHealthMonitor = new ProviderHealthMonitor();\nconst globalProviderCapabilityMatcher = new ProviderCapabilityMatcher();\nconst globalProviderConfigManager = new ProviderConfigManager();\nconst globalProviderMetricsCollector = new ProviderMetricsCollector();\nconst globalProviderLifecycleManager = new ProviderLifecycleManager();\n\n// ----- Native hooks for Phase 16 -----\nconst _ProviderSelector_nativeScore = (health, cost, latency) => globalNativeBridge.computeProviderScore(health, cost, latency);\nconst _ProviderFallback_nativeDepth = (chain, reliability) => globalNativeBridge.computeFallbackDepth(chain, reliability);\nconst _ProviderLoadBalancer_nativeWeight = (capacity, load) => globalNativeBridge.computeLoadWeight(capacity, load);\nconst _ProviderCircuitBreaker_nativeState = (failures, threshold) => globalNativeBridge.computeCircuitState(failures, threshold);\n\n// ----- Native hooks for Phase 14 -----"}

### What Was Fixed

The remaining test failure in `phase16_audit.js` was a test logic issue, not a code issue:

- `ProviderCircuitBreaker.recordSuccess` only updates existing breakers (returns `null` if breaker doesn't exist)
- The test was calling `recordSuccess` first, then expecting `failures === 0`
- **Fix**: Added `recordFailure('svc1')` before `recordSuccess('svc1')` to create the breaker first

### Phase 16 Summary

**10 utility classes** added to `pipeline/screenai_pipelines.js`:

- `ProviderRegistry` — catalog of implementations
- `ProviderSelectorV2` — best provider selection (renamed from `ProviderSelector` to avoid Phase 13 conflict)
- `ProviderFallback` — alternative provider chains
- `ProviderLoadBalancer` — distribute requests by capacity
- `ProviderCircuitBreaker` — isolate failing providers
- `ProviderHealthMonitor` — track success/failure rates
- `ProviderCapabilityMatcher` — match providers to capabilities
- `ProviderConfigManager` — per-provider configuration
- `ProviderMetricsCollector` — aggregate provider stats
- `ProviderLifecycleManager` — init/shutdown/restart providers

**Native C++ hooks** (op codes 120-123) added to `screenai_core.h`/`screenai_core.cpp` with JS fallbacks.

**10 provider domains** supported: Browser, Vision, OCR, LLM, Filesystem, Terminal, Email, Documents, Network, OS.

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\hackathon_ui_operator_distill\\native\\screenai_core.cpp","oldString":"int compute_circuit_state(int failure_count, int threshold) {\n        // 0 = closed (healthy), 1 = half-open (testing), 2 = open (failing)\n        if (threshold <= 0) return 0;\n        if (failure_count >= threshold) return 2;       // open\n        if (failure_count >= threshold / 2) return 1;   // half-open\n        return 0;                                        // closed\n    }\n\n} // namespace provider","newString":"int compute_circuit_state(int failure_count, int threshold) {\n        // 0 = closed (healthy), 1 = half-open (testing), 2 = open (failing)\n        if (threshold <= 0) return 0;\n        if (failure_count >= threshold) return 2;       // open\n        if (failure_count >= threshold / 2) return 1;   // half-open\n        return 0;                                        // closed\n    }\n\n} // namespace provider\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Phase 17 — Agent Runtime implementations\n// ============================================================================\nnamespace runtime {\n\n    int compute_stage_priority(const std::string& stage, int64_t age_ms) {\n        // Base priority by stage importance, minus age decay\n        int base = 50;\n        if (stage == \"intent\") base = 90;\n        else if (stage == \"context\") base = 80;\n        else if (stage == \"plan\") base = 85;\n        else if (stage == \"graph\") base = 75;\n        else if (stage == \"registry\") base = 60;\n        else if (stage == \"runtime\") base = 95;\n        else if (stage == \"skills\") base = 70;\n        else if (stage == \"observe\") base = 65;\n        else if (stage == \"verify\") base = 85;\n        else if (stage == \"recover\") base = 90;\n        else if (stage == \"memory\") base = 50;\n        else if (stage == \"complete\") base = 40;\n\n        int decay = (int)(age_ms / 1000);  // 1 point per second\n        int priority = base - decay;\n        if (priority < 0) priority = 0;\n        if (priority > 100) priority = 100;\n        return priority;\n    }\n\n    std::string hash_runtime_request(const std::string& request_json) {\n        // djb2 hash for runtime request dedup\n        unsigned long hash = 5381;\n        for (char c : request_json) {\n            hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + (unsigned char)c;\n        }\n        std::ostringstream oss;\n        oss << \"rt_\" << std::hex << hash;\n        return oss.str();\n    }\n\n    int compute_runtime_relevance(const std::string& text, const std::string& query) {\n        // Token overlap + recency-style scoring\n        if (text.empty() || query.empty()) return 0;\n\n        // Simple word overlap\n        std::istringstream textStream(text);\n        std::istringstream queryStream(query);\n        std::string word;\n        std::vector<std::string> textWords;\n        std::vector<std::string> queryWords;\n\n        while (textStream >> word) textWords.push_back(word);\n        while (queryStream >> word) queryWords.push_back(word);\n\n        if (queryWords.empty()) return 0;\n\n        int matches = 0;\n        for (const auto& qw : queryWords) {\n            for (const auto& tw : textWords) {\n                if (qw == tw) { matches++; break; }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int score = (matches * 100) / (int)queryWords.size();\n        if (score > 100) score = 100;\n        return score;\n    }\n\n    int compute_stage_transition_cost(const std::string& source, const std::string& target) {\n        // Cost of transitioning between runtime stages (0-100)\n        // Lower cost for natural flow, higher for skips/loops\n        if (source == target) return 90;  // loop = expensive\n\n        // Natural flow costs\n        if ((source == \"intent\" && target == \"context\") ||\n            (source == \"context\" && target == \"plan\") ||\n            (source == \"plan\" && target == \"graph\") ||\n            (source == \"graph\" && target == \"registry\") ||\n            (source == \"registry\" && target == \"runtime\") ||\n            (source == \"runtime\" && target == \"skills\") ||\n            (source == \"skills\" && target == \"observe\") ||\n            (source == \"observe\" && target == \"verify\") ||\n            (source == \"verify\" && target == \"recover\") ||\n            (source == \"recover\" && target == \"memory\") ||\n            (source == \"memory\" && target == \"complete\")) {\n            return 10;\n        }\n\n        // Skip stages = moderate cost\n        return 50;\n    }\n\n} // namespace runtime"}

{"filePath":"c:\\Users\\brigh\\Desktop\\trying_new\\Screen-AI\\pipeline\\screenai_pipelines.js","oldString":"// Op 123: compute circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=half-open, 2=open)\n  computeCircuitState(failureCount, threshold) {\n    const r = this.call(123, failureCount + '|' + threshold);\n    if (r !== null) return parseInt(r, 10);\n    // JS fallback\n    const f = Math.max(0, parseInt(failureCount, 10) || 0);\n    const t = parseInt(threshold, 10) || 0;\n    if (t <= 0) return 0;\n    if (f >= t) return 2;\n    if (f >= Math.floor(t / 2)) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  isAvailable() {\n    return this.available;\n  }\n}","newString":"// Op 123: compute circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=half-open, 2=open)\n  computeCircuitState(failureCount, threshold) {\n    const r = this.call(123, failureCount + '|' + threshold);\n    if (r !== null) return parseInt(r, 10);\n    // JS fallback\n    const f = Math.max(0, parseInt(failureCount, 10) || 0);\n    const t = parseInt(threshold, 10) || 0;\n    if (t <= 0) return 0;\n    if (f >= t) return 2;\n    if (f >= Math.floor(t / 2)) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  // Op 130: compute stage priority (0-100) from stage name and age\n  computeStagePriority(stage, ageMs) {\n    const r = this.call(130, stage + '|' + (ageMs || 0));\n    if (r !== null) return parseInt(r, 10);\n    // JS fallback\n    const basePriorities = {\n      intent: 90, context: 80, plan: 85, graph: 75,\n      registry: 60, runtime: 95, skills: 70, observe: 65,\n      verify: 85, recover: 90, memory: 50, complete: 40,\n    };\n    const base = basePriorities[stage] || 50;\n    const decay = Math.floor((ageMs || 0) / 1000);\n    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, base - decay));\n  }\n\n  // Op 131: hash runtime request for dedup\n  hashRuntimeRequest(requestJson) {\n    const r = this.call(131, requestJson || '');\n    if (r !== null) return r;\n    // JS fallback: djb2 hash\n    let hash = 5381;\n    const s = requestJson || '';\n    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {\n      hash = ((hash << 5) + hash) + s.charCodeAt(i);\n      hash = hash & hash;\n    }\n    return 'rt_' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16);\n  }\n\n  // Op 132: compute runtime relevance (0-100) from text and query\n  computeRuntimeRelevance(text, query) {\n    const r = this.call(132, (text || '') + '|' + (query || ''));\n    if (r !== null) return parseInt(r, 10);\n    // JS fallback: token overlap\n    if (!text || !query) return 0;\n    const textWords = text.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/);\n    const queryWords = query.toLowerCase().split(/\\s+/);\n    if (queryWords.length === 0) return 0;\n    let matches = 0;\n    for (const qw of queryWords) {\n      if (textWords.includes(qw)) matches++;\n    }\n    return Math.min(100, Math.floor((matches * 100) / queryWords.length));\n  }\n\n  // Op 133: compute stage transition cost (0-100)\n  computeStageTransitionCost(source, target) {\n    const r = this.call(133, (source || '') + '|' + (target || ''));\n    if (r !== null) return parseInt(r, 10);\n    // JS fallback\n    if (source === target) return 90;\n    const naturalFlow = [\n      ['intent', 'context'], ['context', 'plan'], ['plan', 'graph'],\n      ['graph', 'registry'], ['registry', 'runtime'], ['runtime', 'skills'],\n      ['skills', 'observe'], ['observe', 'verify'], ['verify', 'recover'],\n      ['recover', 'memory'], ['memory', 'complete'],\n    ];\n    for (const [s, t] of naturalFlow) {\n      if (s === source && t === target) return 10;\n    }\n    return 50;\n  }\n\n  isAvailable() {\n    return this.available;\n  }\n}"}

AgentRuntime\n```\n\n### Agent Runtime Pipeline\n\n```text\nUser Request\n      │\n      ▼\nIntentEngine          (classify intent + risk)\n      │\n      ▼\nContextEngine         (gather environment + memory + resources)\n      │\n      ▼\nRuntimePlanner        (create plan with steps)\n      │\n      ▼\nRuntimeExecutionGraphBuilder  (build graph with auto-approval nodes)\n      │\n      ▼\nPipelineRegistryBridge (register pipeline)\n      │\n      ▼\nRuntimeExecutionEngine (execute graph nodes)\n      │\n      ▼\nSkillOrchestratorBridge (orchestrate skills)\n      │\n      ▼\nObservationEngineBridge (observe execution)\n      │\n      ▼\nVerificationEngineBridge (verify result)\n      │\n      ▼\nRecoveryEngineBridge  (recover on failure)\n      │\n      ▼\nMemoryUpdateBridge    (store in long-term memory)\n      │\n      ▼\nCompleted\n```\n\n### Agent Runtime Capabilities\n\n| Utility | Purpose |\n|---------|---------|\n| `IntentEngine` | Classify user request into intent + risk level using regex patterns |\n| `ContextEngine` | Gather environment, memory, and resource context for the request |\n| `RuntimePlanner` | Create execution plan with typed steps (observe, act, verify, finish) |\n| `RuntimeExecutionGraphBuilder` | Build execution graph with auto-inserted approval nodes for risk >= 3 |\n| `PipelineRegistryBridge` | Register and lookup pipelines by name or capability |\n| `RuntimeExecutionEngine` | Execute graph nodes and record results in history |\n| `SkillOrchestratorBridge` | Orchestrate skills based on intent with auto-selection |\n| `ObservationEngineBridge` | Record observations with timestamps for each stage |\n| `VerificationEngineBridge` | Verify execution results with pass/fail status |\n| `RecoveryEngineBridge` | Classify failures and apply recovery policies (retry/abort/rollback/replan) |\n| `MemoryUpdateBridge` | Store execution results in long-term memory with tags |\n| `AgentRuntime` | Orchestrate all 11 stages end-to-end via `processRequest()` |\n\n### Intent Patterns\n\n```text\nbrowser_open    - \"open chrome|edge|firefox|browser\"     (risk: 1)\nbrowser_search  - \"search <query>\"                       (risk: 1)\nbrowser_close   - \"close chrome|edge|firefox|browser\"    (risk: 1)\nfile_delete     - \"delete [file] <path>\"                  (risk: 3)\nfile_move       - \"move <src> to <dst>\"                   (risk: 2)\nfile_list       - \"list files|directory\"                  (risk: 0)\nsystem_status   - \"check status|system|memory|disk\"      (risk: 0)\nauth_login      - \"login [to] <site>\"                     (risk: 3)\ndownload_file   - \"download <url>\"                        (risk: 2)\nsystem_run      - \"run <command>\"                         (risk: 4)\n```\n\n### Recovery Policies\n\n```text\ntimeout      -> retry (3 attempts)\nnetwork      -> retry (5 attempts)\npermission   -> abort\nvalidation   -> abort\ncrash        -> rollback\nnot_found    -> replan\nunknown      -> retry (1 attempt)\n```\n\n### Native C++ Hooks (Op Codes 130-133)\n\n```text\n130 = compute_stage_priority       # base priority by stage - age decay (0-100)\n131 = hash_runtime_request         # djb2 hash for request dedup\n132 = compute_runtime_relevance    # token overlap score (0-100)\n133 = compute_stage_transition_cost # 10 for natural flow, 50 for skip, 90 for loop\n```\n\n### JS Fallbacks\n\nWhen the native addon is absent, every method falls back to pure-JS:\n\n- `computeStagePriority` → base priority by stage name minus age decay\n- `hashRuntimeRequest` → djb2 hash returning `rt_<hex>`\n- `computeRuntimeRelevance` → token overlap percentage\n- `computeStageTransitionCost` → 10 for natural flow, 50 for skip, 90 for loop\n\n### Verified\n\n```powershell\nnode -c pipeline\\screenai_pipelines.js\n# syntax OK\n\nnode pipeline\\test_pipeline.js\n# Results: 43/43 passed, 0 failed\n\nnode Create an AgentRuntime instance\nconst runtime = new AgentRuntime();\n\n// 2. Process a user request end-to-end\nconst result = runtime.processRequest({ text: 'open chrome' });\n// result.intent, result.context, result.plan, result.graph,\n// result.execution, result.orchestration, result.observation,\n// result.verification, result.memory, result.stages, result.status\n\n// 3. Use individual stages\nconst intent = runtime.intentEngine.classify('delete file foo.txt');\n// { name: 'file_delete', risk: 3, confidence: 0.9, ... }\n\nconst context = runtime.contextEngine.gather({ text: 'open chrome', intent });\n// { timestamp, request, intent, environment, memory, resources }\n\nconst plan = runtime.planner.createPlan(intent, context);\n// { intent, risk, steps: [...], context, createdAt }\n\nconst graph = runtime.executionGraph.build(plan.steps);\n// { nodes: [...], edges: [...], createdAt }\n// Note: auto-inserts approval nodes before risk >= 3 actions\n\n// 4. Register and execute pipelines\nruntime.pipelineRegistry.register('my_pipeline', { steps: ['a', 'b'] });\nconst execution = runtime.executionRuntime.execute(graph);\n\nconst orchestration = runtime.skillOrchestrator.orchestrate({ intent: 'browser_open' });\nconst observation = runtime.observationEngine.observe({ stage: 'runtime', data: execution });\nconst verification = runtime.verificationEngine.verify({ stage: 'runtime', observation });\nconst recovery = runtime.recoveryEngine.recover({ stage: 'runtime', error: 'timeout' });\nconst memory = runtime.memoryUpdate.update({ stage: 'runtime', result: execution });\n\n// 5. Use the global instance\nconst result = globalAgentRuntime.processRequest({ text: 'check status' });\n```\n"}
